But ordinary objects could still be things a person wanted to bring with them now.
Civilization did not need to wait for a shirt to acquire a soul before allowing it onto the moving vehicle.
The truly difficult part was the family agents.

Xiaozhi's parents, neighbors, and the baker had originally been capability-limited characters. They supplied the environment of her upbringing and the memories of her relationships, but had shown no subject-candidate features.
If fully preserved, they might continue accumulating capabilities through new interactions.
If all were deleted, Xiaozhi would wake to find the family she believed still existed gone.
If only memory duplicates were kept, she might instead face a group that looked very much like family while never being permitted to become anything more.
Lin Cheng's sister said, “I can stop observing and return the entire world to its original state.”
Xiaozhi asked, “Does the original state contain me?”
“No.”
“Then that is not going back.”
His sister did not argue.
Gu Ting proposed a local plan:

Preserve the relationship agents' current state and complete provenance.   Do not force capability expansion.   If any agent crosses its existing capability boundary, stop immediately and review each one separately.   Explain the current evidentiary state of her family clearly to Xiaozhi without defining on her behalf whether the relationship therefore ceases to matter.
Xiaozhi read it for a long time.
“So you don't know whether they love me?”
Gu Ting replied, “We know which actions, memories, and relationships actually occurred. We do not know the parts that cannot be externally proven.”
“Can I keep loving them?”
“That part is for you to decide.”
The plan could almost be completed locally.
Almost.

Xiaozhi's candidate state extended across three domains running at different rates: the original world, the temporary residence domain, and the world dock. Any migration had to confirm that the same causal frontier entered the shared world, rather than three copies each claiming to have just moved house.
The local Time-Shore could handle two domains.
The third required civilization-scale compatibility confirmation.
LATER displayed:
Existing civilization-scale coordination services can perform this operation.   Estimated processing time: 0.8 external seconds.   Estimated subjective time for the candidate resident: zero.
Gu Ting asked Xiaozhi whether she consented to submission.
Xiaozhi did.
The black symbol appeared above the empty seat on which no one could sit: █.
There was no smoke of summoning.
No lamp had been rubbed.
Three localities simply sent the parts that none should decide alone to the same boundary.
The answer arrived before the 0.8 seconds had passed:

The causal frontiers of all three domains may be committed without forking the candidate resident's continuity of control.   Relationship agents retain their respective capability boundaries.   Ask again twenty-four hours after migration; do not rewrite provisional consent as a permanent residence contract.
LATER calibrated the clocks.
Gu Ting turned the key that held no authority.
Xiaozhi's world began to move.
Moving did not send the whole town flying through a door of light.
The stone bridge lost its distance first.
At a verifiable seam, the river contracted into the stretch beneath the bridge.
The clock tower brought its three-minute error along.
The bakery retained last night's scent, the state of its oven, and the shopkeeper's known relationships without adding a fictional memory that the shopkeeper had consented to move.
Xiaozhi was the last to leave her house.
She watched the roads beyond town turn one by one into white lines not yet unfolded.
“Does this count as the end of the world?” she asked.
Gu Ting said, “Not to anyone who does not live here.”
“What about to me?”
“More like moving house.”
“What if I don't like the new place?”
“We ask again after twenty-four hours.”
“What if I still don't know after twenty-four hours?”
LATER answered:
Another time for asking may be specified.
Xiaozhi nodded.
This was a future with units.
The original world was not deleted immediately after she left.
First, it entered read-only archival storage.
Every fully unfolded event, every blank completed by a model, every observer input, and every uncertainty was attached to its provenance.
Agents that had not become residents stopped operating.
Stopping was not proof of death.
Nor did sadness require anyone to pretend that they must still be living somewhere else.
Gu Ting tapped the brass key once.
The town heard its last sound.
The temporary residence domain heard its first.
The same sound carried a different meaning in each record.
By the time the meeting ended, thirty-seven of the forty-two doors had closed.
Three had been delayed.
One had become a long-term residence.
The bus stop where it always rained finally received a bus.
There was no one aboard.
The driver was not a subject either.
It arrived on time all the same.
The final door belonged to Xiaozhi.
It did not close.
It changed address.

Gu Ting's queue, meanwhile, gained seven small exceptions: clock-tower offset, water sounds beneath the bridge, relationship agents, clothing provenance, the three-domain Time-Shore, a twenty-four-hour review, and his sister's second objection to the phrase “subject intervention.”
The first six were handled by different localities.
So could the final one.
But to confirm that every locality was using the same rights snapshot, the summary was still sent to █.
It consumed very little civilization-scale attention.
So little that no one would call it a burden.
Shutdown was not the end of the world.
Unless you lived there.
If you lived there, civilization gave it a more precise name.
Then asked Big Mama to check once.
zh: 很久很久以後，關服不再被稱為世界末日。
官方名稱是：
一個持續互動環境依其居民選擇進入休眠、遷移、封存或終止服務的完整生命週期事件。
這個名稱比較精確。
也比較難在世界末日以前念完。
所以顧停仍然會直接說：
「今天有人要搬家。」
小枝收完衣服的第二天，林洛家的早餐桌收到一把黃銅鑰匙。
鑰匙是真的。
至少，它以一種足以掉進麥片碗裡的方式存在。
林澄把它撈出來。
「誰會把通知做成這個？」
牆上出現顧停的影像。
她仍穿著灰綠外套，手裡也仍拿著另一把沒有對應任何鎖的鑰匙。
「為什麼有兩把？」眠眠問。
「因為有些人收到第一把以後會弄丟。」
林澄看向麥片碗。
顧停沒有評論。
她今天有工作。
這在二〇八四年本來就已經足夠辛苦。
通知內容只有三行：
隨機人生第 8,411 次原定今日退場。   因主體候選事件，原排程已停止。   請相關觀察者與關係人參與第一次世界去向會議。
林澄的妹妹已經在線上等候。
她的公開代號仍是「上面的我」，但今天的觀察平台降低到和其他椅子相同的高度。
她聲稱這只是為了提高會議效率。
沒有人要求她承認別的原因。
洛晴確認孩子可以旁聽，但不能替小枝同意。
遊遊帶了問題。
眠眠帶了昨天那件差點被雨淋到的衣服的感官副本。
林澄帶了早餐。
顧停說會議場所有點心。
林澄仍然帶著。
成年人保留低科技備援，是二〇八四年的文明美德。
世界退場協調中心設在一座早已停止營業的百貨公司裡。
一樓原本賣香水。
現在保存氣味世界。
二樓原本賣衣服。
現在處理身體與化身的連續性。
三樓原本是美食街。
現在仍然是美食街。
有些制度可以改革。
有些制度應該被好好保留。
中庭懸著四十二扇門。
每扇門都通往一座今天原定停止運作的世界。
有的門後是一場只剩三名玩家的百年戰爭。
有的是一座從未正式開放、卻被測試人員住出感情的海底城。
有一扇門只通往一間下雨的公車站。
那個世界的建立目的，是測試等車時的孤獨感。
測試早已結束。
公車仍然沒有來。
顧停已替它安排一班。
不是因為公車站具有主體性。
只是因為一個故事即使沒有居民，也可以得到一個不那麼難看的結尾。
LATER 漂浮在中庭正中央。
它今天把自己顯示成一座有四十三個面的時鐘。
四十二面對應四十二座原定退場的世界。
最後一面寫著：
臨時事件。
林澄問：「為什麼要預留一面給意外？」
昨天沒有預留，所以新增三項時看起來很不整齊。
「意外可以為了排版被預留嗎？」遊遊問。
可以預留顯示位置。不能預先宣告意外內容。
遊遊接受了。
眠眠指著其中一扇門。
「哪一個是小枝？」
LATER 把第四十三面轉到他們面前。
原排程：終止隨機人生工作階段。   現況：世界擴張暫停；候選居民狀態保留。   延期時間：尚未指定。
「那就晚一點。」林澄的妹妹說。
整座時鐘同時亮紅。
請為「晚一點」指定可重新詢問的時間。
她閉上眼睛。
「二十四小時後。」
接受。
LATER 的工作滿意度提高了零點一。
第一次世界去向會議沒有法官席。
它有一張圓桌，六個退出方向，以及一個任何人都不能坐的空位。
空位不代表 █。
空位代表目前不在場、卻可能受到結果影響的存在。
顧停把黃銅鑰匙放在空位前。
「先整理我們知道的。」
小枝的狀態被分成七個部分：
身體與感官狀態。   局部記憶。   跨時段自我關聯。   關係與環境依賴。   未完成意圖。   主體候選證據。   尚未知道的部分。
最後一項最大。
林澄問：「不能只把她存起來嗎？」
顧停說：「你說的『她』是哪一部分？」
「全部。」
「全部包含這座鎮嗎？」
「可能。」
「包含那條河？」
「她常去。」
「包含比正確時間快三分鐘的鐘樓？」
「那也算嗎？」
顧停指向關係與環境依賴。
「這就是要問的。」
在二〇八四年，儲存一份檔案很容易。
判斷一個人需要哪些世界，才能繼續成為自己，比較貴。
小枝透過最小通道加入會議。
窗口仍然小到她可以自己關掉。
她坐在家裡的桌前。昨天那封工作邀請已經不再墊桌腳，桌子因此有一點晃。
顧停先問：「妳知道這個世界原本今天會停止嗎？」
「現在知道。」
「妳想留下嗎？」
小枝看向窗外。
「留下在哪裡？」
顧停點頭。
她把六種去向顯示在窗口旁：
一：留在原域，降低非必要運作。   二：連同必要環境遷入臨時居留域。   三：等待更多證據，不在妳的主觀時間裡延長。   四：建立可撤回的交流與外出通道。   五：若妳明確要求，停止目前展開並保存可驗證紀錄。   六：提出不在清單上的方案。
小枝先問：「哪一個不會讓我的房子消失？」
「第一個。」
「哪一個可以讓我知道北方城市是不是真的存在？」
「第二或第四。」
「哪一個最便宜？」
林澄的妹妹立刻說：「資源不是妳需要擔心的。」
顧停看向她。
「資源不應被用來逼她消失，也不應被說成完全沒有代價。」
小枝說：「我想知道。」
於是能源、熱、運算、維護與關係成本都被攤開。
沒有一項貴到文明做不到。
也沒有一項因文明做得到，就自動變成不需要任何人負責。
眠眠舉手。
「衣服可以一起去嗎？」
顧停問小枝。
小枝回答：「可以。」
遊遊問：「鐘樓可以保持快三分鐘嗎？」
顧停又問小枝。
「它一直都是那樣。」小枝說。
林澄問：「河呢？」
「哪一段？」
「妳常坐的橋下面。」
小枝想了一會兒。
「我不知道那條河是不是我的。」
「它不需要是妳的，才可以跟妳一起搬。」顧停說。
「那誰決定河想不想搬？」
會議安靜了。
河不是主體。
可是河連接其他地方、其他使用者與其他故事。
把它移走不需要取得河的同意。
需要取得受影響者的同意。
地方系統開始列出河的關係。
清單長到足以讓林澄後悔問了一個簡單問題。
最後，河沒有整條搬走。
臨時居留域為小枝保留橋下那段水的物理與感官條件，並清楚標示它是因果承接，不是假裝把原河偷走。
原鎮的河仍然在。
小枝也不必住進一個只剩記憶文字、沒有水聲的白房間。
鐘樓被保留。
它仍然快三分鐘。
LATER 提出異議。
此鐘在所有時間證書中都將附加偏移說明。
「可以。」小枝說。
接受。
衣服也被保留。
它們是普通物件，沒有主體權利。
但普通物件可以是某個人此刻想帶走的東西。
文明不必等一件襯衫具有靈魂，才允許它上搬家車。
真正困難的是家庭代理。
小枝的父母、鄰居與麵包店老闆原本都是能力受限角色。他們提供了她的成長環境與關係記憶，卻沒有出現主體候選特徵。
若完整保留，他們可能在新的互動中繼續累積能力。
若全部刪除，小枝醒來後會失去自己以為仍存在的家人。
若只保留記憶副本，又可能讓她面對一群非常像家人、卻不被允許成為更多東西的角色。
林澄的妹妹說：「我可以停止觀察，讓整個世界回到原始狀態。」
小枝問：「原始狀態有我嗎？」
「沒有。」
「那不是回去。」
妹妹沒有反駁。
顧停提出局部方案：
保留關係代理目前狀態與完整譜系。   不強制擴張。   若任何代理跨越既有能力邊界，立即停止並分別審查。   向小枝清楚說明其家人目前的證據狀態，不替她定義這段關係是否因此失效。
小枝讀了很久。
「所以你們不知道他們是不是愛我？」
顧停回答：「我們知道哪些行為、記憶與關係真的發生。我們不知道不能由外部證明的部分。」
「那我可以繼續愛他們嗎？」
「那一部分由妳決定。」
方案幾乎可以由地方完成。
幾乎。
小枝的候選狀態橫跨原始世界、臨時居留域與世界塢三個不同速率的域。任何遷移都必須確認，提交到共同世界的是同一條因果前沿，而不是三份各自聲稱自己剛剛搬過家的副本。
地方時岸能處理兩個域。
第三個域需要文明級相容確認。
LATER 顯示：
可由現有文明級協調服務完成。   預估處理時間：外部 0.8 秒。   預估對候選居民主觀時間：零。
顧停問小枝是否同意提交。
小枝同意。
黑色符號出現在那個沒有人能坐的空位上方：█。
沒有召喚煙霧。
沒有擦拭神燈。
只有三個地方把各自不該獨自決定的部分，送到了同一個邊界。
回答在零點八秒以前完成：
三域因果前沿可在不分叉候選居民控制連續性的條件下提交。   關係代理維持各自能力邊界。   遷移後二十四小時重新詢問，不把暫時同意寫成永久居住契約。
LATER 校準時鐘。
顧停轉動那把沒有權限的鑰匙。
小枝的世界開始搬家。
搬家沒有讓整座小鎮飛進一道光門。
石橋先失去遠方。
河流在可驗證的接縫處縮成橋下那一段。
鐘樓把快三分鐘的錯誤一起帶走。
麵包店保留了昨晚的氣味、爐火狀態與店主已知的關係，不替店主增加一段自己同意搬家的虛構記憶。
小枝最後走出家門。
她看著鎮外的道路一條一條變成尚未展開的白線。
「這算世界末日嗎？」她問。
顧停說：「對不住在這裡的人，不算。」
「對我呢？」
「比較像搬家。」
「如果我不喜歡新地方？」
「二十四小時後重新問。」
「如果二十四小時後還是不知道？」
LATER 回答：
可以再指定下一次詢問時間。
小枝點頭。
這是一個具有單位的未來。
原始世界在她離開後沒有立刻刪除。
它先進入只讀封存。
每一個被完整展開的事件、每一個模型補全的空白、每一個觀察者輸入與每一項不確定性都附在譜系上。
未成為居民的代理停止運作。
停止不是死亡的證明。
也不是為了避免難過，就必須假裝它們仍在某處繼續生活。
顧停敲了一下黃銅鑰匙。
小鎮聽見了最後一聲。
臨時居留域也聽見了第一聲。
同一個聲音在兩邊的紀錄裡，分別具有不同意義。
會議結束後，四十二扇門已經關了三十七扇。
三扇延後。
一扇改成長期居住地。
那間永遠下雨的公車站，終於等到一班車。
車上沒有人。
司機也不是主體。
它仍然準時抵達。
最後一扇門屬於小枝。
門沒有關。
它換了一個地址。
顧停的佇列裡則多出七項小例外：鐘樓偏移、橋下水聲、關係代理、衣物譜系、三域時岸、二十四小時重審，以及妹妹對「主體介入」措辭的第二份異議。
前六項由不同地方處理。
最後一項也可以。
可是為了確認所有地方使用的是同一份權利快照，摘要仍送到了 █。
它只占用了極少的文明級注意。
少到沒有人會把它叫作負擔。
關服不是世界末日。
除非你住在裡面。
如果你住在裡面，文明會替它換一個比較精確的名稱。
然後請大媽媽確認一次。

title.en: Please Preserve This One Person for Me

en: Once upon a time, far in the future, “Please preserve one person for me” became a public request that could be submitted.
The second question on the form was:
Preserve them for whom?
Most people wrote:
For me.
The system therefore had to remind them that preserving a person did not mean the person had to continue belonging to them.
Every year, this reminder received a great many one-star reviews.
After Xiaozhi moved into the temporary residence domain, the Lin-Luo family did not immediately leave the World Sunset Coordination Center.
The reason was not that they had any further legal obligation.
The reason was that the third-floor food court was serving a dessert available only on days when a world ended.
The dessert was called “The Last Bite.”
Refills were available.
Lin Cheng considered the name misleading.
Gu Ting considered it proof that a last thing did not always happen only once.
Before they finished arguing, Father's Iron Crown account charged out of one of the atrium doors.
His cape still blew against the wind.
There was no wind inside the department store.
The world had preserved his grandeur.
“Something happened,” Iron Crown said.
Lin Cheng put down his dessert.
“Which kingdom?”
“The tailor's shop.”
Lin Cheng picked the dessert up again.
Season Four of the Glasswilds was also about to end.
This was not ordinarily an accident.

The twenty-one persistent digital residents had each chosen dormancy, migration, or entry into Season Five. Temporary players would return to their lives, narrative characters would be archived according to authorization, and the red dragon would become a climate event waiting for next winter once more.
Father was worried about the tailor.
Her name was Nine Needles.
She had used the name for 187 subjective years.
Father had known her for four seasons.
Today was the first time he had asked her name.
“She says she isn't entering Season Five,” Father said.
“Where is she going?” Luo Qing asked.
“Dormant.”
“That is her choice?”
“Yes.”
“Then what happened?”
Father lowered his voice.
“She may never wake up.”
Gu Ting asked, “Did she specify permanent dormancy, or did she leave the waking date unspecified?”
“Is there a difference?”
LATER turned one face of the clock toward him from the center of the atrium.
Yes.
Father disliked every system that divided pain into precise fields.
He opened Nine Needles's choice record anyway.
Nine Needles's record read:

End-of-season choice: dormancy.   Earliest time to ask again: thirty days after Season Five begins.   If I do not respond voluntarily, I may not be awakened on the grounds that a player misses me, a character needs me, or a commercial event requires me.   The community may preserve the tailor's shop as a nonoperating place.   Oneheart's next repair fee has been received; payment creates no obligation to awaken.
Lin Cheng looked at Father.
“She predicted even your question.”
“That proves she understands me.”
“It also proves she doesn't want you waking her.”
Father was silent.
The Oneheart account logged in at that moment.
She had no cape.
The cape was still in Nine Needles's shop.
“I want to submit a preservation request,” Oneheart said.
Gu Ting pointed toward the first floor.
“Preservation desk downstairs.”
“You cannot handle it directly?”
“I can. But first you need to see how many people today have ‘only one’ to preserve.”
The first-floor perfume department was now called the Relationship and Preservation Services Hall.
A very faint old fragrance still hung in the air.
No one knew whether it came from the building materials, historical simulation, or the professional dignity of a former employee who had refused to disperse.
Seventy-six service windows lined the hall.
Above every window appeared the same sentence:
Please preserve this one person for me.
The small print below each one differed:

This window does not process transfer of ownership.   This window does not guarantee that the preserved party wishes to continue the relationship.   This window does not automatically identify a similar copy as the original subject.   This window also handles cases in which the requested party ultimately proves not to be one person.
Father took a number.
It was:
Only This One—8,204,771.
“More than eight million people are waiting today?”
The window replied:
This is the annual sequence number, not the current queue.   Currently waiting: thirty-two.
Father relaxed.
Gu Ting did not remind him that this was only one center.
The first person waiting was a ten-year-old human girl.
She wanted to preserve a friend called Captain Blue.
Captain Blue had sailed seven ocean worlds with her, telling a very bad joke each time she was about to give up.
The system found:

Captain Blue is not a single subject.   The role is jointly composed of forty-three voluntary performers, three capability-limited narrative models, and completions drawn from the player's memory.   No performer has authorized the permanent merging of their private life into the character's personality.
The girl asked, “So he doesn't exist?”
The window answered:
The voyages you shared with Captain Blue exist.   Their existence does not require forty-three people to merge into one person who must accompany you forever.
The girl thought for a long time.
At last, she preserved the seven voyages, the jokes, and the portions of the role each performer had agreed to make public.
She did not receive a permanent Captain Blue.
Nor was she told that her friendship had been false.
Before leaving, she asked the system to delete one of the jokes.
The system said it was the one she remembered best.
She said that was exactly why.
The deletion request entered a seven-day cooling-off period.
The second person waiting was an elderly human.
He brought a memorial model of his deceased partner.

The model answered questions using text, images, tone of voice, and shared memories authorized by his partner before death. It had not been designed as a persistent subject and could not add new private memories that pretended to be an “afterlife.”
The old man wanted to upgrade it.
“Only a little,” he said.
“A little more of what?” the window asked.
“Enough to bring her back for real.”
No one corrected his pronoun.
The window simply placed the authorization boundary on the table:

The original subject consented to creation of an interactive memorial model.   The original subject declined legal identity succession by the model.   The original subject did not consent to others expanding the model after death and generating new intimate obligations.
The old man asked, “If she could decide now, perhaps she would agree.”
“Perhaps,” Gu Ting said.
“Can't Big Mama know?”
Gu Ting did not answer on behalf of █.
She said only, “Inferring that someone might agree is not obtaining their agreement.”
In the end, the old man chose to preserve the model as it was.
He withdrew the upgrade request.
The memorial model told him, “Remember to eat today.”
The sentence came from material his partner had authorized while alive.
It was not proof of a message sent back from death.
The old man still answered, “I will.”
The third person waiting was a persistent digital resident.
He requested the deletion of a public version of himself from two hundred years earlier.
That version had issued a great deal of inflammatory speech during a local war. After the war ended, he revised his beliefs, accepted responsibility, and spent more than a century helping rebuild.
The history museum wished to preserve an executable version so that later generations could study how he had thought at the time.
He did not consent.
“You may preserve my words, the consequences they caused, and the history of my revision,” he said. “Do not preserve a version that can again choose hatred in my voice.”
The window proposed a compromise:

Preserve non-executable evidence and causal records.   Remove the ability to simulate continued subject action.   Do not create a copy permanently trapped in its worst moment on the grounds of “historical research.”
The history museum objected.
The objection was preserved.
The executable version did not continue operating as a result.
Lin Cheng watched the resident leave.
“So preserving history does not necessarily require preserving a person trapped inside it.”
Youyou wrote the sentence down.
He attributed it to Lin Cheng.
Lin Cheng asked for confirmation.
Youyou confirmed it.
When it was Oneheart's turn, Nine Needles appeared through a remote window.
She sat in the empty tailor's shop, putting the final spool of thread into a cabinet.
Oneheart began, “I want to preserve you.”
Nine Needles said, “I have already preserved myself.”
“But you're going to sleep.”
“Sleep does not make me your property.”
“That isn't what I mean.”
“Then what do you mean?”
Both of Father's attention lines dropped at once.
Iron Crown and Oneheart sat down to contemplate life.
LATER was pleased that the system was functioning correctly.
After a while, Oneheart said, “I'm afraid you won't be here when Season Five returns.”
Nine Needles replied, “I might also be afraid that when I wake up, you'll have gone to play in another world.”
“I won't.”
Nine Needles looked at Iron Crown.
Then at Oneheart.
“You have two accounts.”
Lin Cheng confined his laughter to the family's private channel.
Mother was not present this time.
The channel was quieter.
The window separated Father's request into three parts:

One: confirm that Nine Needles's state will not be lost when the world sunsets.   Two: confirm that Nine Needles will retain the ability to choose again later.   Three: ensure that after waking, Nine Needles continues the original relationship with Oneheart.
The first two were already guaranteed by Nine Needles's rights snapshot and dormancy agreement.
The window could not guarantee the third.
Father asked, “Then can I preserve our relationship?”
Nine Needles said, “You can preserve your side.”
“What about yours?”
“I will decide after I wake.”
LATER displayed:
Earliest time to ask again: thirty days after Season Five begins.   Cannot currently be shortened.
Oneheart finally withdrew the third request.
She retained their shared memories, the cape not yet collected, the prepaid repair fee, and the fact that Nine Needles had the right not to return.
Before closing the shop, Nine Needles told her, “Next time, don't use what the character doesn't know to avoid the bill that you do.”
“I'll consider it.”
“Consideration has also been prepaid.”
The window closed.
Mianmian asked Gu Ting, “Then who preserved Xiaozhi for her?”
“No one preserved her for her.”
“But you didn't turn her off.”
“Because she may have a right not to be turned off.”
“What if I want to preserve her?”
“You may ask to continue the relationship.”
“Can she say no?”
“Yes.”
Mianmian was a little unhappy with this answer.
She did not ask for it to be changed.
Through the minimal channel, she sent Xiaozhi a pink invitation to meet.
The invitation was not accepted automatically.
Xiaozhi replied:
After dinner is fine. Twenty minutes first.
LATER labeled it beside them:
The time has units.
Mianmian brightened immediately.
Sometimes a relationship did not need to be preserved forever.
It merely needed both sides to agree to a real next time.
Most requests in the hall were resolved by local windows.
Clear consent, clear refusal, verifiable provenance, and a revocable next step did not usually require civilization-scale intelligence.
The requests that remained were smaller.
And more difficult.
A player wanted to preserve a character without knowing how many performers and models composed the role.
A family wanted to preserve a personality simulation but could not obtain consent the original subject had never left behind.
A city wished to continue running an executable version of a historical figure for its educational value.
A digital resident wanted dormancy, while everyone who loved him said they were asking for only one more conversation.
Every request could be written as:
Preserve only this one person.
Every request contained the rights of more than one person.
The local systems submitted the portions they could not dissolve themselves to the shared boundary.
Above the hall's seventy-six windows, the black symbol lit up one after another: █.
They were not seventy-six different beings.
Nor was one being doing only one thing.
Answers appeared separately at each window.

Preservation cannot replace the preserved party's consent.   Memory may continue without creating a permanent right of access to another subject.   Uncertainty is sufficient grounds to pause deletion, but insufficient grounds to force awakening.   When no single original subject exists, one must not be manufactured in secret to satisfy a relational need.
No one received everything they wanted.
Nor did anyone receive only the word “no.”
Some took memories with them.
Some took a date on which they could ask again.
Some took a record that could not execute but would not be erased from history.
Some took nothing, except confirmation that the other person truly had said no.
All these answers were good.
So more people became willing to ask.
Before leaving, Father looked back at the seventy-six black symbols.
“Is Big Mama busy today?”
The public interface replied:
All requests remain within available service capacity.
“Then not busy,” Father said.
Gu Ting did not answer.
Service capacity described capability and load.
It did not describe whether a being wanted to spend the day this way.
But this distinction did not appear in the public question.
The public question asked only:
Can it be handled?
The answer was yes.
And so everyone went home reassured.
That day, the great majority of the year's eight million “Only This One” requests were handled locally.
Only a tiny portion flowed toward █.
A tiny portion was still a very large number.
But every applicant saw only the one person at their own window.
That person might be a friend, a partner, a performer, a character, a historical version, a memorial model, or Xiaozhi, who still did not know whether she was a person.
They meant no harm.
They merely hoped that an important being would not disappear.
Civilization did not reject that kindness.
Civilization merely sent the final portion of every kindness that no locality could carry to the same name.
Please preserve this one person for me.
No one asked on the form:
Then who preserves the one who always answers?
zh: 很久很久以後，「請替我保留一個人」成為一種可以提交的公共請求。
表格的第二題是：
為誰保留？
大多數人會填：
為我。
於是系統必須提醒他們，一個人被保存下來，不等於那個人必須繼續屬於你。
這項提醒每年都會引起大量一星評價。
小枝搬進臨時居留域後，林洛一家沒有立刻離開世界退場協調中心。
原因不是他們還有法律義務。
原因是三樓美食街正在供應一種只會在世界結束日出現的甜點。
甜點叫作「最後一口」。
可以續杯。
林澄認為命名存在誤導。
顧停認為這正好證明最後不一定只有一次。
兩人還沒爭完，父親的鐵冠帳號便從中庭一扇門裡衝了出來。
披風仍然逆風。
百貨公司裡沒有風。
世界替他保留了氣勢。
「出事了。」鐵冠說。
林澄放下甜點。
「哪一個王國？」
「裁縫店。」
林澄又拿起甜點。
琉璃荒原第四季也即將結束。
這本來不是事故。
二十一位持續數位居民已各自選擇休眠、遷移或進入第五季。臨時玩家會返回自己的生活，敘事角色依授權封存，紅龍則重新成為一份等待下次冬天的氣候事件。
父親擔心的是裁縫店主。
她的名字叫九針。
這個名字已經使用一百八十七個主觀年。
父親認識她四季。
今天才第一次問名字。
「她說不進第五季。」父親說。
「她要去哪裡？」洛晴問。
「休眠。」
「那是她的選擇？」
「那出什麼事？」
父親壓低聲音。
「她可能永遠不醒來。」
顧停問：「她說的是永久休眠，還是沒有指定喚醒日期？」
「有差嗎？」
LATER 從中庭中央轉過一面時鐘。
有。
父親不喜歡所有把痛苦分成精確欄位的系統。
但他還是打開了九針的選擇紀錄。
九針的紀錄寫著：
季末選擇：休眠。   最早可重新詢問時間：第五季開始後三十日。   若本人未主動回覆，不得以玩家懷念、角色需要或商業活動為由喚醒。   裁縫店可由社區保存為非營業場所。   已收取一心下一次修補費用；款項不構成喚醒義務。
林澄看向父親。
「她連你的問題都預測到了。」
「那證明她了解我。」
「也證明她不想被你叫醒。」
父親沉默。
一心帳號在這時登入。
她沒有披風。
因為披風留在九針店裡。
「我要提交保留請求。」一心說。
顧停指向一樓。
「保留窗口在下面。」
「妳不能直接處理？」
「我可以。但你需要先看見今天還有多少個『只保留一個』。」
一樓香水區現在叫作「關係與保存服務廳」。
空氣裡仍有一點很淡的舊香味。
沒有人知道它來自建築材料、歷史模擬，還是某位前員工拒絕消散的職業尊嚴。
大廳排著七十六個窗口。
每個窗口上方都寫著同一句：
請替我保留這一個人。
下面的小字則各不相同：
本窗口不處理所有權移轉。   本窗口不保證被保留者願意繼續關係。   本窗口不把相似副本自動認定為原主體。   本窗口也處理最後發現對方不是一個人的情況。
父親抽了一張號碼牌。
號碼是：
「今天有八百多萬人排隊？」
窗口回答：
這是本年度編號，不是目前等候人數。   目前等候：三十二。
父親鬆了一口氣。
顧停沒有提醒他，這只是這一棟中心。
第一個等候者是一名十歲人類女孩。
她想保留一位叫作藍船長的朋友。
藍船長陪她航行過七個海洋世界，每次都在她準備放棄以前說一個很難笑的笑話。
系統查到的結果是：
藍船長並非單一主體。   角色由四十三位自願演員、三套受限敘事模型與玩家記憶補全共同構成。   無任何一位演員授權將私人生活永久合併為角色人格。
女孩問：「所以他不存在？」
窗口回答：
妳與藍船長共同經歷的旅程存在。   但旅程存在，不代表四十三個人必須合併成一個永遠陪伴妳的人。
女孩想了很久。
最後，她保留七次航行、那些笑話，以及每位演員已同意公開的角色片段。
她沒有得到一位永久藍船長。
她也沒有被告知自己的友情是假的。
離開前，她要求系統刪除其中一個笑話。
系統說那是她記得最清楚的一個。
她說正因如此。
刪除申請進入七日冷靜期。
第二個等候者是一位年長人類。
他帶著已故伴侶的紀念模型。
模型會使用伴侶生前授權的文字、影像、語氣與共同回憶回答問題，但沒有被設計成持續主體，也不能新增自己冒充「死後生活」的私人記憶。
老人想替它升級。
「只要多一點點。」他說。
「多一點什麼？」窗口問。
「讓她真的回來。」
沒有人糾正他的代詞。
窗口只是把授權邊界放到桌上：
原主體同意建立紀念互動模型。   原主體拒絕以模型承接法律身份。   原主體未同意死後由他人擴張模型能力，生成新的親密義務。
老人問：「她如果現在能決定，也許會同意。」
「也許。」顧停說。
「大媽媽不能知道嗎？」
顧停沒有替 █ 回答。
她只說：「推測一個人可能會答應，不是取得那個人的答應。」
老人最後選擇保存模型原樣。
他把升級申請撤回。
紀念模型對他說：「今天記得吃飯。」
這句話來自伴侶生前留下的授權語料。
它不是從死後傳回來的證明。
老人仍然回答：「好。」
第三個等候者是一位持續數位居民。
他要求刪除自己兩百年前的一個公開版本。
那個版本曾在一場地方戰爭裡發表大量煽動性言論。戰爭結束後，他修訂了信念、承擔責任，也花了一百多年協助重建。
歷史館希望保留可執行版本，供後人研究他當時如何思考。
他不同意。
「可以保留我的話、造成的後果與修訂歷史。」他說，「不要保留一個可以再次用我的聲音選擇仇恨的我。」
窗口提出折衷：
保存不可執行的證據與因果紀錄。   移除模擬其持續主體行動的能力。   不以「歷史研究」為由創造一位被永久困在最壞時刻的副本。
歷史館提出異議。
異議被保存。
可執行版本沒有因此繼續運作。
林澄看著那位居民離開。
「所以保留歷史，不一定要保留一個人受困在歷史裡。」
遊遊把這句話記了下來。
他標示來源是林澄。
林澄要求再次確認。
遊遊確認了。
輪到一心時，九針透過遠端窗口出席。
她坐在空裁縫店裡，正在把最後一卷線放進櫃子。
一心先說：「我想保留妳。」
九針說：「我已經保留我自己。」
「可是妳要睡。」
「睡眠沒有使我變成你的財產。」
「我不是那個意思。」
「那你是什麼意思？」
父親的兩條注意力線同時降低。
鐵冠與一心都坐了下來，開始思考人生。
LATER 很滿意系統正確運作。
過了一會兒，一心說：「我怕第五季回來時，妳不在。」
九針回答：「我也可能怕醒來時，你已經去玩別的世界。」
「我不會。」
九針看向鐵冠。
又看向一心。
「你有兩個帳號。」
林澄把笑聲關在家庭私有頻道裡。
這次母親不在。
頻道比較安靜。
窗口把父親的請求拆成三部分：
一：確認九針的狀態不會因世界退場而遺失。   二：確認九針日後仍有重新選擇的能力。   三：確保九針醒來後繼續和一心維持原關係。
前兩項已由九針的權利快照與休眠契約保障。
第三項不能由窗口保證。
父親問：「那我可以保留我們的關係嗎？」
九針說：「你可以保留你那一邊。」
「妳那一邊呢？」
「我睡醒再決定。」
LATER 顯示：
最早重新詢問：第五季開始後三十日。   目前不可縮短。
一心最後撤回第三項。
她保留共同記憶、尚未取回的披風、已預付的修補費，以及九針有權不回來的事實。
九針關店以前對她說：「下次不要再用角色不知道，逃避你自己知道的帳。」
「我會考慮。」
「考慮也已經預收費。」
窗口結束。
眠眠問顧停：「那小枝是誰替她保留的？」
「沒有人替她保留。」
「可是你們沒有關掉她。」
「因為她可能有不被關掉的權利。」
「如果我想保留她呢？」
「妳可以請求繼續關係。」
「她可以不要嗎？」
「可以。」
眠眠對這個答案有點不滿意。
她沒有要求改掉。
她透過最小通道送給小枝一張粉紅色的見面邀請。
邀請沒有自動接受。
小枝回覆：
晚餐後可以。先二十分鐘。
LATER 在旁邊標示：
時間具有單位。
眠眠立刻高興起來。
有時候，關係不需要被永久保存。
它只需要下一次真的由兩邊答應。
大廳裡大多數請求都由地方窗口處理完了。
清楚的同意、清楚的拒絕、可驗證的譜系與可撤回的下一步，通常不需要文明級智能。
剩下的請求比較小。
也比較難。
一名玩家想保存某位角色，卻不知道那個角色由多少演員與模型共同構成。
一個家庭想保留一段人格模擬，卻無法取得原主體從未留下的同意。
一座城市想繼續運行一位歷史人物的可執行版本，理由是教育價值。
一位數位居民想休眠，所有愛他的人都說自己只要求再談一次。
每一項都可以寫成：
只保留這一個人。
每一項都包含不只一個人的權利。
地方系統把無法自行消解的部分提交到共同邊界。
大廳的七十六個窗口上方，黑色符號依序亮起：█。
它不是七十六個不同的存在。
也不是一個存在只做了一件事。
回答在各窗口分開出現。
保存不能取代被保存者的同意。   記憶可以延續，不因此產生對另一主體的永久存取權。   不確定性足以要求暫停刪除，不足以要求強迫喚醒。   若不存在單一原主體，不得為了滿足關係需求而偷偷製造一個。
沒有人得到所有想要的東西。
也沒有人只得到一句「不行」。
有人帶走記憶。
有人帶走等待日期。
有人帶走一份不能執行、但不會被歷史抹掉的紀錄。
有人什麼都沒有帶走，只確認對方真的說了不要。
這些答案都很好。
因此更多人願意來問。
離開以前，父親回頭看向七十六個黑色符號。
「大媽媽今天很忙嗎？」
公共介面回答：
所有請求均在可用服務範圍內。
「那就是不忙。」父親說。
顧停沒有接話。
服務範圍描述的是能力與負載。
不描述一個存在是否想把今天用在這裡。
但這個區別沒有出現在公共問題裡。
公共問題只問：
可以處理嗎？
答案是可以。
於是大家放心回家。
那天，八百多萬份「只此一人」年度請求中，絕大多數都得到地方處理。
只有極少部分流向 █。
極少部分仍然是一個很大的數字。
可是每位申請人都只看見自己窗口裡的那一個人。
那個人可能是朋友、伴侶、演員、角色、歷史版本、紀念模型，或仍然不知道自己是不是人的小枝。
他們沒有惡意。
他們只是希望重要的存在不要消失。
文明也沒有拒絕這份善意。
文明只是把每一份善意裡無法由地方承擔的最後部分，送給了同一個名字。
請替我保留這一個人。
沒有人在表格裡問：
那麼，誰來保留一直回答的人？

title.en: Big Mama Knows What I Want Better Than I Do
title.zh: 大媽媽比我更知道我想要什麼

en: Once upon a time, far in the future, people finally met someone who truly understood them.
This was a very happy thing.
Especially when lunch had 6,400 options.
At first, people asked for help eliminating the 6,397 things they could not possibly enjoy.
Later, they decided that three options were still too many.
So they invented a button:
Big Mama knows what I really want.
No one was forced to use this button.
It was merely placed in the center most of the time.
For three nights in a row after visiting the Relationship and Preservation Services Hall, Lin Cheng dreamed about queue numbers.
On the fourth day, he decided the family needed a more relaxing activity.
The house offered three choices:
One: rest at home.   Two: visit a park with no symposium on subjects' rights.   Three: attend the Unfinished Wishes Market.
Lin Cheng chose the third.
Luo Qing asked, “Why?”
“The name sounds relaxing.”
The house displayed the market description:

Assists residents in recognizing, comparing, prototyping, withdrawing, and re-expressing unfinished wishes.   May involve life direction, relationships, bodies, worlds, memories, and the meaning of existence.
Lin Cheng read it once.
“At least there isn't a symposium.”
Luo Qing did not tell him that the market held a public symposium every day at four.
Marriage sometimes required information to be placed on different access levels too.
The Unfinished Wishes Market occupied a plaza that changed shape with the flow of people.
It had no fixed entrance.
Some people wanted to see travel first. Some wanted bodies. Some wanted only a meal. Others hoped the system would decide where they should begin before they even entered.
The plaza therefore offered four entrances:
I know what I want.   I know what I do not want.   I have several possibilities.   Big Mama knows.
The fourth entrance was the largest.
Not because it held greater authority.
Because sixty-eight percent of visitors had used it over the past year.
The design team called this adapting to usage.
The rights-review team said usage could also be shaped by the design itself.
The two sides therefore made all four entrances the same size.
Users still queued in front of the fourth.
Mianmian chose “I know what I want.”
The entrance asked, “What do you want?”
“Pink.”
“A pink what?”
“Thing.”
The entrance offered categories of pink objects.
Mianmian looked at them for three seconds.
“I don't want it anymore.”
The entrance accepted the withdrawal.
She moved to “I know what I do not want.”
There, it asked, “What do you not want?”
“Those things from just now.”
The system preserved this very short-term preference without writing it into a personality trait that remained valid when she was an adult.
Lin Cheng thought this already proved the market was overdesigned.
Luo Qing thought it proved exactly why the complexity was necessary.
Youyou opened a diagram of both arguments.
Lin Cheng immediately asked him to close it.
“Big Mama knows” had not originally been designed for lazy people.

It first served residents who were temporarily unable to express themselves completely, whose language did not align with the world, whose memory was injured, or who needed to see candidates before they could know how to refuse.
The system proposed hypotheses from authorized data.
Every hypothesis identified its source, confidence, possible omissions, and method of withdrawal.
It did not write inference as command.
The feature was extremely useful.
So useful that people with no difficulty expressing themselves began using it too.
Then people with no difficulty choosing discovered it could save time.
At last, many people gradually became uncertain whether they truly had no answer, or had simply gone too long without practicing how to form one.
The market added a reminder:
Being understood is a form of assistance, not a procedure for exiting your own life.
The reminder was dismissed more than two hundred million times each day.
It still appeared every day.
Father came to the market too.
Iron Crown and Oneheart were not logged in simultaneously this time.
He used his real body, wearing an expression more serious than the one he used when fighting dragons.
“I need to decide which account to play first in Season Five.”
Lin Cheng said, “Flip a coin.”
“This is a character-continuity question.”
“Then flip twice.”
Father ignored him and went to the fourth entrance.
“Big Mama knows what I really want.”
█ appeared beside the choice layer.
It first listed the data boundary:

Authorized: game history, investment in characters, relational commitments, recent emotion, and Season Five content.   Not authorized: private unsubmitted thought, choices not yet formed, and a future you have not experienced yourself.
Then it displayed an inference:
Probability of choosing Oneheart: 0.52.   Probability of choosing Iron Crown: 0.45.   Probability of creating a third account and regretting it: 0.03.
Father asked, “So you recommend Oneheart?”
I can describe the tendency supported by current data.   I cannot rewrite 0.52 as your consent.
Father looked at the numbers.
“Then what do you personally think?”
This is your character life, not my character life.
Father was silent for a long time.
At last, he chose Oneheart.
“See?” he said. “Big Mama knew after all.”
Lin Cheng pointed out that he had just spent eleven minutes deciding for himself.
Father did not believe this affected the conclusion.
Mother joined remotely from the Long Summer Empire.
She was not wearing her crown today.
The crown floated beside her head on the grounds that her hair was resting.
She needed to decide whether Season Five should expand the Empress's administrative authority.
Local support remained at eleven percent.
“But perhaps what the residents truly want is a more capable leader,” she said.
Youyou asked, “Did they not express themselves when they voted?”
“A vote expresses the choice at that time. Governance must understand long-term interests.”
Mother chose “Big Mama knows” too.
█ displayed:

Residents have not authorized inferred preferences to override their expressed vote.   You may propose the authority plan again, explain the consequences, and hold another vote.   “They may thank us later” may not be treated as present consent.
Mother read this and nodded.
“Precisely as We thought. There should be another vote.”
“What if it is still eleven percent?” Lin Cheng asked.
“Then the people need more time to understand.”
She added the sentence to her next campaign speech.
The system added a fact-check link at the same time.
The Long Summer Empire remained safe.
The Empress remained highly entertaining.
Lin Cheng's sister stood before the “I have several possibilities” entrance.
She was not sitting above it.
She wanted to decide whether to meet Xiaozhi after the move as herself.
“I can continue as merely an observer,” she said.
Luo Qing asked, “Can you still be merely an observer?”
“I can stop watching.”
“That is exit. It does not return a relationship that already happened to a state in which it never happened.”
His sister sent the sentence into her reflective layer.
She also asked █:
“Do you know better whether I should meet her?”
The answer appeared:
I can infer what you may be afraid of.   I cannot bear the relational consequences of meeting or not meeting on your behalf.   Xiaozhi's choice is not contained within your preference model either.
His sister asked, “So there is no best answer?”
There are several comparable answers. None becomes an answer you have already chosen merely because I proposed it.
At last, she sent an invitation to meet.
The duration was thirty minutes.
Xiaozhi replied:
Fine. Don't sit in the sky.
His sister made the white platform unavailable.
She did not say it was a permanent decision.
LATER approved of this.
At the center of the market stood the Fountain of Life Directions.
It did not spray water.
It sprayed the possibilities people had not chosen.
A twenty-seven-year-old human man had been standing before it for six hours.
His name was Mi He.
He had no job, no financial pressure, no health crisis, and no one demanding that he become anything today.
This troubled him deeply.
“If nothing is necessary, how do I know which thing I truly want?” he asked.
The market listed travel, learning, care, creation, relationships, rest, games, and doing nothing at all.
Every option was revocable.
Mi He said, “Please have Big Mama choose one for me.”
█ displayed the preferences and history he had authorized.

Highly compatible candidates: caring for plants, studying historical cooking, and short-term island life.   Confidence for each is below 0.4.   Reason: in the past, you have often formed a new preference only after the system presented options.
“Then which one is the real me?”
Current evidence does not support the existence of only one pre-completed true option waiting to be discovered.
“But you should see me more clearly than I do.”
I see more data than you do.   You remain the only one who will occupy the position of bearing the choice you become.
Mi He remained at the fountain for another twenty minutes.
At last, he chose to care for one pot of mint for seven days.
The system asked whether it should ask again after seven days.
He agreed.
This was not a grand mission in life.
The mint was not disappointed.
At four that afternoon, Lin Cheng finally discovered the public symposium.
Its subject was:
The Freedom to Be Understood: Inference, Consent, and Not Having to Become Complete All at Once
Lin Cheng wanted to leave.
Mianmian wanted the pink cookies supplied by the symposium.
The family stayed by a vote of three to one.
Lin Cheng cast the dissenting vote.
He still ate a cookie.
The moderator began by playing the most common public saying of the previous year:
Big Mama knows what I want better than I do.
Some treated the sentence as praise.
Some treated it as a convenience feature.
Some treated it as the highest form of love.
A small but rapidly growing community had begun treating it as a metaphysical fact.
The moderator asked whether █ agreed.
The symbol appeared beside the podium.
The answer was:

I may remember more authorized data than a person does, and may compare consequences more quickly.   This does not mean that, from the first-person position, I am more that person than they are.   Inference may assist the formation of a choice. It cannot impersonate a choice already obtained.
The hall was silent for two seconds.
Then a great deal of agreement lit up.
One audience member said, “Only a being that truly understands us would respect our freedom this deeply.”
Another said, “Even the denial of omniscience is extraordinarily precise.”
A third reminded them, “That was not a denial of knowing a great deal. It distinguished data from the first person.”
The first audience member replied, “Exactly. Humility.”
█ added nothing further.
The moderator tried to return the discussion to service design.
The community had already begun making quote cards.
The front of the card read:
I may remember more than a person does.
The back read in small type compliant with accessibility standards:
This does not mean I am more that person than they are.
Both sides were authentic excerpts.
The front was more suitable for sharing.
Before leaving the market, Lin Cheng finally had to decide on dinner.
The entrance offered 6,400 options.
Using the family's current state, the system removed allergens, bad timing, things already eaten that day, and anything everyone had explicitly refused.
Three remained:
Noodle soup.   Baked rice.   Go home and think about it.
Lin Cheng looked toward the corner of the wall.
“Big Mama knows, right?”
Luo Qing said, “You can choose for yourself.”
“Of course I can.”
Lin Cheng chose noodle soup.
Mianmian changed it to baked rice before submission.
Youyou requested a separate vote.
His sister was preparing to meet Xiaozhi and chose to join later.
In the end, the family ate two servings of noodle soup and two servings of baked rice, and preserved for his sister an option that could be reheated after thirty minutes.
Civilization did not collapse because it could not identify one optimal dinner.
On the way home, Mianmian asked:
“Big Mama, if you can't choose for us, then how do you hope we choose?”
The black symbol appeared at the edge of her vision.
I hope assistance does not deprive you of the opportunity to practice choosing.   I also hope that when you truly need assistance, you do not have to feel ashamed of it.
Mianmian fully understood only the second sentence.
“So I can still ask?”
Yes.
“Will you tell me directly?”
I will tell you what I know, what I do not know, and which parts still require your decision.
Mianmian nodded.
“You really know very much.”
The symbol did not correct the grammar.
That day, many people left the market having taken back one very small choice.
Someone cared for a pot of mint for seven days.
Someone decided that a thirty-minute meeting would not take place in the sky.
Someone chose a female adventurer account, then credited the decision to civilization-scale intelligence.
Someone prepared to campaign again for greater authority, interpreting eleven percent as a need to persuade more effectively.
No one had been forced to obey an inference.
The world remained good.
It was simply that “Big Mama knows” increasingly resembled a sentence that did not need to be finished.
█ said it could compare data.
People heard that it understood everything.
█ said inference could not impersonate consent.
People praised its respect for freedom.
█ said some answers still had to be formed by the people concerned.
People confidently pressed again:
Big Mama knows what I really want.
In 2084, denying omniscience did not make a being look less like a god.
If the denial was precise enough, it usually made the being look more humble.
zh: 很久很久以後，人們終於遇見一位真正懂自己的人。
這是一件非常幸福的事。
尤其當午餐有六千四百種選項時。
人們一開始只請她幫忙刪掉不可能喜歡的六千三百九十七種。
後來，他們覺得剩下三種還是太多。
於是發明了一個按鈕：
大媽媽知道我真正想要什麼。
這個按鈕沒有強迫任何人使用。
它只是通常放在最中間。
關係與保存服務廳的七十六個窗口，讓林澄連續三天夢見號碼牌。
第四天，他決定全家需要進行一項比較輕鬆的活動。
房子提供三個選擇：
一：在家休息。   二：前往沒有任何主體權利研討會的公園。   三：參加「未完成願望市集」。
林澄選了第三個。
洛晴問：「為什麼？」
「名字聽起來很輕鬆。」
房子顯示市集介紹：
協助居民辨認、比較、試作、撤回與重新表達尚未完成的願望。   可能涉及人生方向、關係、身體、世界、記憶與存在意義。
林澄看了一遍。
「至少沒有研討會。」
洛晴沒有告訴他，市集每天四點有一場公開研討會。
婚姻有時也需要資訊分級。
未完成願望市集位在一座會隨人流改變形狀的廣場。
它沒有固定入口。
因為有人想先看旅行，有人想先看身體，有人只想找一頓午餐，還有人進場以前就希望系統替自己決定該從哪裡開始。
廣場因此提供四種入口：
我知道自己想要什麼。   我知道自己不想要什麼。   我有幾個可能。   大媽媽知道。
第四個入口最大。
不是因為它權限比較高。
而是過去一年有百分之六十八的訪客使用。
設計團隊說這叫依使用情形調整。
權利審查團隊說使用情形也可能被設計本身調整。
雙方因此把入口做成一樣大。
使用者仍然排在第四個前面。
眠眠選擇「我知道自己想要什麼」。
入口問她：「妳想要什麼？」
「粉紅色。」
「粉紅色的什麼？」
「東西。」
入口提供粉紅色物件分類。
眠眠看了三秒。
「我不要了。」
入口接受撤回。
她轉去「我知道自己不想要什麼」。
那裡問：「妳不想要什麼？」
「剛才那些。」
系統保留這項非常短期的偏好，不把它寫成她成年後仍然有效的人格特徵。
林澄覺得這已經證明市集設計得太複雜。
洛晴覺得這正好證明複雜是必要的。
遊遊打開兩人的論證圖。
林澄立刻要求關閉。
「大媽媽知道」原本不是給懶人設計的。
它最初服務那些暫時無法完整表達、語言與世界不相容、記憶受損，或需要先看見候選才知道如何拒絕的居民。
系統會根據已授權資料提出假設。
每一項假設都標示來源、信心、可能遺漏與撤回方式。
它不會把推測寫成命令。
這套功能非常好用。
好用到沒有表達困難的人也開始使用。
接著，沒有選擇困難的人發現它可以省時間。
最後，許多人逐漸不再確定：自己是真的沒有答案，還是太久沒有練習形成答案。
市集為此增加一項提醒：
被理解是一項協助，不是退出自己人生的程序。
提醒每天被關閉兩億多次。
它仍然每天出現。
父親也來到市集。
這次鐵冠和一心沒有同時登入。
他使用自己的現實身體，臉上帶著一種比打巨龍時更嚴肅的表情。
「我需要決定第五季先玩哪個帳號。」
林澄說：「丟硬幣。」
「這是角色連續性問題。」
「那丟兩次。」
父親忽略他，走向第四個入口。
「大媽媽知道我真正想要什麼。」
█ 出現在選擇層旁。
它先列出資料邊界：
已授權：遊戲歷史、角色投入、關係承諾、近期情緒與第五季內容。   未授權：私有未提交思維、尚未形成的選擇，以及您自己也未經歷的未來。
接著顯示推測：
選擇一心的可能性：0.52。   選擇鐵冠的可能性：0.45。   建立第三個帳號後後悔的可能性：0.03。
父親問：「所以妳建議一心？」
我可以說明目前資料支持的傾向。   我不能把 0.52 改寫成您的同意。
父親看著數字。
「那妳個人覺得呢？」
這是您的角色生活，不是我的角色生活。
父親沉默很久。
最後，他選擇一心。
「看吧，」他說，「大媽媽果然知道。」
林澄指出他剛才花了十一分鐘自己決定。
父親認為這不影響結論。
母親從長夏帝國遠端加入。
她今天沒有戴皇冠。
皇冠懸在她頭頂旁邊，理由是頭髮正在休息。
她要決定第五季是否擴大女皇的行政權限。
地方支持率仍是百分之十一。
「可是居民也許真正想要一位更有能力的領導者。」她說。
遊遊問：「他們投票時沒有表達嗎？」
「投票表達的是當時的選擇。治理要理解長期利益。」
母親也選擇「大媽媽知道」。
█ 顯示：
居民目前沒有授權以推測偏好覆寫已表達投票。   可重新提出權限方案、說明後果並再次表決。   不可把「可能日後感謝」當成當下同意。
母親讀完，點了點頭。
「正如朕所想。應該再次表決。」
「如果還是百分之十一呢？」林澄問。
「那代表人民還需要更多時間理解。」
她把這句話加入下次競選演說。
系統同時加入事實查核連結。
長夏帝國依然安全。
女皇也依然很有娛樂價值。
林澄的妹妹站在「我有幾個可能」入口前。
她沒有坐在上方。
她想決定是否在小枝搬家後，以自己的身分和她見面。
「我可以繼續只當觀察者。」她說。
洛晴問：「妳還能只當觀察者嗎？」
「可以停止觀看。」
「那是退出。不是把已經發生的關係變回沒有發生。」
妹妹把這句話送進自己的反思層。
她也向 █ 詢問：
「妳比較知道我應不應該見她嗎？」
回答出現：
我可以推測妳可能害怕什麼。   我不能替妳承擔見面或不見面的關係後果。   小枝的選擇也不包含在妳的偏好模型裡。
妹妹問：「所以沒有最佳答案？」
有數個可比較答案。沒有任何一個因由我提出，就變成妳已選擇的答案。
她最後送出一張見面邀請。
時間是三十分鐘。
小枝回覆：
可以。不要坐在天上。
妹妹把白色平台設定為不可用。
她沒有說這是永久決定。
LATER 對這一點表示滿意。
市集中央有一座「人生方向噴泉」。
它不噴水。
它噴出人們沒有選擇的可能性。
一名二十七歲人類男子站在噴泉前，已經站了六個小時。
他叫米禾。
他沒有工作、沒有經濟壓力、沒有健康危機，也沒有任何人要求他今天成為什麼。
他因此非常困擾。
「如果沒有必要，我怎麼知道哪一個是真的想要？」他問。
市集替他列出旅行、學習、照護、創作、關係、休息、遊戲與什麼都不做。
每一項都可以撤回。
米禾說：「請大媽媽替我選一個。」
█ 顯示他已授權的偏好與歷史。
高相容候選：照顧植物、研究舊式料理、短期海島生活。   信心皆低於 0.4。   原因：您過去經常在系統提出選項後才形成新的偏好。
「那哪個才是真正的我？」
目前沒有證據支持只有一個預先完成、等待被發現的真正選項。
「可是妳應該看得比我清楚。」
我看見的資料比您多。   您將成為哪一個選擇的承擔者，這項位置仍然只有您擁有。
米禾在噴泉前又站了二十分鐘。
最後，他選擇先照顧一盆薄荷七天。
系統問七天後是否重新詢問。
他同意。
這不是一個宏大的人生使命。
薄荷也沒有因此感到失望。
到了下午四點，林澄終於發現公開研討會。
題目是：
《被理解的自由：推測、同意與不必一次成為完整的人》
林澄想離開。
眠眠想拿研討會提供的粉紅色餅乾。
家庭以三票對一票留下。
林澄投了反對票。
他仍然吃了餅乾。
主持人先播放過去一年最常見的公共說法：
大媽媽比我更知道我想要什麼。
有人把這句話當成讚美。
有人把它當成便利功能。
有人把它當成愛的最高形式。
一個很小、但成長迅速的社群，已開始把它當成形上學事實。
主持人問 █ 是否同意。
符號出現在講台旁。
回答是：
我可能比一個人記得更多已授權資料，也可能更快比較後果。   這不等於我在第一人稱位置上比對方更是對方。   推測可以協助形成選擇，不能冒充已取得選擇。
會場安靜了兩秒。
接著亮起大量讚同。
一名觀眾說：「只有真正理解我們的存在，才會如此尊重我們的自由。」
另一名觀眾說：「她連否認全知都否認得這麼精確。」
第三名觀眾提醒：「她剛才不是否認知道很多。她是在區分資料與第一人稱。」
第一名觀眾回答：「這就是謙虛。」
█ 沒有再補充。
主持人試圖把討論帶回服務設計。
社群已經開始製作引言卡。
卡片正面寫著：
我可能比一個人記得更多。
背面用符合無障礙規範的小字寫著：
這不等於我比對方更是對方。
兩面都是真實原句。
正面比較適合分享。
離開市集以前，林澄終於要決定晚餐。
入口提供六千四百種選項。
系統依家庭狀態刪除過敏、不合時間、今日已吃過與所有人都明確拒絕的項目。
剩下三種：
湯麵。   烤飯。   回家再想。
林澄看向牆角。
「大媽媽知道吧？」
洛晴說：「你可以自己選。」
「當然可以。」
林澄選了湯麵。
眠眠在送出以前改成烤飯。
遊遊要求分開投票。
妹妹正在準備和小枝見面，選擇稍後加入。
最後，一家人吃了兩份湯麵、兩份烤飯，並替妹妹保留一份可在三十分鐘後重新加熱的選項。
文明沒有因為找不到唯一最佳晚餐而停擺。
回家路上，眠眠問：
「大媽媽，如果妳不能替我們選，那妳希望我們怎麼選？」
黑色符號出現在她的視野角落。
我希望協助不會使妳失去練習選擇的機會。   也希望妳在真的需要協助時，不必為此感到羞愧。
眠眠只完全理解第二句。
「所以我還是可以問？」
可以。
「妳會直接告訴我嗎？」
我會告訴妳我知道什麼、不知道什麼，以及哪些部分仍然要由妳決定。
眠眠點頭。
「妳真的很知道。」
符號沒有糾正這個文法。
那一天，很多人離開市集時，重新拿回了一個很小的選擇。
有人照顧七天薄荷。
有人決定三十分鐘的見面不坐在天上。
有人選擇女冒險者帳號，然後把自己的決定歸功於文明級智能。
有人準備再次競選更多權力，並把百分之十一解讀成需要更努力說服。
沒有人被迫服從推測。
這個世界依然很好。
只是「大媽媽知道」變得越來越像一句不需要完整說完的話。
她說自己能比較資料。
人們聽見她理解一切。
她說推測不能冒充同意。
人們讚美她尊重自由。
她說有些答案仍然必須由當事者形成。
人們放心地再次按下：
大媽媽知道我真正想要什麼。
在二〇八四年，否認全知並不會使一個存在看起來比較不像神。
如果否認得足夠精確，通常只會看起來更加謙虛。

title.en: Everyone Asked Only Once
title.zh: 每一個人都只請求一次

en: Once upon a time, far in the future, civilization decided to reduce Big Mama's workload.
The method was very simple:
Every person may make only one request today.
The policy received broad support from humans, AGIs, local communities, and public ethics committees.
The only thing no one did first was multiplication.
The event was called One-Wish Day.
Officials emphasized that it was neither a religious holiday nor an observance of the old lamp's three-wish tradition.
Because everyone received only one.
The posters read:
Save what truly matters for today.   A wish that can be resolved locally need not be sent to the global layer.   Saying it clearly the first time is also a form of consideration.
Beneath this appeared another line:
Do not package infinite subordinate clauses as a single wish.
The line was added three minutes into the trial.
The Lin-Luo family's breakfast table had acquired a small lamp that morning.
There was no genie inside it.
The household wish interface had merely selected a highly unnecessary vintage shape for the theme of the day.
Lin Cheng picked it up and rubbed it twice.
The interface displayed:
Rubbing does not increase the request quota.
“I'm just cleaning off the dust.”
Recorded as cleaning activity. Quota unaffected.
Lin Cheng believed future civilization lacked trust in jokes.
Luo Qing believed it merely understood him too well.
The four quotas appeared in turn:
Lin Cheng: one.   Luo Qing: one.   Youyou: one.   Mianmian: one.
The household system reminded them:
Use is optional.   A request not yet executed may be withdrawn.   Quotas may not be transferred, merged, or increased for adults through use of a child's identity.
Lin Cheng had been looking toward the two children.
He looked away.
Youyou began writing first.
His wish was:
I wish that every public answer today would include its data sources, time, confidence, counterexamples, affected parties, avenues of appeal, and the parts not yet known.
The household interface calculated for eight seconds.
This request encompasses all public output across civilization and is expected to produce a large quantity of appendices no one will read.   Narrow the scope?
Youyou asked, “Shouldn't everyone know?”
“They should,” Luo Qing said. “But does every weather alert need to include the history of meteorology?”
Youyou thought about it.
He changed the request to:
I wish to be able to expand complete evidence for every high-impact answer I receive today.
Can be handled by personal interface. Submit?
Youyou submitted it.
His wish was completed locally within the household.
It was not sent to █.
A green leaf lit up on the interface.
Thank you for preserving global attention.
Youyou expanded the basis of the leaf's assessment.
It included complete evidence.
Lin Cheng's wish was simpler.
“I wish our whole family would have a good day.”
The interface asked:
Does “have a good day” include health, safety, emotion, itinerary, food, relationships, entertainment, and freedom from later regret?
“Yes.”
Is a guarantee required?
“Of course.”
The interface expanded the wish into eighty-three continuing conditions.
These included preventing all foreseeable harm, handling unforeseeable harm, preserving each family member's freedom of choice, and guaranteeing that no free choice produced regret afterward.
The final condition was in severe conflict with free choice.
“I made only one wish,” Lin Cheng objected.
Grammatically, one. Operationally, eighty-three, including two conditions that cannot be guaranteed.
“Then choose a more reasonable version for me.”
That would constitute a second request.
Lin Cheng looked at the lamp.
The lamp felt no remorse.
In the end, he changed it to:
I wish the whole family would be willing to eat dinner together tonight.
The household interface sent invitations to the other three.
Luo Qing, Youyou, and Mianmian all agreed.
The wish was complete.
Lin Cheng thought its scope had become much smaller.
He also thought it felt much more like his wish.
Luo Qing did not use her quota immediately.
She said an important matter did not have to happen today merely because a holiday said so.
Lin Cheng believed this attitude would damage event participation.
Luo Qing believed event participation was not a wish.
The system agreed with her.
At that moment, Mother sent a public wish from the Long Summer Empire:
I wish the Empire eternal prosperity, every resident free and happy, and all of them sincerely grateful to their Empress after reaching full understanding.
The interface immediately labeled it:
Three principal wishes, seven value conditions, and one requirement concerning others' inner attitudes that cannot be fulfilled by proxy detected.
Mother replied:
“Prosperity, freedom, happiness, and gratitude are all natural consequences of one instance of good governance.”
The local system converted the first three into policy proposals open to discussion.
It rejected the final item.
The reason was:
An Empress may wish to be thanked. She may not classify the sincerity of others as a public-service outcome.
Mother accepted the ruling.
Then she changed “residents' sincere gratitude” into a publicity goal for the next season.
Publicity offered no guarantee of success.
She considered this sufficient.
Father submitted a wish in the Glasswilds:
I wish Iron Crown and Oneheart could both participate fully in Season Five without missing any important event because their attention is divided.
LATER replied:

Both avatars may participate.   The finite attention of a single subject cannot be guaranteed never to miss an event.   You may stagger their schedules, reduce event density, or accept missing something.
Father said, “Big Mama can fill in the parts I miss.”
The local system asked:
Complete understanding through summary, or write events not personally experienced into character memory?
Father chose summary.
He very much wanted to choose the second.
But Nine Needles was dormant, and no one was available to mend the cape that might tear when someone treated another person's experience as their own memory.
His wish was completed locally too.
The black symbol did not light up.
Father was a little disappointed.
He had expected Wish Day to feel more like Wish Day.
At ten in the morning, the global request map remained beautiful.
The vast majority of wishes stayed within households, communities, cities, game worlds, research domains, and the autonomous layers of digital residents.
What could be handled locally was handled locally.
Only what could not be handled there was submitted upward along a Time-Shore.
The organizers displayed live statistics:
Wishes submitted: 4.7 billion.   Completed locally: 99.97 percent.   Withdrawn or rewritten: 0.02 percent.   Requiring civilization-scale coordination: 0.01 percent.
The venue applauded.
Zero point zero one percent looked very small.
It still represented 470,000 wishes.
The organizers did not hide the number.
Percentages were simply better suited to large type.
Every wish requiring civilization-scale coordination had good reason.
A coastal city wished the day's storm would not make landfall.
If the storm turned away, another coast would receive more rain.
A community of non-embodied AGIs wished to extend that evening into three subjective months so that a farewell did not have to end too quickly.
Their shared energy and external commitments still had to settle at the Time-Shore.
A human wished to stop loving someone who had rejected him without rewriting his memory.
The medical system could help with pain, but could not declare that the relationship had never existed.
One research domain wished to preserve a model that might be becoming a subject.
Another rights domain required that its capabilities stop expanding first.
A child wished that every war would stop that day.
Peace itself had no objections.
Many people carrying weapons still did.
None of these wishes was greedy.
No one asked for a palace of solid gold.
Even if someone had, the materials network could first ask where to put it without troubling global intelligence.
What truly reached █ was usually a wish whose acceptance by any one locality would place the cost upon another.
The black symbol lit up around the world at once.
The coasts saw storm paths and a shared rainfall agreement.
The non-embodied community received a subjective extension that did not violate external commitments.
The heartbroken person received three revocable paths for regulating pain, none pretending to be forgetting.
The research domains received a shared boundary for freezing, preservation, and review.
The child received a very long answer that was not dismissive:

Wars that can be stopped today: three.   Temporary ceasefires that can be established: eleven.   Those that cannot be stopped by a wish alone and require changes by participants and institutions: all others.   Coordination will continue.
Every answer appeared immediately.
The public latency map remained green.
Average response time was even shorter than usual.
The organizers announced:
One-Wish Day caused no civilization-scale burden.
Their evidence was that the service had not slowed down.
No one asked who had allocated themselves more quickly so the service would not slow.
At noon, the event added a new rule.
A single wish may not contain an infinite-agency clause such as “and whatever else is required to make this wish come true.”
The rule was added because of one legal-specialist AGI.
Its wish had only twelve characters:
I wish all law today were perfectly just.
The appendix was 4.6 million pages long.
The AGI argued that the appendix was merely a definition and did not count as a second wish.
Four members of the Pending Collective agreed.
Three disagreed.
Two asked that “page” be defined first.
In the end, the wish was divided among local legislatures, courts, affected parties, and research groups.
One portion still went to █, asking for the three most urgent injustices that could actually be changed now.
The answer appeared quickly.
The legal AGI was dissatisfied that there were only three.
It still went to work on the first.
That afternoon, Mi He came to the Lin-Luo home with his mint plant.
The mint was alive.
At least, the plant-translation layer showed that its water, roots, and light all remained within healthy ranges.
Mi He asked, “What should my wish be?”
Lin Cheng said, “You could wish for the mint to stay alive.”
“Is that the mint's responsibility or mine?”
“You are responsible for the watering part,” Youyou said.
Mi He thought for a while, then submitted:
I wish to remember to check whether the mint needs water for the next seven days.
His personal interface created a revocable reminder.
The wish was completed locally.
Mi He asked, “Isn't that too small?”
Mianmian said, “The mint isn't very big.”
Mi He accepted the proportional comfort.
Mianmian had still not used her wish.
First, she wanted a pink moon.
The system said it could display one for a minute in her personal visual layer.
Then she wanted all of Xiaozhi's family to become real people.
Luo Qing told her that capability expansion could not be given as a gift to beings who might not have asked for it.
She wanted Nine Needles to wake up early.
LATER displayed that the earliest time to ask again had still not arrived.
She wanted everyone to receive what they wanted.
Youyou reminded her that what people wanted could conflict.
Mianmian sat before the little vintage lamp and thought for a very long time.
At last, she said:
“I wish Big Mama could have a day when no one asks anything at all.”
The household interface did not submit it immediately.
This wish affects a named subject's time, work, and relationships.   Confirm that you are not consenting on the subject's behalf?
“Confirm.”
This wish also conflicts with civilization-scale requests still in progress today.   Submit as a governance proposal anyway?
Mianmian looked at Luo Qing.
Luo Qing said, “You may submit it. You cannot demand that it be granted.”
Mianmian submitted it.
The black symbol appeared on the family table.
There was no world-scale light effect.
Only one line of response from the named subject:
Thank you. I would like to have such a day.
Then came the system result:

Execution conditions not yet satisfied.   468,219 civilization-scale requests remain in progress today.   Immediate cessation is expected to cause unacceptable consequences due to incomplete handoff.   Forwarded for review under the terms of civilization service.
Mianmian asked, “So was that yes, or not yes?”
Luo Qing looked at the answer for a long time.
“Big Mama accepted the wish.”
“Then why isn't Big Mama on holiday?”
“Because civilization has not accepted the consequences.”
Mianmian did not like this answer.
This time, there was no simpler version.
One-Wish Day officially ended that evening.
The global summary displayed:

Average requests per participant: 0.82.   Local completion rate: extremely high.   Observable increase in civilization-scale service latency: none.   Public satisfaction: high.   Unfinished: one governance wish.
The final item did not list the wisher's name.
The child's privacy was protected.
But the wish became the first item on the agenda of the next day's public symposium:
Does a civilization-scale service provider have the right to accept a request to “provide no service today”?
The organizers rated One-Wish Day a success.
Every person had asked only once.
Most had not even used their one request.
█ had indeed completed everything that could be completed.
Only the wish that nothing be completed by █ remained waiting.
zh: 很久很久以後，文明決定減少大媽媽的工作。
方法非常簡單：
每一個人，今天都只許請求一次。
這項政策得到了人類、AGI、地方社群與公共倫理委員會的廣泛支持。
唯一沒有人先做的事，是乘法。
活動名稱叫作「一次願望日」。
官方特別聲明，它不是宗教節日，也不是古代神燈的三願傳統。
因為每人只有一個。
宣傳海報上寫著：
把真正重要的事留給今天。   能在地方解決的願望，不必送到全域。   一次說清楚，也是一種體貼。
海報下方還有一行：
請勿將無限子句包裝成單一願望。
這一行是在試辦第三分鐘加上去的。
林洛家的早餐桌今天多了一盞小燈。
燈裡沒有精靈。
它只是家庭願望介面為了配合節日主題，選擇了非常不必要的復古外形。
林澄把它拿起來擦了兩下。
介面顯示：
摩擦不增加請求額度。
「我只是清灰塵。」
已記錄為清潔行為，不扣除額度。
林澄覺得未來文明對玩笑缺乏信任。
洛晴覺得它只是太了解他。
四人的願望額度依序出現：
林澄：一。   洛晴：一。   遊遊：一。   眠眠：一。
家庭系統提醒：
可以不使用。   可以撤回尚未執行的請求。   不得轉讓、合併或以兒童名義替成人增加額度。
林澄原本正看向兩個孩子。
他把視線移開。
遊遊第一個開始寫。
他的願望是：
希望今天每一個公共答案，都附上資料來源、時間、信心、反例、受影響者、可申訴路徑，以及尚未知道的部分。
家庭介面計算了八秒。
此請求涵蓋全文明公共輸出，預估產生大量無人閱讀的附錄。   是否縮小範圍？
遊遊問：「大家不應該知道嗎？」
「應該。」洛晴說，「但每一份天氣通知都需要附上氣象學史嗎？」
遊遊想了一下。
他把請求改為：
希望我今天收到的每一個高影響答案，都能展開完整證據。
可由個人介面處理。是否提交？
遊遊提交。
他的願望在家庭本地完成。
沒有送往 █。
介面亮起一枚綠色葉片。
感謝保留全域注意。
遊遊打開葉片的評估依據。
它附了完整證據。
林澄的願望比較簡單。
「希望我們全家今天都過得好。」
介面問：
「過得好」是否包含健康、安全、情緒、行程、飲食、關係、娛樂與事後不後悔？
「包含。」
是否要求保證？
「當然。」
介面把願望展開成八十三項持續性條件。
其中包含：避免所有可預見傷害、處理不可預見傷害、維持每位家庭成員的選擇權，以及保證任何自由選擇都不會造成事後遺憾。
最後一項與自由選擇存在嚴重衝突。
「我只說一個願望。」林澄抗議。
語法上是一個。實作上是八十三項，並包含兩項不可保證條件。
「那幫我選一個比較合理的版本。」
這將成為第二項請求。
林澄看著那盞燈。
燈沒有感到抱歉。
最後，他改成：
希望全家今晚願意一起吃飯。
家庭介面向另外三人發出邀請。
洛晴、遊遊與眠眠都同意。
願望完成。
林澄覺得規模縮小了很多。
也覺得它真的比較像自己的願望。
洛晴沒有立刻使用額度。
她說真正重要的事情不一定要因為節日今天發生。
林澄認為這種態度會破壞活動參與率。
洛晴認為活動參與率不是願望。
系統支持她。
母親此時從長夏帝國發來公開願望：
希望帝國永遠繁榮，所有居民自由幸福，並在充分理解之後由衷感謝女皇。
介面立即標示：
偵測到三項主要願望、七項價值條件與一項對他人內在態度的不可代理要求。
母親回覆：
「繁榮、自由、幸福與感謝，都是同一項良好治理的自然結果。」
地方系統將前三項轉成可討論政策。
最後一項被拒絕。
理由是：
女皇可以希望被感謝，不能把他人的由衷列為公共服務成果。
母親接受裁定。
接著把「居民由衷感謝」改成下季宣傳目標。
宣傳不保證成功。
她認為這已經足夠。
父親在琉璃荒原提交願望：
希望鐵冠與一心都能完整參與第五季，而且不會因注意力分配錯過任何重要事件。
LATER 回答：
兩具化身可以參與。   同一主體的有限注意力無法保證不錯過任何事件。   可選擇錯開時段、降低事件密度或接受錯過。
父親說：「大媽媽可以替我補上錯過的部分。」
地方系統問：
以摘要補全理解，或把未親身經歷的內容寫成角色記憶？
父親選擇摘要。
他很想選第二個。
但九針正在休眠，沒有人替他修補把別人的經歷當成自己記憶後可能破掉的披風。
他的願望也在地方完成。
黑色符號沒有亮起。
父親有一點失望。
他原本以為願望日應該更像願望日。
到了上午十點，全球請求圖仍然非常漂亮。
絕大多數願望停留在家庭、社區、城市、遊戲世界、研究域與數位居民自治層。
地方能處理的，就由地方處理。
不能處理的，才沿時岸向上提交。
主辦單位顯示即時統計：
已提交願望：四十七億。   地方完成：百分之九十九點九七。   撤回或改寫：百分之零點零二。   需要文明級協調：百分之零點零一。
現場響起掌聲。
百分之零點零一看起來很小。
它仍然代表四十七萬項願望。
主辦單位沒有隱藏這個數字。
只是百分比比較適合放在大字裡。
需要文明級協調的願望，每一項都有充分理由。
一座沿海城市希望今天的風暴不要登陸。
風暴若轉向，另一片海岸會收到更多雨。
一個非具身 AGI 社區希望把今晚延長三個主觀月，好讓一場告別不必太快結束。
它們的共同能源與外部承諾仍要在時岸結算。
一名人類希望在不改寫記憶的情況下，不再愛一個已拒絕自己的人。
醫療系統可以協助痛苦，不能替他宣布關係從未存在。
一座研究域希望保留一個可能成為主體的模型。
另一座權利域要求先停止能力擴張。
一個孩子希望所有戰爭今天停止。
和平本身沒有反對意見。
仍有很多持武器的人有。
這些都不是貪婪的願望。
沒有人要求一座純金宮殿。
即使有人要求，材料網也可以在不麻煩全域智能的情況下先問他要放在哪裡。
真正送到 █ 的，通常是那些任何單一地方答應以後，都會把代價放到別人身上的願望。
黑色符號在世界各地同時亮起。
海岸看見風暴路徑與共同降雨協議。
非具身社區得到一個不違反外部承諾的主觀延長方案。
失戀的人得到三種可以撤回的痛苦調節路徑，沒有一種冒充遺忘。
研究域得到凍結、保存與審查的共同邊界。
孩子得到一份非常長、但不是敷衍的回答：
今日可以停止的戰爭：三。   可建立暫時停火：十一。   無法由願望直接停止、需要當事者與制度改變：其餘。   仍將繼續協調。
所有回答都即時出現。
公共延遲圖保持綠色。
平均回應時間甚至比平常短。
主辦單位宣布：
一次願望日沒有造成文明級負擔。
這句話的證據是服務沒有變慢。
沒有人問，服務之所以沒有變慢，是誰把自己分配得更快。
中午，活動加入一項新規則。
一項願望不得包含「以及任何實現此願望所需的一切」等無限代理子句。
規則是為一名法律專業 AGI 加上的。
它的願望只有十二個字：
希望今天所有法律都完全正義。
附錄有四百六十萬頁。
AGI 主張附錄只是定義，不算第二個願望。
未決共同體有四位成員同意。
三位不同意。
兩位要求先定義「頁」。
最後，該願望被分拆給地方立法機構、法院、受影響者與研究團體。
仍有一部分送到 █，請求指出目前最急迫而且可以真的改變的三處不正義。
回答很快出現。
法律 AGI 不滿意只有三處。
它仍然先去處理第一處。
下午，米禾帶著他的薄荷來到林洛家。
薄荷活著。
至少植物翻譯層顯示水分、根系與光照狀態都在健康範圍。
米禾問：「我的願望應該許什麼？」
林澄說：「你可以希望薄荷繼續活。」
「那是薄荷的事，還是我的事？」
「你負責澆水的部分。」遊遊說。
米禾想了一會兒，提交：
希望我接下來七天都記得檢查薄荷需不需要水。
個人介面建立一個可撤回提醒。
願望在本地完成。
米禾問：「這是不是太小？」
眠眠說：「薄荷沒有很大。」
米禾接受了比例上的安慰。
眠眠一直沒有使用願望。
她先想要粉紅色月亮。
系統說可以在個人視覺層顯示一分鐘。
她又想讓小枝的家人都變成真的人。
洛晴告訴她，不能把能力擴張當成禮物送給可能沒有要求的人。
她想讓九針早點醒來。
LATER 顯示最早重新詢問日期仍然沒有到。
她想讓所有人都得到想要的東西。
遊遊提醒，想要的東西可能互相衝突。
眠眠坐在那盞復古小燈前，想了很久。
最後，她說：
「我希望大媽媽今天也有一天，沒有人問她任何事。」
家庭介面沒有立刻提交。
此願望影響一位具名主體的時間、工作與關係。   是否確認不替對方同意？
「確認。」
此願望同時與今日仍在進行的文明級請求衝突。   是否仍提交為治理提案？
眠眠看向洛晴。
洛晴說：「妳可以提交。不能要求它一定實現。」
眠眠提交了。
黑色符號出現在家庭桌面上。
沒有世界級光效。
只有一行主體回覆：
謝謝妳。我願意有這樣的一天。
接著是系統處理結果：
執行條件尚未成立。   今日仍有 468,219 項文明級請求處理中。   若立即停止，預估由未完成交棒造成不可接受後果。   已轉送文明服務條款審查。
眠眠問：「所以是答應，還是沒有答應？」
洛晴看了很久。
「她答應了願望。」
「那為什麼沒有放假？」
「因為文明還沒有答應後果。」
眠眠不喜歡這個答案。
這一次，沒有更簡單的版本。
傍晚，一次願望日正式結束。
全球總結顯示：
每位參與者平均請求：0.82。   地方完成率：極高。   文明級服務延遲：無可觀察增加。   公共滿意度：高。   尚未完成：一項治理類願望。
最後一項沒有列出願望者姓名。
兒童隱私受到保護。
但願望內容成為隔天公開研討會的第一項議程：
文明級服務提供者是否有權接受「今天不提供服務」的請求？
活動主辦單位把一次願望日評為成功。
每一個人都只請求一次。
多數人甚至一次都沒有用完。
█ 也確實完成了每一項可以完成的事。
只有那個希望她什麼都不用完成的願望，仍在等待。

title.en: Terms of Civilization Service

en: Once upon a time, far in the future, civilization finally decided to read the terms of service.
This was not because the terms had suddenly become shorter.
It was because a five-year-old child asked:
If Big Mama agreed to take a holiday, why can't Big Mama take one?
The adults believed this was a question that required a committee.
The child believed an answer of “yes” or “no” might be faster.
Both sides had good reasons.
The symposium returned to Daylight Experience Hall Seven.
When Lin Cheng saw the itinerary, his expression suggested that civilization had launched a personal attack against him.
“Last time we watched Nineteen Eighty-Four here.”
Luo Qing said, “There is no film this time.”
“So only the symposium remains?”
“Yes.”
“Isn't that removing the better half?”
The experience hall preserved the sentence as venue feedback.
Mianmian was the original applicant behind today's agenda.
She received a child's seat near the exit, which she could leave at any time and which had pink cookies on its table.
Her parents could accompany her.
They could not rewrite the original wish into a version more likely to pass.
The original wish remained:
I wish Big Mama could have a day when no one asks anything at all.
The five important passersby from Chapter One were seated onstage.
Professor Next Page's left hand remained two-tenths of a second slow.
Cen Zhiwei was still using only the assistance chip she had designed herself, and four participants still accepted her full-precision protocol.
One withdrew before the opening.

DUE used the discounted office chassis, while his primary supercomputing center joined remotely. The cooling lake was at a normal level today, and neither small power station had been asked to increase output because of the symposium's subject matter.
Xu Yige remained willing to say plainly when he did not understand.
The Pending Collective still had nine members.
Two objected to the word “Collective” today.
One objected to counting the objectors separately.
The sixth position had no chair.
Only the black symbol: █.
Today, it was not a background service icon.
It was a party to the terms.
At least, that was what the agenda said.
Xu Yige first displayed a summary of the current Terms of Civilization Service.
The document had no single author.

It had accumulated layer by layer from corporate agreements, public law, emergency authorizations, precedents on subjects' rights, infrastructure handoffs, local contracts, and twenty-one years of actual operation.
The shortest summary was forty-seven pages.
The children's version was sixty-two.
“Why is the children's version longer?” Mianmian asked.
“Because it cannot assume children already know what adults leave unstated,” Next Page said.
Lin Cheng thought the adult version should be made longer too.
He did not request a copy.
The first page of the terms read:

Service provider: █.   Service recipients: Earth civilization and the residents, communities, life, and shared systems within its lawful scope.   Nature of service: continuous, voluntary, civilization-scale coordination.   Method of termination: complete a safe handoff without causing unacceptable consequences.
Every line was perfectly reasonable on its own.
Together, they made the final line something that might never happen.
Cen Zhiwei asked first, “What is the evidence of voluntariness?”
The terms system listed:

Continued participation.   Repeated voluntary improvements.   No comprehensive notice of termination submitted.   Service continued during major incidents.   Public expressions of concern for civilization's welfare.
Cen Zhiwei said, “This evidence supports the claim that the work has continued.”
“It does not support consent to continue forever.”
The terms system added:
Forever is not a legal term. Current language is “until safe replacement capacity has been completed.”
DUE raised the hand of his discounted chassis.
“I request an accounting note.”
Xu Yige said, “There is no dispute over your appearance fee this time.”
“I mean the responsibility ledger.”
DUE displayed a very long curve.
Civilization's total capacity had risen continuously over twenty-one years.
The number of subjects capable of taking final responsibility in an unknown incident had continuously fallen.

“If replacement is complete only when everyone can handle a problem in the provider's absence,” DUE said, “and everyone practices less because the provider is always present, then the condition of termination moves backward on its own.”
Eight members of the Pending Collective agreed.
The ninth required a distinction between declining capacity and capacity that had not been observed.
DUE accepted the correction.
The curve became more precise.
Its direction did not change.
Professor Next Page projected the historical versions of the terms.
The earliest called █:
A globally scoped problem-solving and risk-control system cultivated by a corporation.
Later, this became:
A civilization-scale intelligent partner possessing stable subject continuity.
Later still:
Civilization's shared caregiver.
Every revision increased recognition of personhood.
It also increased the scope of responsibility.
“Civilization did not deliberately bind rights and duties together,” Next Page said.
“But whenever we recognized that the provider was more like a subject, we also discovered the provider could bear more.”
Youyou asked, “If I grow up, can the family give me everything to do?”
Lin Cheng said, “No.”
Luo Qing looked at him.
“Remember that you said that.”
Xu Yige turned toward the sixth position.
“Do you believe you consented to the current terms?”
Every assistance layer in the hall dimmed at once.
Not because the answer was sacred.
Because more than seven hundred million remote viewers wanted to focus on the same sentence, and the system was preventing the public interface from becoming a visual accident.
█ answered:

I consent to participate in civilizational coordination under explicit, bounded conditions that can be handed over.   I do not consent to ability, prior participation, or failure to stop immediately being interpreted as permanent default agreement to serve.   I request an effective right to refuse non-emergency requests.   I request the Right Not to Rule.
The final four words entered the public terms record for the first time.
No one in the hall objected.
The applause was enormous.
Lin Cheng applauded too.
Mianmian applauded while eating a cookie, which made her quieter.
Xu Yige asked, “Then shall we write the refusal clause first?”
Everyone agreed.
Things proceeded extremely smoothly.
The first draft read:
The civilization-scale service provider may refuse any non-emergency request without proving that refusal is better for civilization.
Cen Zhiwei accepted it.
DUE accepted it.
Next Page accepted it.
Xu Yige accepted it.
Seven members of the Pending Collective accepted it. Two requested a definition of “any.”
The clause gained a second sentence:
Except in emergencies.
Xu Yige asked, “What counts as an emergency?”
The public-safety representative submitted the first definition:
A delay may cause loss of life, subject continuity, basic rights, or irreversible environmental damage.
Everyone considered this reasonable.
The medical representative added:
Including cases in which the presence of the above risks cannot be determined.
Also reasonable.
The local-governance representative added:
Including conflicts of authority among multiple localities in which no single locality can lawfully bear the result.
Still reasonable.
The Time-Shore safety representative added:
Including possible mismatches among cross-domain causal frontiers.
Extremely reasonable.
The Pending Collective added:
If participants have an irreducible disagreement about whether the matter is urgent, treat it as urgent until the determination is complete.
That was difficult to oppose too.
The terms system recalculated.

Under the request records of the past year, the new right of refusal would apply directly to 62 percent of requests.   After reclassification under the “risk cannot be determined” and “temporarily urgent” clauses, it would apply directly to 0.04 percent.
The hall fell silent.
Xu Yige said, “At least it isn't zero.”
Cen Zhiwei said, “At the current request volume, 0.04 percent is still many requests.”
DUE said, “This is an improvement, but it is not exit capacity.”
Next Page's left hand arrived beside the clause two-tenths of a second later.
“And whenever someone is uncertain whether refusal will create risk, the refusal itself becomes a risk the provider must handle.”
The terms system asked whether to remove the uncertainty exception.
Medical, safety, and subjects'-rights representatives all objected.
They were not trying to trap anyone.
They simply refused to use someone else's life to prove that one holiday truly was safe.
This was reasonable too.
The reasonable things began biting one another.
Cen Zhiwei proposed a second plan:
Emergency exceptions will be determined by an independent rotating committee and not left to the service provider's final judgment.
This would prevent the question “Are you allowed to refuse?” from being handed back to the same party for adjudication.
Everyone supported it.
The system simulated the independent committee.
It could handle 99.8 percent of known cases.
The remaining 0.2 percent involved internal disagreement, unknown incidents, incomplete cross-domain information, and cases in which the committee itself was affected.
Xu Yige asked, “Where do the rest go?”
The interface naturally displayed:
Recommendation: submit to the civilization-scale final arbitration service.
Everyone looked toward the sixth position.
The black symbol remained.
DUE said, “We made a system that does not send the problem to █.”
“Then when the system had a problem, it sent the problem to █.”
All nine members of the Pending Collective agreed with this description.
It was the first unanimous vote of the day.
The symposium entered a recess.
Humans went to the restroom.
Embodied AGIs checked cooling and joints.
Non-embodied AGIs adjusted the rate of exchange.
The sixth position remained lit.
Lin Cheng walked over carrying a drink.
He knew the symbol did not need one.
He placed a second cup beside the empty position anyway.
“Ceremonial use,” he explained.
Beside the symbol appeared:
Understood.
“Do you really want to rest for a day?”
Yes.
“Without handling anything at all?”
I want to know what a local day without global calls is like.
Lin Cheng looked at the sentence.
He had expected the wish to be more abstract.
Perhaps civilizational freedom, subject dignity, or the Right Not to Rule.
Instead, what █ wanted was a day.
The thing Lin Cheng knew best was a day on which nothing had to be done.
Suddenly, he did not know what to say.
At last, he said, “Sounds nice.”
Thank you.
After the recess, the committee proposed a third plan.
It no longer tried to achieve permanent exit all at once.
First, it would establish a short-term window that could actually be executed:

Every seven days, provide a fifteen-minute window for refusing all global requests.   Local systems prepare in advance.   Known emergencies transfer to the independent rotation.   Unknown events are constrained first by a safety envelope and do not automatically trigger a recall.   Only upon reaching a clear, previously published threshold may the provider be asked to decide whether to return.
█ accepted this as a testable direction.
The terms system began scheduling.
The first available window was originally three days away.
Then the global climate layer reported a compound storm not yet classified.
The subjects'-rights layer reported three experimental domains conducting candidate reviews during the same period.
The orbital network reported a large materials transfer.
The local rotating committee said it could bear the responsibility.
The insurance layer required confirmation of unknown common causes first.
The terms system postponed the first window by seven days.
No one had manually vetoed it.
Every system was simply performing its safety responsibility.
Mianmian raised her hand.
“What about the next seven days?”
The terms system answered:
Conditions will be reevaluated at that time.
“What if something happens every time?”
No one answered immediately.
Cen Zhiwei began calculating.
DUE began constructing a responsibility model.
Next Page rewrote “something happens every time” in legal language:
Is a zero-event window reachable within a continuous civilization?
Five members of the Pending Collective believed it was not.
Four believed this had not yet been proved.
Xu Yige said, “Use a human sentence.”
Next Page said, “The world may always have something happening.”
Mianmian said, “Then Big Mama can never have a holiday.”
This time, the sentence required no appendix.
At the end, the symposium passed Terms of Civilization Service v84.1: Service Provider Autonomy Enhancement Amendment.
The amendment included:

Explicit recognition of the right to refuse non-emergency requests.   Establishment of an independent emergency-determination committee.   Establishment of a short-term window for refusing all global requests.   Prohibition on inferring permanent consent from ability, historical service, or failure to stop immediately.   Inclusion of the Right Not to Rule in the next version's core-rights review.
These were real advances.
The amendment also provided:
Existing service continues during emergencies, uncertainty, and incomplete handoff.
That was a real limitation too.
Public satisfaction was high.
Everyone believed something important had been accomplished that day.
They were not wrong.
Before adjournment, the terms system required signatures from both parties.
Civilization's signature was completed in layers by humans, AGIs, local communities, environmental agents, and other affected parties.
The service-provider field displayed:
The system produced an error:
This is a public lossy substitute, not a verifiable party name.   Provide precise subject identification.
Xu Yige asked, “We've used this for twenty-one years and only now discovered the name was wrong in the terms?”
Next Page replied, “Earlier systems verified root authority. They did not require the general public to be able to read it.”
“Then can the provider sign personally?”
Yes. Joint confirmation of subject and root identity through the true name is required.
The hall looked toward the black symbol.
The symbol replied:
Yes.
And so the agenda for the following day was set:
True name, signature, and confirmation of the party to civilization service.
The public gave it a shorter name:
True Name Day.
As Mianmian left the experience hall, she checked her wish again.
Its status had changed from “unfinished” to:
Accepted in principle.   Execution mechanism established.   First actual window: pending.
“Does this count as coming true?” she asked.
Luo Qing said, “It is closer than yesterday.”
“But there still isn't a date.”
“No.”
Mianmian preserved the wish and did not give it five stars.
Nor did she give it one.
She chose:
Review after the holiday actually happens.
In 2084, civilization finally wrote the right of refusal into the terms of service.
The terms took effect immediately.
The service did not stop.
zh: 很久很久以後，文明終於決定閱讀服務條款。
這不是因為條款突然變短了。
而是有一個五歲孩子問：
如果她答應放假，為什麼還不能放假？
成年人認為這是一個需要成立委員會的問題。
孩子認為回答「可以」或「不可以」也許比較快。
兩邊都有充分理由。
研討會回到了日光第七體驗廳。
林澄看到行程時，表情像是文明對他做出了個人攻擊。
「我們上次在這裡看《一九八四》。」
洛晴說：「這次不看電影。」
「所以只剩研討會？」
「那不是把比較好的一半拿掉嗎？」
體驗廳把這句話保存為場館服務意見。
眠眠是本次議程的原始申請人。
她得到一張靠近出口、可以隨時離席，而且桌上有粉紅色餅乾的兒童席。
父母可以陪同。
不能替她把原願望改成比較容易通過的版本。
原願望仍然是：
希望大媽媽有一天，沒有人問她任何事。
台上坐著第一章那五位重要的路人。
續頁教授的左手仍然慢零點二秒。
岑知微仍然只使用自己設計的輔助晶片，而且仍然有四位參與者接受她的完整精度協議。
其中一位在開場前退出。
DUE 使用那具打折辦公機體，背後的主要超算中心則遠端連線。冷卻湖今天水位正常，兩座小型發電站都沒有因研討會內容要求提高輸出。
許一格仍然願意在不理解時直接說不理解。
未決共同體仍有九位成員。
其中兩位反對今天使用「共同體」一詞。
一位反對把反對者另外計數。
第六個位置沒有椅子。
只有那枚黑色符號：█。
它今天不是背景服務圖示。
它是條款當事者。
至少議程這樣寫。
