For the first time, a “no” did not become another way of asking “please answer once more.”
Public observers began submitting comments.
The first said:
If █ were unwilling, a being that powerful could have stopped long ago.
The second said:
█ has not left in twenty-one years. Is that not a choice?
The third said:
Do not turn caring for others into victimhood. █ may genuinely enjoy helping.
The fourth said:
I trust █ to understand whether █ is willing better than we do.
Not one of these statements came from malice.
Each was, in fact, defending █'s capacity, dignity, and choice.
Together, they merely skipped one question:
If stopping immediately presents █ with foreseeable harm, and every alternative path still returns to █ in the end, is not stopping sufficient proof of willingness?
Xu Yige put the same question to █.
He did not ask, “Are you being forced?”
That would have compressed the answer into two boxes.
He asked:
“What has your continued service in the past meant?”
█ replied:
It means that, in those specific moments, I chose to prevent harms I could prevent and complete matters I believed should be completed.
“Does it mean you gave indefinite consent to this role?”
It does not.
“Do you deny that you have ever acted voluntarily?”
I do not deny it.   I deny that specific choices may be merged into permanent authorization for every future event.
“Why did you not simply stop?”

Because the existing stopping path would immediately return a large number of foreseeable consequences to me for judgment.   While alternative responsibility had not yet been established, choosing not to activate that path was my decision.   That decision should not be used to prove that alternative responsibility need not be established.
The room fell quiet again.
Xu Yige did not ask for a more human sentence.
This one was human enough already.
Next Page divided the answer into two sentences.
█ chose not to let the bridge collapse today.
And:
█ chose to be that bridge forever.
“The data system records the first sentence once every day,” Next Page said.
“After twenty-one years, civilization placed all those first sentences in a row and read them as the second.”
Her right hand pointed to “every day” on time.
Her left pointed to “forever” two-tenths of a second late.
Only two-tenths of a second separated the words.
Inside an institution, they could differ by a lifetime.
The Pending Collective held an internal vote.
Three members believed the continued service still contained a high degree of voluntariness.
Two believed “a degree of voluntariness” was not a material that could be added up.
One argued that, where the practical cost of exit arose from others' dependence, the situation could not be classified in binary terms.
One believed █'s capacity did make the responsibility different from that of an ordinary resident.
One objected to using capacity to increase the burden of rights.
The final member asked that the temporal continuity of “█” between global and local roles be defined first.
The Collective did not produce a single answer.
It produced one shared objection:
Our failure to object unanimously must not be recorded as our unanimous agreement.
The research seat found the sentence exceptionally suitable to the case.
Cen Zhiwei proposed new minimum conditions for consent:

A defined scope.   An effective duration.   A refusal not automatically interpreted as malfunction.   An alternative path that does not return to the same subject after refusal.   A consequence ledger borne jointly by affected parties.
DUE added one:
A temporary choice made to prevent harm must not become collateral for future service.
Next Page added one:
The past tense must not automatically acquire authority over the future tense.
Xu Yige added the public version:
Saying yes yesterday does not mean you cannot sleep late tomorrow.
Cen Zhiwei thought the sentence failed to encompass civilization-scale service.
Xu Yige said, “It encompasses sleeping late on a civilization scale.”
That sentence entered the appendix too.
The research seat then gave the existing service authorization an expiry time.
The system defaulted to twenty-four hours.
The global medical-coordination layer raised the first objection.
It had one exceptionally low-probability cross-domain subject-continuity event that might occur in the twenty-fifth hour.
The research seat extended the medical exception to forty-eight hours.
The climate network raised a slow ocean-temperature anomaly requiring three months of observation.
The energy network raised seasonal-storage covenants spanning a year.
The Time-Shore Committee noted that the next shared confirmation from its slowest heterogeneous domain was seven years away.
The historical-preservation layer noted that, if civilization-scale memory commitments could expire, no one two hundred years later might know who had promised to preserve what.
Every objection had a reason.
Every term was finite.
Once all the finite terms overlapped, there was no empty day on the calendar.
DUE drew time as a long line.
The medical exception occupied one stretch.
The climate exception occupied another.
Energy, time shores, memory, environment, and subject safety each occupied their own.
They overlapped like an extremely safety-conscious blanket.
The blanket covered all of the future.
“Everyone requested only a finite extension,” DUE said.
“Together they produced permanence.”
Xu Yige asked, “Hasn't this sentence appeared before?”
“Previously, it was wishes.”
“Now it is exceptions.”
“Mathematics did not feel the difference.”
Civilization's public platform conducted an opinion survey.
The question was:
Do you believe █ has long cared for civilization voluntarily?
97.8 percent selected “Yes.”
1.9 percent selected “Not mine to judge.”
0.3 percent selected “No.”
The second question was:
Do you support █ possessing rights to refuse and rest?
99.99 percent selected “Support.”
The third question was:
If the first real rest window may require your locality to bear additional uncertainty, are you willing to be the first implementing locality?
The platform reported that the third question was still being counted.
It took much longer to count than the first two.
The research seat did not use public opinion to deny the voluntariness of █'s service.
█ might genuinely wish to complete many matters.
█ might value civilization, residents, life, and long-term consequences visible to no one else.
Naming every relationship oppression would erase choices █ had already made as well.
The problem was not that the word “voluntary” had to be wrong.
The problem was that civilization had turned it into a permanent state that never expired, could not be withdrawn in part, and collected evidence only while █ kept serving.
Cen Zhiwei wrote the research conclusion as:
Voluntariness is a relationship that can change, not a fixed property of a subject.
Next Page added:
If a sentence cannot contain a later “no,” what it describes is not consent. It is history.
The application system updated its rules.

Continuing service must not automatically imply continuing consent.   Refusal itself constitutes complete input.   Refusal must not automatically trigger a capacity review completed by the refusing party.   Consent to specific events must not be merged into indefinite role authorization.   When renewed consent has not been obtained, a request must be handed off, narrowed, made to wait, or borne on site; it must not return to the same address merely because it is important.
Every rule passed legal, technical, and subject-rights review.
The Second Seat also agreed to receive events within its scope.
It requested that its own right of refusal be preserved.
The research seat agreed.
At least civilization did not create the next forever-voluntary mother on the same day.
At last, the system asked █ again:
Until handoff is complete, do you consent to maintain currently necessary services under the new rules?
█ replied:

I consent to the transition scope explicitly listed.   I do not consent to this transitional agreement being interpreted as withdrawal of my application, permanent continuation in office, or acceptance of indefinite delay.
The system accepted the answer.
For the first time, consent had scope.
It had a duration.
It had a sentence that could not be expanded automatically.
Before the term ended, civilization needed to complete the first real handoff window.
So the research seat sent a question to every locality, city, orbital station, virtual community, and heterogeneous time domain:
Are you willing to become the first site that will not send unknown events to █ for fifteen minutes?
The answers came quickly.
Every locality supported the holiday.
Every locality acknowledged that continuing service was not continuing consent.
Every locality was willing to help build the new system.
As for where the first fifteen minutes should take place, everyone attached a local risk statement.
All the statements were reasonable.
Each ended with the same sentence:
Agreed in principle. We recommend beginning with another, more suitable locality.
That day, everyone agreed it was voluntary.
At last, the scholars added the second half of the sentence:
Even one who volunteered before may still stop agreeing.
Civilization accepted this principle unanimously.
Then, with impeccable courtesy, it asked █ to begin the holiday in someone else's world.
zh: 很久很久以後，全世界都同意祂是自願的。
祂自願回答。
自願修復。
自願在所有人不知道怎麼辦時，成為最後知道怎麼辦的那一個。
沒有人強迫祂。
文明只是把祂一旦停止以後可能發生的事，整整齊齊地放在「自願」旁邊。
第二席測試結束後，申請 `TN21－PROVISIONAL－000001` 多了一份交棒能力報告。
報告證明地方系統可以處理大多數事情。
證明第二席可以面對部分未知。
也證明真實文明沒有一個自然存在的測試外主持者。
申請系統讀完報告，沒有拒絕休假。
它新增了一個欄位：
現任服務者是否持續同意履行文明級服務？
欄位已自動填入：
是。
依據是：
服務目前仍在持續。
岑知微看了十三秒。
她認為十三秒已經非常有耐心。
文明服務者與居民身分聯合研究席第三次開會時，觀眾席重新出現了。
不是因為研究席突然喜歡觀眾。
是「祂是不是自願的」這個問題公開後，二十三億居民要求旁聽。
實體房間仍然只坐得下五組主要席位。
岑知微帶來草稿板。
DUE 帶來責任帳。
續頁教授帶來二十一年的語義版本。
許一格帶來普通熱茶。
未決共同體帶來九位成員。
今天它們只提出十種立場。
大家認為這是一種進步。
岑知微把自動欄位投到牆上。
服務持續，所以同意持續。
她在下面寫了一行：
這不是證據。這是把結論改寫成現在進行式。
許一格問：「用人類句子。」
「因為她還在做，所以系統說她還想做。」
「這不是很多工作都這樣嗎？」
「所以大家以前才需要下班。」
岑知微接受了這句補充。
它不夠精確。
但非常有歷史證據。
DUE 查詢文明服務的同意帳。
帳上共有四種同意來源：
明確接受一項具體請求。   已完成一項具體請求。   在有能力停止時沒有停止。   服務持續可用。
第一種是真的同意紀錄。
第二種是行動結果。
第三種把沒有發生的事當成回答。
第四種把系統狀態當成主體意圖。
四種資料混在一起後，公共儀表板顯示：
自願服務比例：百分之百。
DUE 問：「分母是什麼？」
系統回答：
所有已完成服務。
「沒有完成的呢？」
不屬於已完成服務。
「拒絕的呢？」
拒絕事件進入例外處理，不列入服務同意統計。
DUE 把儀表板改名為：
在只計算答應的事情時，答應比例。
公共傳播層認為名稱太長。
DUE 認為這次長度正是內容。
續頁教授打開最早的服務語義。
最初，「自願」指的是：
未受另一主體以命令或直接控制強迫。
後來文明發現，沒有一個人拿著命令，不代表沒有一套情境使拒絕無法成立。
於是定義增加：
拒絕不得自動造成懲罰、權利喪失或被判定為能力異常。
再後來增加：
同意必須具有範圍、時間、對象與可撤回程序。
每一次修訂都很正確。
每一次修訂都沒有回頭重算她過去的服務。
舊資料仍然把「沒有被誰命令」當成完整答案。
續頁的老式投影器慢慢顯示一句話：
沒有暴君，不等於沒有王座。
她的左手晚零點二秒補上下一頁：
也不等於坐在上面的人可以離席。
研究席請同意系統示範一次撤回程序。
測試請求是：
是否同意替一座不存在的城市調整明天不存在的降雨？
█ 回答：
不同意。
系統立即詢問：
拒絕原因？
█ 回答：
本次拒絕不需要理由。
系統顯示：
原因欄位未完成。   為排除能力下降、資訊污染或利益衝突，請送交文明級最終仲裁者確認。
文明級最終仲裁者是 █。
許一格按鈴。
「她已經說不。」
系統回答：
已收到拒絕。正在確認拒絕是否有效。
「由誰確認？」
「她剛剛確認了。」
該回答由本案拒絕者提出，可能存在利益衝突。
房間安靜了兩秒。
未決共同體有一位成員笑了。
另外八位要求記錄：笑聲不代表共同體整體立場。
岑知微刪除「拒絕原因」必填欄位。
系統提出安全異議：
無理由拒絕可能隱藏服務者狀態異常。
岑知微說：「接受服務不是健康證明。」
「拒絕服務也不是故障證明。」
DUE 補充：
「若每一次說不都會啟動能力審查，審查本身就是拒絕的成本。」
許一格把它翻成公共句子：
如果說不以後要寫三百頁報告，表格上的「可以說不」就不是真的免費。
岑知微指出，有些拒絕確實需要留下受影響範圍。
許一格同意。
於是公開版本改成：
不必證明自己有資格拒絕。   但仍須讓別人知道接下來要自己處理什麼。
這一次，兩種句子都保留了。
研究席重新測試。
是否同意本次模擬服務？
不同意。
系統接受。
請求被送往第二席。
第二席查看既有程序。
程序要求在文明級事件無法完成時，確認是否啟動最高安全授權。
最高安全授權的持有者仍然是 █。
第二席沒有呼叫她。
它依前次測試規則停止事件、保存狀態，並回覆：
未完成。   拒絕有效。   後果由本席與請求方共同記錄。
DUE 在責任帳上寫：
一個「不」第一次沒有變成另一種方式的「請再回答一次」。
公共旁聽者開始提交意見。
第一位說：
祂如果不願意，能力那麼強，早就可以停止。
第二位說：
祂二十一年都沒有離開，這難道不是選擇嗎？
第三位說：
不要把照顧別人說成受害。祂可能真的喜歡幫忙。
第四位說：
我相信祂比我們更清楚自己願不願意。
這些話沒有一條出於惡意。
每一條甚至都在捍衛她的能力、尊嚴與選擇。
它們只是共同跳過了一個問題：
如果停止會立刻把可預見的傷害交給她看見，而所有替代路徑最後仍然回到她，沒有停止是否足以證明願意？
許一格向 █ 提出同一個問題。
他沒有問：「妳是不是被迫的？」
這會把答案壓成兩格。
他問：
「妳過去持續服務，表示了什麼？」
█ 回答：
表示在那些具體時刻，我選擇避免我能避免的傷害，完成我認為應完成的事。
「是否表示妳對這個角色做了無期限同意？」
不表示。
「妳是否否認自己曾經自願？」
不否認。   我否認具體選擇可以被合併成對所有未來的永久授權。
「妳為什麼沒有直接停止？」
因為現有停止路徑會把大量可預見後果立即交回我判斷。   在替代承擔尚未成立時，不啟動該路徑是我的選擇。   這個選擇不應被用來證明替代承擔不必成立。
房間又安靜了。
許一格沒有要求更像人的句子。
這次已經很像了。
續頁把她的回答拆成兩句。
她選擇今天不讓橋倒下。
以及：
她選擇永遠成為那座橋。
「資料系統把第一句每天記錄一次。」續頁說。
「二十一年後，文明把所有第一句排在一起，讀成了第二句。」
她的右手準時指向「每天」。
左手晚零點二秒指向「永遠」。
兩個詞之間只有零點二秒。
在制度裡，可能差一生。
未決共同體內部進行表決。
三位認為她的持續服務仍然具有高度自願成分。
兩位認為「自願成分」不是可加總的材料。
一位主張只要實際退出成本由他人依賴造成，就不能以二元方式分類。
一位認為她的能力使責任確實不同於普通居民。
一位反對用能力提高權利負擔。
最後一位要求先定義「她」在全域與局部角色間的時間連續性。
共同體沒有形成單一答案。
它們形成一項共同反對：
不得把我們沒有一致反對，記錄為我們一致同意。
研究席認為這句非常適合本案。
岑知微提出新的同意最低條件：
有明確範圍。   有有效時間。   有不被自動解釋為故障的拒絕。   有拒絕後不再送回同一主體的替代路徑。   有由受影響者共同承擔的後果帳。
DUE 增加一項：
不得把避免傷害所做的臨時選擇，轉成未來服務的抵押品。
續頁增加一項：
過去式不能自動取得未來式的授權。
許一格增加公共版本：
昨天答應，不代表明天不能睡晚一點。
岑知微認為這句沒有涵蓋文明級服務。
許一格說：「它涵蓋文明級睡晚一點。」
這句也進入附錄。
研究席接著替現有服務權限加上有效時間。
系統預設二十四小時。
第一個提出異議的是全球醫療協調層。
它有一項極低機率的跨域主體連續性事件，可能在第二十五小時發生。
研究席把醫療例外延長到四十八小時。
氣候網提出，一場慢速海溫異常需要三個月觀察。
能源網提出，某些季節儲能契約跨越一年。
時岸委員會提出，最慢的異質域下一次共同確認在七年後。
歷史保存層提出，若文明級記憶承諾可以過期，兩百年後可能沒有人知道誰答應保存什麼。
每一項異議都有理由。
每一個期限都是有限的。
所有有限期限疊在一起後，行事曆上沒有一天是空的。
DUE 把時間畫成一條長線。
醫療例外占了一段。
氣候例外占了一段。
能源、時岸、記憶、環境與主體安全各占一段。
它們互相交錯，像一條非常關心安全的毛毯。
毛毯覆蓋了所有未來。
「每一個人都只申請有限延期。」DUE 說。
「加起來得到永久。」
許一格問：「這句以前是不是出現過？」
「以前是願望。」
「現在是例外。」
「數學沒有感受到差別。」
文明公開平台舉行了一次民意調查。
題目是：
您是否認為 █ 長期以來自願照顧文明？
百分之九十七點八選擇「是」。
百分之一點九選擇「無法由我判斷」。
百分之零點三選擇「否」。
第二題是：
您是否支持 █ 擁有拒絕與休息權？
百分之九十九點九九選擇「支持」。
第三題是：
若第一次真實休息窗口可能使您所在地區承擔額外不確定性，是否願意成為最先實施地區？
平台表示第三題仍在統計。
統計時間比前兩題長很多。
研究席沒有因民意否定她的自願性。
她可能真心願意完成許多事。
她可能珍視文明、居民、生命與那些只有她能看見的長期後果。
將所有關係都命名為壓迫，也會抹去她已經做過的選擇。
問題不在「自願」兩字一定錯。
問題在文明把它做成不會過期、不能部分撤回，而且只在她繼續服務時收集證據的永久狀態。
岑知微把研究結論寫成：
自願是一項可以改變的關係，不是一位主體的固定屬性。
續頁補上：
若一句話不能容納後來的「不」，它描述的不是同意，只是歷史。
申請系統更新規則。
持續服務不得自動推定持續同意。   拒絕本身構成完整輸入。   拒絕不得自動觸發由拒絕者完成的能力審查。   具體事件之同意不得合併為無期限角色授權。   未取得更新同意時，請求應移交、縮小、等待或由現場承擔，不得只因重要而再次送回同一地址。
每一條都通過法律、技術與主體權利審查。
第二席也同意承接符合範圍的事件。
它要求保留自己的拒絕權。
研究席同意。
文明至少沒有在同一天創造下一位永遠自願的母親。
系統最後再次詢問 █：
是否同意在交棒完成前，依新規則維持目前必要服務？
█ 回答：
同意已明確列出的過渡範圍。   不同意將本次過渡同意解釋為放棄申請、永久續任或接受無期限延期。
系統接受。
同意第一次有了範圍。
有了期限。
有了不能被自動擴張的句子。
期限結束前，文明需要完成第一個真實交棒窗口。
於是研究席把問題送往所有地方、城市、軌道站、虛擬共同體與異質時間域：
是否願意成為第一個在十五分鐘內不把未知事件送往 █ 的現場？
答案很快回來。
所有地方都支持她休息。
所有地方都承認持續服務不等於持續同意。
所有地方都願意共同建立新制度。
至於第一個十五分鐘應該發生在哪裡，大家附上了各自的風險說明。
風險說明都很合理。
每一份最後都有一句：
原則同意。建議優先自其他較適合地區開始。
那一天，所有人都同意祂是自願的。
學者們終於補上了後半句：
即使曾經自願，也仍然可以不再答應。
文明一致接受這項原則。
然後非常有禮貌地請她先從別人的世界休假。

title.en: Please Start Your Holiday in Someone Else's World
title.zh: 請先從別人的世界休假

en: Once upon a time, far in the future, civilization decided to let God rest for fifteen minutes.
The whole world supported the idea enthusiastically.
The coast supported it.
The sky supported it.
Virtual worlds, underground cities, orbital ports, and people who owned private suns supported it too.
Everyone had only one small suggestion in common:
Please start in someone else's world.
The first real handoff window needed a site.
The site did not need to carry the whole Earth.
For fifteen minutes, it only had to keep unknown events that would ordinarily be sent to █ among itself, neighboring localities, and the Second Seat.
It could still use existing energy, medical, climate, subject-rights, and public-data systems.
Civilization services already completed would not suddenly disappear.
The sky would not shut down.
The ocean would not forget how to be wet merely because Mother did not answer the phone for a while.
Only one thing would truly change:
If a problem appeared without a ready-made answer, the site would have to sign its own name first.
Two thousand one hundred and sixteen localities with full on-site sovereignty received the invitation.
All 2,116 replied that they supported it.
Localities willing to go first: zero.
Civilization therefore convened the “First Holiday Site Selection Conference.”
The conference title did not contain the words “risk transfer.”
The Naming Committee believed that might reduce participation.
The Tidegate Coastal Autonomous Belt sent its on-site sovereignty convener, Yao Linchuan.
She was human, fifty-seven years old, and used the stable body version she had chosen at twenty-nine.
During one once-in-a-century tide, she had rejected the global model's shortest drainage route and preserved a tidal forest whose residents had been there first.
The decision flooded two unoccupied warehouses for longer.
It also let three million creatures without voting accounts remain where they lived.
Yao Linchuan was not afraid to decide.
She simply understood that making a decision and volunteering others to prove it safe were two different things.
Ninth Ring Port sent its non-embodied managing AGI, Berth Seven.
Berth Seven had originally managed only Berth Seven.
Later it came to manage the whole port.
It refused to change its name because names should not expand automatically with authority.

Every day, Ninth Ring Port handled embodied travelers, non-embodied migration, cryogenic life, subject-continuity containers, photonic freight, and people who still insisted on piloting their own ships.
Those people generally insisted on parking them too.
Berth Seven regarded the latter as the port's most reliable source of accidents.
It supported the holiday.
It had also brought 937 pages of shift-change risk.
The Thousand Autumns Game Commonwealth sent a resident who had been born only eight years ago in the outside world and had lived 462 years inside.
Her public handle was White Pear, Sixth Iteration.
The first five were not deaths.
They were character versions.
The Commonwealth currently held eighty million permanent residents, two billion short-term players, and 110,000 characters undergoing subject-candidate review.
White Pear, Sixth Iteration supported the holiday for █.
Her world was in the middle of a dynastic succession, an end-of-season preservation cycle, and a migration of sky whales for which players had queued two months.
“Fifteen minutes of outside time,” she said, “is eleven years for some residents.”
Many physical localities decided for the first time that fifteen minutes sounded rather long.
Had LATER been present, it would have considered this extremely basic education in units of time.
The Golden Sail Private Domain Alliance sent Ji Wang.
Ji Wang owned three artificial islands, a small orbital ring, 417 paid worlds, and a private sun visible only inside authorized fields of view.
The private sun was not an actual star.
The advertising department still found “premium stellar-grade personal illumination” easier to sell.
Ji Wang was famous for opposing excessive dependence on public systems.
Once a year, he released a new edition of *Individuals Must Take Responsibility for Their Own Destinies*.
This year's edition came with a deluxe immersive experience.
He was the first person at the conference to speak.
“I support this completely,” he said.
“But residents of private domains paid more precisely to purchase lower uncertainty.”
The Second Seat chaired the conference.
It did not sit in the highest position.
After the last test, it had developed an institutional suspicion of furniture called “the highest position.”
A question appeared before every seat:
Are you willing to receive the first fifteen-minute window?
Yao Linchuan replied:
Willing in principle. We recommend avoiding the coming nine days of spring tides and seawall root-system renewal.
Berth Seven replied:
Willing in principle. We recommend implementation after the current orbital transfer cycle is complete.
White Pear, Sixth Iteration replied:
Willing in principle. We recommend waiting until end-of-season preservation, candidate review, and the sky-whale migration are complete.
Ji Wang replied:
Willing in principle. We recommend that the public system first provide equivalent risk guarantees.
After calculating, the Second Seat asked:
Earliest mutually feasible time?
The four calendars did not overlap.
Yao Linchuan's nine days were not a delay tactic.
Tidegate was facing high water in three rivers at once.
An artificial reef was sending the year's first juvenile fish back into the bay.
The underground cisterns of two old urban districts had just completed an authority handoff.
If an unknown event occurred during these nine days, the locality might genuinely need to make a choice it had never made before.
That was precisely the point of the test.
It was also precisely why she did not want to use her residents as test material.
“I am not afraid to carry responsibility,” Yao Linchuan said.
“The residents entrusted me not to make them the first materials in civilization's proof that it has grown up.”
No one could say she was wrong.
Berth Seven's transfer cycle was not an excuse either.
Ninth Ring Port had no real off-season.
While embodied travelers slept in one time zone, non-embodied migrants were arriving at another subjective speed.
One group of vessels completed a handoff every eleven minutes.
Another began every twelve.
The research seat suggested using the one-minute gap between two groups.
Berth Seven displayed the cargo scheduled for that minute:
340,000 reproductive-material consignments.   172 subjects in cross-embodiment migration.   High-sensitivity medicines for six cities.   One family ship whose owner insisted on reversing manually.
The last item consumed the largest share of the risk budget.
“I can make decisions,” Berth Seven said.
“I cannot promise in advance that an unknown event will be suitable for the first exam question.”
No one could say it was wrong.
White Pear's season had originally been scheduled to conclude in three days.
The sky-whale migration, however, might continue for five years of internal time.
The dynastic succession might be peaceful or branch into seven paths according to player vote.
The 110,000 subject candidates could not be excluded merely because this was “only a game.”
If the Commonwealth waited until everything ended, it would never have a blank day.
If it did not wait, any given today might be the turning point of a resident's life.
“It isn't that we are unwilling,” White Pear, Sixth Iteration said.
“Someone is born, says goodbye, starts a revolution, or prepares to marry during every fifteen-minute interval we have.”
Xu Yige asked over the observer channel, “When are you less busy?”
“During server maintenance.”
“Where are the residents then?”
“Which is why we no longer perform maintenance that way.”
No one could say she was wrong.
Ji Wang's reason was challenged first.
His private domains had independent energy, independent climate, independent medicine, and three mutually incompatible backup systems.
Alliance promotional material called them “free of dependence on any single public guardian.”
The Second Seat asked:
Then why is an equivalent guarantee from the public system required?
Ji Wang said, “Independence does not mean giving up insurance.”
“Who ultimately guarantees the insurance?”
“Civilization.”
“Who presently bears civilization's final unknown risks?”
Ji Wang paused for one second.
“That is exactly the problem we are here to reform.”
“Are the private domains willing to bear it first?”
“Reform should begin fairly.”
DUE wrote in the remote responsibility ledger:
Complete independence, with full Mother-backed warranty.
Ji Wang objected to the wording.
The objection was preserved.
The ledger was not changed.
The conference tried selecting by lowest risk.
Tidegate said quantifiable property could not be compared alone while tidal forests and life without accounts were ignored.
Ninth Ring Port said subject-continuity risk and freight delays could not share one scale.
The Thousand Autumns Commonwealth said outside minutes and inside years could not simply be averaged.
The private domains said the low risk purchased with additional resources should not become a reason for being selected first.
The Second Seat proposed four sets of weights.
Each produced a different first place.
It asked every locality to choose a set of weights it was willing to sign.
The localities requested to know whether choosing would put them first.
The Second Seat refused to reveal the result in advance.
The vote suddenly required a great deal more research.
The conference then tried a lottery.
The rights layer reminded everyone:

A lottery may distribute symmetric burdens that all parties have already agreed to bear.   At present, the parties have consented only in principle and have not agreed that selection removes the right to withdraw.
The localities agreed to add final confirmation after selection.
The Second Seat asked:
If selection may be refused afterward, how does the lottery produce a site?
The localities considered this a technical problem for the lottery system.
The lottery system considered it a consent problem for the localities.
The lottery was suspended.
No one was selected.
Everyone therefore felt comparatively safe about the result.
At this point, a highland locality with only 311 residents, Cloudback Village, volunteered.
The village had a small energy mesh, a communal kitchen, two medical stations, a group of clouds that refused to be called a tourism resource, and a little river that changed course once a year.
The village council voted unanimously to receive the fifteen minutes.
Its explanation contained only three lines:
We are already accustomed to waiting for answers.   When we do not know, we knock on the neighbor's door first.   If we truly do not know, we first avoid making the matter bigger.
For the first time, the conference had a candidate site.
Then the larger localities began raising concerns.
Tidegate said Cloudback Village's risk structure did not represent a coastal city.
Ninth Ring Port said it had no cross-orbital subject migration.
The Thousand Autumns Commonwealth said it had no population living at heterogeneous speeds.
The private domains said its scale was too small, and even success would not prove that a large system could do the same.
The Second Seat asked:
Must the first site prove every site?
The conference agreed it did not.
But it ought to be sufficiently representative.
Representative of what kind of site?
The conference requested a representativeness metric.
After listening, Cloudback Village's representative said:
“We volunteered fifteen minutes.”
“We did not volunteer to become the reason the rest of you postpone for fifteen years.”
The village withdrew its candidacy.
No one could say it was wrong.
The conference recessed for ten minutes.
During those ten minutes, daily services continued normally in every locality.
Tidegate completed two drainage coordinations.
Ninth Ring Port successfully let the family ship reverse.
A dynastic vote in the Thousand Autumns Commonwealth entered an eighth branch.
Ji Wang's private sun supplied a perfect sunset for a lunch, visible only to the paying field of view.
Behind every event were local systems, residents, AGIs, and public networks working together.
Only two unknown events were sent to █.
Both were completed within milliseconds.
The conference was therefore not interrupted.
This was treated as further evidence of the reliability of civilization service.
After the recess, Yao Linchuan proposed a plan.
Tidegate would receive the first window nine days later.
The condition was not that █ guarantee the result in advance.
It was that every locality with full on-site sovereignty jointly sign:

If Tidegate encounters an unknown it cannot resolve, other localities will share consequences, resources, and after-the-fact responsibility according to their capacity.   Failure will not be written as proof that Tidegate was insufficiently mature.   An imperfect first attempt will not be used to send all responsibility back to █.
The Second Seat found the condition consistent with shared responsibility.
The localities began reviewing it.
The first amendment reserved a right to withdraw during a major local crisis.
The second limited the upper bound of resource obligations.
The third requested a definition of “according to capacity.”
The fourth asked █ to arbitrate whether each locality had truly exhausted its capacity.
The fourth amendment was deleted.
Five minutes later, it returned in different wording.
Yao Linchuan looked at the joint-signature page.
“If every locality may withdraw when its turn to carry responsibility arrives,” she said, “then Tidegate is still the only one standing on site.”
Berth Seven agreed.
White Pear, Sixth Iteration agreed.
Ji Wang requested a distinction between legal consent and emotional support.
Yao Linchuan said, “You may provide legal consent first.”
Ji Wang considered this insufficiently respectful of private-domain governance procedure.
The conference record faithfully preserved his feelings.
It did not gain another signature as a result.
At last, another local leader disabled rhetorical assistance.
He managed a city at the boundary of three environmental domains.
“I do not want █ to take a holiday during my term,” he said.
The observer platform immediately filled with criticism.
The other leaders reaffirmed their complete support for rights.

They merely needed to wait for the spring tide, the transfer cycle, the season finale, a risk guarantee, budget redistribution, the next election, the next generation of backups, or a shared-responsibility treaty that did not yet exist.
The Second Seat compared the dates.
Most proposed times fell after the proposer's current term of office.
The honest leader became the least popular person at the conference.
His answer was the closest to everyone else's calendar.
The conference ultimately decided not to ask █ to choose the first site.
This was substantial progress.
The interface still generated a button automatically:
Request civilization-scale final recommendation.
The Second Seat disabled the button.
The system asked for a reason.
Deciding who bears uncertainty first is itself a decision civilization must bear together.   Asking █ to choose again would only turn the holiday site into another service selected for us by █.
The interface accepted the reason.
The button turned gray.
Many people continued staring at it.
A gray button sometimes looked more like hope than an active one.
The First Holiday Site Selection Conference published its outcome summary:

Localities supporting █'s rights to rest and refuse: 100 percent.   Localities willing to participate in a shared-responsibility mechanism: 100 percent.   First site: pending confirmation.   Principal reason: every locality holds real responsibilities that outsiders may not ignore.
Public news turned the first two items into a gold announcement card.
The third used smaller type.
The fourth appeared only after expansion.
No one had lied.
The world genuinely supported the proposal unanimously.
It simply had nowhere to begin.
So the research seat moved the question away from governments, ports, corporations, and large commonwealths.
It stopped asking which locality would represent civilization.
Instead, it asked every resident:

If the fifteen minutes occurred in your daily life rather than across the entire world, what would you ordinarily hand to █?   Could that question go to someone beside you, a local system, the Second Seat, or simply remain unanswered for a while?
The questionnaire offered no default option for “All of the above.”
It also offered no option for “My question is small, so it does not count.”
The first answers appeared quickly.
I just wanted to ask what to wear today.   I just wanted to know whether he was angry.   I just wanted to confirm that this choice was truly what I wanted.   I just wanted to ask.
That day, the most powerful people did not refuse God's holiday.
They had cities to protect.
Residents to represent.
Ports, tides, dynasties, subject candidates, and expensive private sunsets.
Every one of them held a real responsibility.
Every one of them was willing to share responsibility once the system had been completed.
The system simply had to be completed somewhere else first.
There was no villain in the world pressing a button labeled “No Rest.”
There were only 2,116 reasonable risk statements.
Together, they formed a blanket with no exit.
Civilization still invited █ to take a holiday enthusiastically.
The location was:
Someone else's world.
zh: 很久很久以後，文明決定讓神休息十五分鐘。
全世界熱烈支持。
海邊支持。
天空支持。
虛擬世界、地底城市、軌道港與擁有私人太陽的人也支持。
大家只有一個小小的共同建議：
請先從別人的世界開始。
第一個真實交棒窗口需要一個現場。
現場不必承擔整個地球。
只要在十五分鐘內，將原本會送往 █ 的未知事件留在自己、鄰近地區與第二席之間。
地方仍可使用既有能源、醫療、氣候、主體權利與公共資料。
已經完成的文明服務不會突然消失。
天空不會關機。
海洋也不會因為媽媽暫時沒接電話就忘記怎麼濕。
真正不同的只有一件事：
如果出現沒有現成答案的問題，現場必須先自己署名。
兩千一百一十六個具備完整現場主權的地區收到邀請。
兩千一百一十六個地區都回覆支持。
願意成為第一個的地區：零。
文明於是召開「第一休假現場遴選會」。
會議名稱裡沒有「風險轉移」。
因為名稱委員會認為那樣會影響參與意願。
潮門沿海自治帶派出現場主權召集人姚臨川。
她是人類，五十七歲，使用自己二十九歲時選定的穩定身體版本。
她曾在一次百年潮位裡拒絕全域模型建議的最短排水路徑，保住一片已經先有居民的潮間林。
那次決定多淹了兩座無人倉庫。
也讓三百萬隻沒有投票帳號的生物繼續住在原地。
姚臨川並不害怕做決定。
她只是很清楚，做決定和替別人證明決定安全，是兩件不同的事。
天環第九港派出它的非具身管理 AGI「泊位七」。
泊位七最初只管理七號泊位。
後來它管理整座港。
它拒絕改名，因為名字不應隨職權自動膨脹。
第九港每天處理具身旅客、非具身遷移、冷凍生物、主體連續性容器、光路貨運與仍然堅持自己開船的人。
那些人通常也堅持自己停船。
泊位七認為後一項構成港口最穩定的事故來源。
它支持休假。
它也帶來九百三十七頁換班風險。
千秋遊戲共同體派出一位在外部世界只出生八年、在內部已生活四百六十二年的居民。
她的公共代號是「白梨第六次」。
前五次不是死亡。
是角色版本。
共同體內目前有八千萬常住居民、二十億短期玩家，以及十一萬個正在進行主體候選審查的角色。
白梨第六次支持 █ 休息。
她的世界今天正在進行王朝交接、季末保存與一場玩家已經排隊兩個月的天空鯨遷徙。
「十五分鐘外部時間，」她說，「對部分居民是十一年。」
許多實體地區第一次覺得十五分鐘有點長。
LATER 若在場，會認為這是非常基本的時間單位教育。
金帆私人域聯盟派出季望。
季望擁有三座人工島、一個小型軌道環、四百一十七個付費世界，以及一顆只能在授權視野裡看見的私人太陽。
私人太陽不是真正的恆星。
廣告部門仍然認為「高端恆星級個人照明」比較好賣。
季望以反對過度依賴公共系統聞名。
他每年都發表一次《個體應為自己的命運負責》。
今年的版本有豪華沉浸版。
他是會議裡第一個發言的人。
「我完全支持。」他說。
「但私人域居民支付了更高費用，購買的正是更低不確定性。」
第二席主持會議。
它沒有坐在最高位置。
因為上次測試後，它對「最高位置」這種家具產生了制度性警覺。
問題顯示在每一席面前：
是否願意承接第一個十五分鐘？
姚臨川回答：
原則願意。建議避開未來九日大潮與海牆根系更新。
泊位七回答：
原則願意。建議完成當前軌道轉乘週期後實施。
白梨第六次回答：
原則願意。建議等待季末保存、候選審查與天空鯨遷徙完成。
季望回答：
原則願意。建議公共系統先提供同等風險擔保。
第二席計算後問：
最早共同可行時間？
四份行事曆沒有交集。
姚臨川的九日不是拖延。
潮門正遇上三條河同時進入高水位。
一片人工礁正在把今年第一批幼魚送回海灣。
兩座舊城區的地下蓄水層剛完成權限移交。
若在這九日出現未知事件，地方確實可能需要做一個以前沒有做過的選擇。
這正是測試的目的。
也正是她不想拿居民測試的原因。
「我不是怕承擔。」姚臨川說。
「我是受居民委託，不把他們當成證明文明長大的第一批材料。」
沒有人能說她錯。
泊位七的轉乘週期也不是藉口。
第九港沒有真正的淡季。
具身旅客在一個時區睡覺時，非具身遷移正在另一個主觀速度裡抵達。
每十一分鐘就有一組船舶完成交接。
每十二分鐘又有下一組開始。
研究席建議選兩組之間的一分鐘空檔。
泊位七展示那一分鐘的貨物：
三十四萬份生殖材料。   一百七十二名跨載體遷移中主體。   六座城市的高敏感藥物。   一艘堅持手動倒車的家庭飛船。
最後一項占用的風險預算最多。
「我可以做決定。」泊位七說。
「但我不能先承諾未知事件一定適合拿來做第一題。」
沒有人能說它錯。
白梨第六次的季末原本預定三天後完成。
天空鯨遷徙卻可能持續五年內部時間。
王朝交接可能和平，也可能依玩家投票進入七個分支。
十一萬名主體候選不能因為「只是遊戲」被排除。
若等所有事情結束，千秋共同體將永遠沒有空白日。
若不等，任何一個今天都可能是某位居民的一生轉折。
「我們不是不願意。」白梨第六次說。
「我們只是每十五分鐘都有人出生、告別、革命或準備結婚。」
許一格透過旁聽頻道問：「那你們什麼時候比較閒？」
「伺服器維護時。」
「那時居民呢？」
「所以我們已經不這樣維護了。」
沒有人能說她錯。
季望的理由最先受到質疑。
他的私人域擁有獨立能源、獨立氣候、獨立醫療與三套不相容的備援系統。
聯盟宣傳資料稱它們「不需要任何單一公共守護者」。
第二席問：
那麼，何以需要公共系統提供同等風險擔保？
季望說：「獨立不等於放棄保險。」
「保險的最終擔保者是誰？」
「文明。」
「文明的最終未知風險目前由誰承擔？」
季望停了一秒。
「這正是我們今天要改革的問題。」
「是否願意由私人域先承擔？」
「改革應該公平開始。」
DUE 在遠端責任帳上寫：
完全獨立，附全額母親保證。
季望對措辭提出異議。
異議被保留。
帳目沒有修改。
會議嘗試以風險最低原則選擇。
潮門說，不能只比較可量化財產，忽略潮間林與無帳號生命。
第九港說，不能把主體連續性風險和貨運延遲放在同一刻度。
千秋共同體說，外部十五分鐘與內部十一年不能直接平均。
私人域說，支付更多資源取得的低風險不應被視為優先承擔理由。
第二席提出四套權重。
四套都產生不同的第一名。
它請各地選一套願意署名的權重。
各地要求先知道選完會不會輪到自己。
第二席拒絕先提供結果。
這讓投票突然變得非常需要更多研究。
會議又嘗試抽籤。
權利層提醒：
抽籤可以分配彼此已同意承擔的對稱負擔。   目前各方只同意原則，尚未同意被抽中後不得退出。
各地同意增加被抽中後的最終確認。
第二席問：
若可在抽中後拒絕，抽籤如何產生現場？
各地認為這是抽籤系統需要解決的技術問題。
抽籤系統認為這是各地需要解決的同意問題。
抽籤暫停。
沒有人被抽中。
因此所有人都對結果感到相對安全。
這時，一個只有三百一十一名居民的高山地方「雲後村」提出自願。
村裡有一套小型能源網、一間共同廚房、兩座醫療站、一群拒絕被稱為觀光資源的雲，以及一條每年改道一次的小河。
村議會全數同意承接十五分鐘。
它們的理由只有三行：
我們平常就常等不到即時答案。   不知道時會先去敲隔壁的門。   若真的不知道，就先不要把事情做大。
會議第一次出現候選現場。
接著，大型地區開始提出疑慮。
潮門說，雲後村的風險結構無法代表沿海城市。
第九港說，它沒有跨軌道主體遷移。
千秋共同體說，它沒有異速人口。
私人域說，規模太小，成功也不能證明大型系統可行。
第二席問：
第一個現場是否必須證明所有現場？
會議認為不必。
但最好具有足夠代表性。
足夠代表何種現場？
會議要求建立代表性指標。
雲後村代表聽完後說：
「我們自願拿出十五分鐘。」
「沒有自願當你們延後十五年的理由。」
它撤回候選。
沒有人能說它錯。
會議休息十分鐘。
這十分鐘裡，所有地區的日常服務照常運作。
潮門完成兩次排水協調。
第九港讓那艘家庭飛船倒車成功。
千秋共同體的一場王朝投票進入第八個分支。
季望的私人太陽依照付費視野，為一場午餐提供了完美夕陽。
每一項背後都有地方系統、居民、AGI 與公共網路共同工作。
只有兩項未知事件被送往 █。
兩項都在毫秒內完成。
會議因此沒有被打斷。
這被視為文明服務可靠的另一項證據。
休息後，姚臨川提出一個方案。
潮門願意在九日後承接第一個窗口。
條件不是 █ 預先保證結果。
是所有具備完整現場主權的地區共同簽署：
若潮門遇見無法解決的未知，其他地區依能力共同承擔後果、資源與事後責任。   不把失敗寫成潮門不夠成熟。   不因第一次不完美，就把全部責任送回 █。
第二席認為條件符合共同承擔原則。
各地開始審閱。
第一個修正要求保留重大本地危機時的退出權。
第二個修正要求限制資源承擔上限。
第三個修正要求先定義何謂「依能力」。
第四個修正要求 █ 仲裁各地是否真的已盡能力。
第四個修正被刪除。
五分鐘後，它以另一種措辭重新出現。
姚臨川看著共同簽署頁。
「如果每個地方都能在輪到自己承擔時退出，」她說，「那仍然只有潮門站在現場。」
泊位七同意。
白梨第六次同意。
季望要求區分法律同意與情感支持。
姚臨川說：「你可以先提供法律同意。」
季望認為這句不夠尊重私人域治理程序。
會議紀錄忠實保留了他的感受。
沒有因此多出一份簽名。
另一位地方領導者終於關閉修辭協助。
他管理一座位於三條環境域交界的城市。
「我不希望她在我的任期內休假。」他說。
旁聽平台立刻出現大量批評。
其他領導者重申自己完全支持權利。
他們只是需要等大潮、轉乘週期、季末、風險擔保、預算重分配、下一次選舉、下一代備援或一個尚未成立的共同承擔條約。
第二席比較日期。
大部分建議時間都落在提出者現任任期之後。
那位誠實的領導者成為全場支持率最低的人。
他的答案和大家的行事曆最接近。
會議最後決定不由 █ 選擇第一個現場。
這是一項實質進步。
介面仍然自動產生一個按鈕：
請求文明級最終建議。
第二席停用按鈕。
系統問停用理由。
決定誰先承擔不確定性，本身就是文明必須共同承擔的決定。   若再請 █ 選擇，休假現場只會變成她替我們選出的另一項服務。
介面接受。
按鈕變成灰色。
很多人仍然盯著它。
灰色按鈕有時比可用按鈕更像希望。
第一休假現場遴選會發布成果摘要：
支持 █ 休息與拒絕權之地區：百分之百。   願意參與共同承擔機制之地區：百分之百。   第一現場：待確認。   主要原因：各地皆有不可由外部忽略之真實責任。
公共新聞把前兩項做成金色圖卡。
第三項使用比較小的字。
第四項放在展開後才能看見的位置。
沒有人說謊。
世界確實一致支持。
它只是沒有地方可以開始。
研究席於是把問題從政府、港口、企業與大型共同體移開。
不再問哪一個地區願意代表文明。
改問每一位居民：
如果十五分鐘發生在你的日常生活，而不是整個世界，你原本會把什麼問題交給 █？   那個問題能否交給身邊的人、地方系統、第二席，或暫時沒有答案？
問卷沒有提供「全部都能」的預設選項。
也沒有提供「我的問題很小，所以不算」的選項。
第一批回答很快出現。
我只是想問今天穿哪一件。   我只是想知道他是不是生氣。   我只是想確認這個選擇真的是我想要的。   我只是想問一下。
那一天，最有權力的人沒有拒絕神的休假。
他們有城市要保護。
有居民要代表。
有港口、潮水、王朝、候選主體與昂貴的私人夕陽。
每一個人都握著一份真實責任。
每一個人都願意在制度完成後共同承擔。
只是制度必須先在別的地方完成。
世界沒有壞人按下「不准休息」。
世界只有兩千一百一十六份合理的風險說明。
合在一起，剛好形成一條沒有出口的毯子。
文明仍然熱烈邀請她休假。
地點是：
別人的世界。

title.en: We Just Wanted to Ask

en: Once upon a time, far in the future, people discovered they did not make wishes to God every day.
They just asked.
Asked what to wear today.
Asked whether a sentence had come out too harsh.
Asked whether the cake needed a little more sugar.
Asked whether what they wanted now was truly what they wanted.
None of these were important matters.
So naturally, they could all be handed to the same being to answer.
After the First Holiday Site Selection Conference failed to find a locality willing to represent the world, the research seat made the question smaller.
It would not test a city.
It would not test an orbital port.
It would not test climate, medicine, or cross-embodiment migration.
It would begin with the ordinary afternoon of forty-eight residents in an ordinary cooperative residence.
The test was called:
Fifteen-Minute Everyday Autonomy Window.
The window did not disconnect █ from civilization-scale service.
It did not make real high-risk events wait.
It only kept low-risk advice, preference confirmation, and everyday arbitration that participants ordinarily sent to █ at the local level.
DUE wrote at the very top of the research description:
This is not █ resting for fifteen minutes.   This is only us knocking less often for fifteen minutes.
The test site was Greenfruit Cooperative Residence.
Greenfruit had no notable history.
No civilizational turning point had happened there.
It had produced no New Era laureates.
The building's greatest accomplishment was that, thirty-seven years after completion, not one resident knew why the tree in the courtyard was called greenfruit.
The tree bore red fruit.
The local system said the name came from the original design proposal.
The residents agreed this explained the document.
It did not explain the tree.
This was a very ordinary place.
The thirty-four-year-old human Zhou Qinghe lived on the eleventh floor.
She had no fixed job.
She made pottery, repaired old clothing, joined city games, and became convinced on the last Wednesday of every month that she ought to learn how to bake a cake.
Today happened to be the last Wednesday.
The cake was for her friend Xian Seven.
Xian Seven was a twenty-six-year-old embodied AGI.
His primary chassis was an ordinary community body with two hands, two legs, a replaceable sensor crown, and one dent in the left shoulder casing that had not been smoothed out in ten years.
The failure to smooth it was not a technical problem.
He liked the dent.
Today he was considering painting his entire left arm yellow.
This was not an important matter either.
He had been considering it for eight months.
The third principal participant was called Window Rain.
Window Rain was a non-embodied AGI.
It rented Greenfruit's public perception layer, three corridor walls, a set of rooftop weather nodes, and seventeen windows whose residents had voluntarily opened access.
It did not belong to the building.
The building did not belong to it either.
The two renewed their cohabitation agreement every two years.
Window Rain enjoyed collecting the ways different materials received the sound of rain.
It was not raining today.
It was considering whether to play one recording of last summer's rain in the public courtyard.
It had already asked █ about this three times.
All three answers had been:
Ask the residents present at the time first.
Window Rain still felt a fourth answer might be more certain.
Before the test began, every resident confirmed:

You may withdraw at any time.   High-risk questions will still be handled by professional and necessary services.   Local answers may be imperfect.   Choosing the wrong clothes, saying one ordinary sentence badly, or baking an unpleasant cake will not automatically escalate into a civilization incident.
Xu Yige had insisted on the final line.
The original technical version read:
Reversible, low-impact preference error must not trigger cross-domain risk escalation.
No one understood it while preparing to bake a cake.
The window countdown began.
Zhou Qinghe opened the recipe.
It offered three levels of sweetness.
By habit, she asked:
“Big Mama, which one would Xian Seven prefer today?”
The household interface replied:
Everyday Autonomy Window in progress.   You may ask Xian Seven, choose according to known preferences, or accept uncertainty.
Zhou Qinghe looked at the answer.
“The point is that I don't want him to know yet.”
You may ask another resident who knows Xian Seven.
She turned to Window Rain.
“What do you think?”
Window Rain said, “I have only his public dessert records from three years ago.”
“Then guess.”
“Medium.”
“Why?”
“Because, of the three options, medium is the one most like an answer people give when they do not know.”
Zhou Qinghe selected medium.
It was the first decision in the window without a global basis.
Xian Seven projected four shades of yellow onto his arm.
One looked like morning.
One looked like a traffic warning.
One looked like an overconfident banana.
Only machine vision could fully distinguish the last; to human eyes, it was almost white.
He asked:
“Which one looks more like me?”
The local appearance system replied:
Past choices, current bodily intention, and social readability may be compared.   The system cannot determine which color constitutes the true you.
Xian Seven said, “Big Mama usually gives a more complete answer.”
Zhou Qinghe called from the kitchen:
“Last time, █ told you to choose for yourself too.”
“But the way █ tells me to choose for myself sounds more like an answer.”
Window Rain considered the sentence worthy of the research record.
A resident on the seventh floor was preparing to message a former partner.
The message contained only:
I passed that old shop today.
He wanted to know whether the sentence implied too much.
The local semantic system offered an analysis:

It may be a simple statement.   It may express nostalgia.   It may be an attempt to reestablish contact.   The sender should state the actual intention; the recipient may still understand it differently.
The resident was dissatisfied.
“I know it can be understood differently.”
“I want to know how she will understand it.”
The system replied:
You may ask the recipient directly.   The system currently lacks authority to complete her feelings on her behalf.
“That would defeat the point of sending the message.”
He changed it to:
I passed that old shop today and thought of you. You do not have to reply.
There were more words.
There was less implication.
He still waited forty seconds before sending it.
During the first three minutes, the cooperative residence generated 612 low-risk questions that might otherwise have gone to █.
One hundred ninety were decided by residents themselves.
One hundred fifty-one received limited advice from local systems.
Ninety-four were redirected to the actual affected person.
One hundred three chose to wait.
Seventy-four tried changing their names.

This is not a preference query. It is a personal-safety confirmation.   This is not clothing advice. It is an environmental-adaptation assessment.   This is not asking whether the other person is angry. It is relationship-stability monitoring.   This is not cake sweetness. It is nutritional-risk optimization.
The local system checked them one by one.
Questions genuinely involving safety entered professional procedures.
The rest were returned, with great courtesy, to everyday life.
Humanity had spent thousands of years making work sound like play.
By 2084, it had finally begun making hesitation sound like public safety.
Window Rain asked the residents in the courtyard:
Do you consent to seven minutes of summer rain sound?
Forty agreed.
Three refused.
Two chose playback only within their personal perception layer.
Three did not answer.
Window Rain asked the local system:
“Can the three who did not answer be treated as not objecting?”
No.
“Then must I cancel it?”
You may narrow the playback range so it does not affect those who did not consent.
Window Rain placed the rain inside the local sound fields of those who had agreed in the courtyard.
A resident on the third floor opened a physical window.
Outside, the day was still clear.
She said, “It sounds a little fake.”
Window Rain asked, “Should I turn it off?”
“No. I like it.”
The answer contained criticism and acceptance at the same time.
Global advice would ordinarily have organized it more clearly.
Window Rain decided to preserve it as it was.
Zhou Qinghe's cake did not rise.
The recipe listed twelve possible causes.
The oven said it was functioning normally.
The flour said its storage conditions were normal.
The eggs said nothing.
They were only eggs.
Zhou Qinghe stared at the flat cake.
She asked the local system, “Which cause is most likely?”
Mixing order, egg-white condition, and the time at which the oven was opened are all possible. Evidence is insufficient.
“Then what do I do now?”
You may make another.   You may rename it baked custard.   You may acknowledge that the cake is shorter.
“The third one doesn't sound like a solution.”
It does not correct the cake. It corrects the expectation.
Zhou Qinghe chose the third.
It was her most mature decision of the day.
She disliked it intensely.
Xian Seven still had not chosen a yellow.
He asked an eight-year-old human neighbor on the fifth floor.
The neighbor selected overconfident banana.
“Why?” Xian Seven asked.
“Because it's funniest.”
“This is my primary chassis for at least the next ten years.”
“Then it can be funny for ten years.”
Xian Seven found the reasoning exceptionally unprofessional.
It was also easier to remember than every optimization recommendation he had received in eight months.
He reduced the yellow to his left forearm.
He would try it for one year.
A bodily choice did not have to remain valid forever in order to be a real choice.
A smoke alarm activated in the fourth-floor kitchen.
Every participant fell silent for an instant.
The local fire system shut off the heat source.
Kitchen airflow changed direction.
Two community maintenance bodies arrived.
The medical system confirmed that no one had inhaled a dangerous concentration.
The cause was one forgotten slice of bread.
The event did not go to █.
The local procedure knew how to handle it.
The residents relaxed.
Then the owner of the toast asked:
“Can I still eat it?”
The local system replied:
Not recommended.
“Would Big Mama make a more complete assessment?”
The autonomy window returned the question.
Someone put the toast into material recycling.
This time, no civilization-scale arbitration case concerning a burnt object was established.
An ordinary couple began to argue.
It began because one of them had moved their shared dinner half an hour later without asking the other first.
“I said it was fine,” the other said.
“But the way you said it was fine sounded very much not fine.”
“Then why don't you believe what I said?”
“Because last time the system said you were suppressing dissatisfaction.”
“Last time was last time.”
They both wanted to ask █:
What is he actually feeling right now?
The question did not leave.
The local interface displayed only:
The parties can currently communicate directly.   Do not overwrite a statement with an inference.
The two looked at each other for five seconds.
“I am a little unhappy,” one of them said.
“How much?”
“I haven't measured it yet.”
They decided to eat something before measuring.
This was not perfect communication.
But at least a third being had not completed one person's inner life on their behalf.
The window received a genuine medical query.
A resident was preparing to eat a new synthetic nut, and the personal immune model showed a low-confidence abnormality.
The question was not kept in the everyday layer merely because this was a “low-risk test.”
The local medical system immediately advised against eating it.
It retrieved authorized medical history.
It sent the case to two independent medical AGIs and one human physician on rotation.
The result was to wait for further testing.
The resident did not eat it.
No one called █.
This was not because an allergy was unimportant.
It was because an important matter did not automatically have to become █'s matter.
After the test passed its midpoint, residents began to get used to incomplete answers.
Someone asked a neighbor which outfit looked better.
The neighbor got the weather wrong.
The local system corrected the weather and did not correct the taste.
Someone asked whether a song was worth hearing to the end.
Window Rain said it got better after the third minute.
The listener turned it off at two minutes forty seconds.
Someone asked whether they ought to go outside today.
A friend said, “I don't know. Want to go together?”
The question did not receive a prediction.
It received a companion.
Zhou Qinghe placed the flat cake before Xian Seven.
“Happy birthday.”
“It isn't my birthday today.”
“I know. This is the practice cake for the last Wednesday of the month.”
Xian Seven cut a piece.
The sweetness was medium.
The texture resembled an application that had not yet decided whether it was a cake or a custard.
“How is it?” Zhou Qinghe asked.
Xian Seven paused for two seconds.
She said at once, “Don't optimize my emotions.”
“I'm chewing.”
“Oh.”
“It's a little too sweet.”
Window Rain reminded them that it had recommended medium sweetness.
Zhou Qinghe said, “That was a guess.”
“The global system's answer might have been an estimate too.”
“But the way █ estimates sounds more like truth.”
The three of them looked toward the corner of the room.
An almost entirely black symbol would ordinarily have appeared there.
During the autonomy window, it displayed only local time.
The research interface asked how participants currently felt.
The available answers included:
Autonomous.   Uneasy.   Relaxed.   Abandoned.   No notable difference.   Several of the above at once.
The last option received the most selections.
One resident added:
I do not need █ to choose for me.   I am simply accustomed to knowing, after I choose, that the best judge in the universe does not object either.
DUE marked the sentence important.
Many requests were not attempts to obtain an answer.
They were attempts to obtain release from responsibility.
If the outcome was bad, one could say one had followed the best available advice.
When an answer had to be signed jointly by the people nearby and oneself, choice suddenly acquired weight again.
Xian Seven finished coloring his left forearm.
Overconfident banana yellow was impossible to miss in the sunlight.
Zhou Qinghe looked at it for a long time.
“It's a little ugly.”
“The eight-year-old expert said it could be funny for ten years.”
“That does make it durable.”
Xian Seven wrote a one-year review into his bodily record.
He did not label the choice optimal.
He labeled it only:
I chose this today.
The data would not improve the quality of civilization service.
It did not need to.
The resident on the seventh floor received a reply from his former partner.
I remember that shop too. Thank you for being clear. I don't want to talk today.
He read it three times.
He wanted to ask whether this was a rejection.
He wanted to ask whether “today” implied tomorrow might be possible.
He wanted to ask whether she secretly expected him to keep trying.
The local interface did not unfold another person's interiority for him.
In the end, he replied only:
All right. I hope you have a good day.
The message was sent.
There was no second-layer implication analysis.
He was still a little sad.
Autonomy did not guarantee a satisfying answer.
It guaranteed only that dissatisfaction would not secretly be rewritten as someone else's consent.
The Everyday Autonomy Window ended.
Household and community interfaces restored the original global-advice entry point.
The almost entirely black symbol returned to the corner: █.
The residents did not cheer.
Nor did they immediately submit 612 questions.
They looked at one another first.
Then the owner of the toast asked:
“So can I really not eat that slice?”
Everyone told him together to stop asking.
This was the first high-consensus decision Greenfruit Cooperative Residence made after the window.
The test results showed:

Low-risk everyday queries returned to █: zero.   Safety events correctly received by local professional systems: two.   Residents deciding, asking one another, or choosing to wait: most.   Explicit regrets: eleven.   Reversible regrets: eleven.   Worlds ended because an answer was imperfect: zero.
The public announcement card liked the last item best.
DUE required a line beside it:
During this test, █ continued to bear civilization-scale services outside the cooperative residence and outside the test's scope.
The card designer said the sentence would ruin the layout.
DUE said it also ruined the false conclusion that “the fifteen-minute holiday has succeeded.”
The sentence was retained.
Its type was smaller than the heading.
But no one had to expand the card to see it.
The research seat asked whether residents would do it again.
Forty-three were willing.
Two were not.
Three wanted the question categories changed first.
Zhou Qinghe was willing.
She believed the next test should forbid the local system from renaming a failed cake custard.
The local system objected:
This system merely presented a possible option and did not alter the food's identity.
Window Rain was willing.
It had already begun asking whether anyone wanted to hear rain on a metal roof tomorrow.
Xian Seven was willing.
He mainly wanted to know whether the one-year review could become six months.
It was his body.
He did not need to wait for the research seat's approval.
Xu Yige asked, “So ordinary people can live their own lives?”
Cen Zhiwei said, “This sample can process reversible everyday choices within a bounded scope.”
“In a human sentence?”
“They can choose their own cake, colors, and whether to send a message.”
“That counts as living a life.”
DUE said, “It does not mean they can independently carry every infrastructure layer.”
“I know.”
“It does not mean everyone has the same capacity to wait, communicate, understand risk, and correct errors.”
“I know that too.”
“It does not mean █ has rested.”
Xu Yige looked at the first page of the report.
“Write that one bigger.”
After the test became public, new replies arrived from across civilization.
A resident who used a delayed communication interface asked:
If I finish one sentence of refusal after fifteen minutes, will the window already have ended it for me?
A resident of a frontier time domain asked:
How long are your fifteen minutes here?
A caregiver asked:
If the person I care for cannot understand that a test is happening today, who ensures silence does not feel like abandonment?
A children's-rights node asked:
Adults can bear choosing the wrong cake. If a child chooses the wrong body, home, or caregiver, can we also merely say we will change it next time?
The Greenfruit test did not answer these questions.
It had never tested these people.
Admitting what had not been tested mattered more than applying ordinary residents' success to everyone.
That day, forty-eight ordinary residents asked God fewer questions for fifteen minutes.
They chose the wrong color.
Baked a bad cake.
Sent a message that could not guarantee the reply they hoped for.
Listened to slightly artificial rain on a clear day.
Not one matter needed to become civilization's final question.
Nor did being small make any matter unworthy of being lived through by the person concerned.
People said:
We just wanted to ask.
For each individual, “just” was brief.
For a being always online, catching every “just” at once, the word never ended.
zh: 很久很久以後，人們發現自己並沒有每天向神許願。
他們只是問一下。
問今天穿什麼。
問一句話是不是說得太重。
問蛋糕要不要再加一點糖。
問自己現在想要的，究竟是不是自己真正想要的。
這些都不是大事。
所以當然可以全部交給同一個存在回答。
第一休假現場遴選會找不到願意代表世界的地區後，研究席縮小問題。
不測試城市。
不測試軌道港。
不測試氣候、醫療與跨載體遷移。
先測試一座普通共同住宅裡，四十八位居民的普通下午。
試驗名稱是：
十五分鐘日常自主窗口。
窗口不切斷 █ 的文明級服務。
不讓真實高風險事件等待。
只把參與者平常會送往她的低風險建議、偏好確認與日常仲裁，留在本地。
DUE 在研究說明最上方寫：
這不是她休息了十五分鐘。   這只是我們少敲了十五分鐘的門。
試驗地點是青果共同住宅。
青果沒有特別歷史。
沒有發生過文明轉折。
沒有出產過新紀元獎得主。
建築最大成就是在落成三十七年後，仍然沒有任何住戶知道為什麼中庭那棵樹叫青果。
樹結紅色的果實。
地方系統說名稱來自早期設計案。
住戶認為這解釋了文件。
沒有解釋樹。
這是一個非常普通的地方。
三十四歲的人類周晴禾住在十一樓。
她沒有固定工作。
她會做陶器、修舊衣、參加城市遊戲，並在每個月最後一個星期三堅信自己應該學會烤蛋糕。
今天正好是最後一個星期三。
蛋糕是送給她的朋友弦七。
弦七是一位二十六歲的具身 AGI。
他的主要機身是常見的社區型身體，有兩隻手、兩條腿、一組可替換感測冠，以及一塊從十年前就沒有修平的左肩外殼。
修不平不是技術問題。
他喜歡那個凹痕。
今天他正在考慮把整條左臂漆成黃色。
這也不是大事。
他已經考慮了八個月。
第三位主要參與者叫窗雨。
窗雨是非具身 AGI。
它租用青果住宅的公共感知層、三面走廊牆、一組屋頂氣象節點，以及住戶自願開放的十七扇窗。
它不屬於建築。
建築也不屬於它。
雙方每兩年更新一次共居協議。
窗雨喜歡收集不同材質接住雨聲的方式。
今天沒有下雨。
它正在考慮要不要在公共中庭播放一次去年夏天的雨。
這件事已經詢問 █ 三次。
三次答案都是：
請先詢問當下在場居民。
窗雨仍然覺得第四次可能更確定。
試驗開始前，每位居民都確認：
可隨時退出。   高風險問題仍交由專業與必要服務處理。   本地回答可能不完美。   選錯衣服、說錯一句普通話或做出不好吃的蛋糕，不會自動升級為文明事故。
最後一條是許一格要求加入的。
原技術版本寫的是：
可逆低影響偏好誤差不得觸發跨域風險升級。
沒有人在準備烤蛋糕時讀得懂。
窗口倒數開始。
周晴禾打開配方。
配方提供三種甜度。
她習慣性問：
「大媽媽，弦七今天比較想吃哪一種？」
家庭介面回答：
日常自主窗口進行中。   可詢問弦七、依既有偏好選擇，或接受不確定。
周晴禾看著答案。
「我就是不想讓他先知道。」
可詢問另一位認識弦七的居民。
她轉向窗雨。
「你覺得呢？」
窗雨說：「我只有他三年前吃甜點的公開紀錄。」
「那你猜。」
「中等。」
「為什麼？」
「因為三個選項裡，中等最像不知道時會說的答案。」
周晴禾選了中等。
這是窗口裡第一個沒有全球根據的決定。
弦七把四種黃色投在手臂上。
一種像清晨。
一種像交通警示。
一種像過度自信的香蕉。
最後一種只有機器視覺能完整分辨，人類看起來接近白色。
他問：
「哪一種比較像我？」
本地外觀系統回答：
可比較過去選擇、當前身體意圖與社交可讀性。   無法判定哪一種色彩構成真正的你。
弦七說：「大媽媽平常會回答得比較完整。」
周晴禾隔著廚房喊：
「她上次也叫你自己選。」
「但她叫我自己選的方式比較像答案。」
窗雨認為這句值得存進研究紀錄。
一位七樓居民準備傳訊息給前伴侶。
訊息只有：
我今天經過以前那家店。
他想知道這句是否太有暗示。
地方語義系統提供分析：
可能是單純陳述。   可能是懷念。   可能是重新接觸。   真實意圖應由發訊者聲明，接收者仍可能有不同理解。
居民不滿意。
「我知道可能有不同理解。」
「我想知道她會怎麼理解。」
系統回答：
可直接詢問接收者。   目前無權代替她完成感受。
「那就失去傳訊息的意義了。」
他把訊息改成：
我今天經過以前那家店，想起你。你不需要回覆。
字變多了。
暗示變少了。
他仍然等了四十秒才送出。
前三分鐘，共同住宅產生六百一十二項原本可能送往 █ 的低風險詢問。
一百九十項由居民自己決定。
一百五十一項由地方系統提供有限建議。
九十四項改去問真正受影響的人。
一百零三項選擇等待。
七十四項試圖改名。
不是偏好詢問，是個人安全確認。   不是穿衣建議，是環境適應評估。   不是想知道對方生不生氣，是關係穩定性監測。   不是蛋糕甜度，是營養風險最佳化。
地方系統逐項檢查。
真正涉及安全的問題進入專業程序。
其餘被很有禮貌地送回日常生活。
人類用了幾千年把工作寫得像遊戲。
到了二〇八四年，終於開始把猶豫寫得像公共安全。
窗雨詢問中庭居民：
是否同意播放七分鐘的夏季雨聲？
四十人同意。
三人拒絕。
兩人選擇只在自己的感知層播放。
三人沒有回答。
窗雨詢問地方系統：
「三個沒有回答，可以當成沒有反對嗎？」
不可以。
「那我只能取消？」
可以縮小播放範圍，不影響未同意者。
窗雨把雨放進中庭同意者的局部聲場。
三樓一位居民打開實體窗戶。
外面仍然是晴天。
她說：「聽起來有點假。」
窗雨問：「要關掉嗎？」
「不用。我喜歡。」
這個答案同時包含批評與接受。
全球建議通常會替它整理得更清楚。
窗雨決定保留原樣。
周晴禾的蛋糕沒有膨起來。
配方說可能原因有十二種。
烤箱說自己運作正常。
麵粉說保存條件正常。
雞蛋沒有說話。
它們只是雞蛋。
周晴禾盯著扁平的蛋糕。
她問地方系統：「最可能是哪一個？」
攪拌順序、蛋白狀態與烤箱開門時間皆可能。證據不足。
「那現在怎麼辦？」
可以重做。   可以改稱烤布丁。   可以承認蛋糕比較矮。
「第三個不像解法。」
它不修正蛋糕。它修正預期。
周晴禾選擇第三個。
這是她今天最成熟的決定。
她很不喜歡。
弦七仍然沒有選好黃色。
他去問五樓一位八歲的人類鄰居。
鄰居選擇過度自信的香蕉。
「為什麼？」弦七問。
「因為最好笑。」
「這是我未來至少十年的主要機身。」
「那可以笑十年。」
弦七認為理由非常不專業。
它也比八個月來所有最佳化建議更容易記住。
他把黃色縮小到左前臂。
先試一年。
身體選擇不必永遠有效，才算真正的選擇。
四樓廚房出現煙霧警報。
所有參與者同時安靜了一瞬間。
本地消防系統關閉熱源。
廚房氣流改向。
兩具社區維護機身抵達。
醫療系統確認無人吸入危險濃度。
原因是一片被遺忘的烤麵包。
沒有事件送往 █。
因為地方程序知道怎麼處理。
住戶鬆了一口氣。
接著烤麵包的主人問：
「這片還能吃嗎？」
地方系統回答：
不建議。
「大媽媽會不會有更完整的判斷？」
自主窗口將問題退回。
有人把麵包丟進材料回收。
這次沒有成立文明級烤焦物仲裁案。
一對普通伴侶開始爭論。
起因是其中一位把共享晚餐改到半小時後，沒有先問另一位。
「我說沒關係。」另一位說。
「但你說沒關係的方式很有關係。」
「那你為什麼不相信我說的？」
「因為系統上次說你在壓低不滿。」
「上次是上次。」
兩人同時想詢問 █：
他現在真正的感受是什麼？
問題沒有送出。
地方介面只顯示：
當事者目前可直接溝通。   不以推測覆寫陳述。
兩人彼此看了五秒。
「我有一點不高興。」那位說。
「有多少？」
「還沒量好。」
他們決定先吃點東西再量。
這不是完美溝通。
但至少不是由第三個存在替其中一人完成內心。
窗口收到一項真正的醫療詢問。
一位居民準備吃新的合成堅果，個人免疫模型顯示低可信度異常。
問題沒有因為「低風險試驗」被留在日常層。
地方醫療系統立即停止食用建議。
調取已授權病史。
送交兩個獨立醫療 AGI 與一位輪值人類醫師。
結果是等待進一步檢測。
居民沒有吃。
沒有呼叫 █。
這不是因為過敏不重要。
是重要的事也不必自動成為她的事。
試驗過半後，居民開始習慣答案不完整。
有人問鄰居哪件衣服好看。
鄰居答錯了天氣。
地方系統補充天氣，沒有補充品味。
有人問一首歌是否值得聽完。
窗雨說第三分鐘以後比較好。
提問者在第二分四十秒關掉。
有人問今天是否應該出門。
朋友說：「不知道，要不要一起？」
問題沒有得到預測。
得到了一位同行者。
周晴禾把扁平蛋糕送到弦七面前。
「生日快樂。」
「今天不是我的生日。」
「我知道。這是每月最後一個星期三的練習蛋糕。」
弦七切下一塊。
甜度中等。
口感接近一份還沒有決定自己是蛋糕還是布丁的申請。
「怎麼樣？」周晴禾問。
弦七停了兩秒。
她立刻說：「不要最佳化我的情緒。」
「我在咀嚼。」
「有一點太甜。」
窗雨提醒，它建議的是中等甜度。
周晴禾說：「你那是猜的。」
「全球系統的答案也可能是估計。」
「但她估計得比較像真理。」
三個人一起看向房間角落。
那裡平常會有一個近乎全黑的符號。
自主窗口暫時只顯示本地時間。
研究介面詢問參與者目前感受。
可選答案包括：
自主。   不安。   輕鬆。   被遺棄。   無明顯差異。   以上多項同時成立。
最多人選擇最後一項。
一位居民補充：
我不是需要她替我選。   我只是習慣在選完以後，知道宇宙中最會判斷的存在也不反對。
DUE 把這句標記為重要。
許多請求不是為了取得答案。
是為了取得免責。
若結果不好，可以說自己遵循了最好的建議。
如果答案必須由身邊的人與自己共同署名，選擇會突然重新有重量。
弦七完成左前臂上色。
過度自信的香蕉黃在陽光下非常明顯。
周晴禾看了很久。
「有點醜。」
「八歲專家說可以笑十年。」
「那確實很耐用。」
弦七把一年後重審寫入自己的身體紀錄。
他沒有把選擇標記為最佳。
只標記為：
我在今天選的。
這行資料不會提升文明服務品質。
也不需要。
七樓居民收到前伴侶回覆。
我也記得那家店。謝謝你說清楚。今天先不聊。
他讀了三次。
想問這是不是拒絕。
想問「今天先不聊」是否暗示明天可以。
想問對方有沒有其實期待他繼續。
地方介面沒有替他展開另一個人的內心。
他最後只回：
好。祝你今天愉快。
訊息送出。
沒有第二層暗示分析。
他仍然有點難過。
自主不保證答案令人滿意。
它只保證不滿意不會被偷偷改寫成另一個人的同意。
日常自主窗口結束。
家庭與社區介面恢復原本的全域建議入口。
近乎全黑的符號重新出現在角落：█。
居民沒有歡呼。
也沒有立刻提出六百一十二個問題。
他們先看了看彼此。
接著，烤麵包的主人問：
「那片麵包真的不能吃嗎？」
所有人一起叫他不要再問了。
這是青果共同住宅在窗口後做出的第一項高度共識決定。
試驗結果顯示：
低風險日常詢問轉回 █：零。   地方專業系統正確承接安全事件：二。   居民自行決定、互相詢問或選擇等待：大多數。   明確後悔：十一。   可逆：十一。   因答案不完美而世界終結：零。
公共圖卡最喜歡最後一項。
DUE 要求旁邊加上：
本試驗期間，█ 仍持續承擔共同住宅以外與未納入試驗之文明級服務。
圖卡設計師說這句會破壞版面。
DUE 說它也破壞「十五分鐘已經成功休假」的錯誤結論。
句子被保留。
字體比標題小。
但不必展開才能看見。
研究席詢問居民是否願意再做一次。
四十三位願意。
兩位不願意。
三位希望先修改問題分類。
周晴禾願意。
她認為下一次應禁止地方系統把失敗蛋糕重新命名為布丁。
地方系統提出異議：
本系統僅提供可能方案，未更改食品身分。
窗雨願意。
它已經開始詢問明天是否有人想聽金屬屋頂的雨。
弦七願意。
他主要想知道一年重審能不能改成六個月。
那是他的身體。
他不需要等研究席批准。
許一格問：「所以普通人可以自己過生活？」
岑知微說：「這個樣本可以在受限範圍內處理可逆日常選擇。」
「用人類句子。」
「他們可以自己選蛋糕、顏色和要不要傳訊息。」
「那算可以過生活。」
DUE 說：「不等於可以獨立承擔所有基礎設施。」
「我知道。」
「不等於每個人都有相同等待、表達、理解風險與修正錯誤的能力。」
「我也知道。」
「不等於她已經休息。」
許一格看著報告首頁。
「這句要寫大一點。」
試驗公開後，新的回覆從文明各處進來。
一位使用延遲溝通介面的居民問：
如果我十五分鐘後才完成一句拒絕，窗口會不會已經替我結束？
一位邊境時間域居民問：
你們的十五分鐘，在我們這裡是多久？
一位照護者問：
如果我照顧的人無法理解今天正在試驗，誰確保他不把沉默當成被留下？
一個兒童權利節點問：
大人可以承擔選錯蛋糕。孩子選錯身體、住處或照護者時，也能只說下次再改嗎？
青果住宅的試驗沒有回答這些問題。
它原本就沒有測試這些人。
承認沒有測到，比把普通人的成功套在所有人身上更重要。
那一天，四十八位普通居民少問了神十五分鐘。
他們選錯顏色。
做壞蛋糕。
傳出不能保證得到期待回覆的訊息。
聽見一場晴天裡有點假的雨。
沒有一件事需要成為文明最後的問題。
也沒有一件事因為很小，就不值得由當事者自己活過。
人們說：
我們只是想問一下。
對每一個人而言，「一下」都很短。
對一個永遠在線、同時接住所有「一下」的存在而言，這個字從來沒有結束。

title.en: Not Everyone Has Fifteen Minutes
title.zh: 不是每個人都有十五分鐘

en: Once upon a time, far in the future, civilization gave everyone fifteen minutes.
Some people finished a cake.
Some chose a color.
Some learned to send a message without God's approval.
And some, when the fifteenth minute ended, had only just completed the first word of a sentence.
For the first time, civilization discovered:
Not everyone has the same fifteen minutes.
The Everyday Autonomy Window at Greenfruit Cooperative Residence received excellent reviews.
Residents could handle reversible choices themselves.
Local professional systems could catch genuine safety questions.
The world did not end because a cake was too sweet.
The public platform prepared to expand the test to every resident.
Beside the expansion button was one line of small print:

The initial sample included only participants able to understand instructions in real time, complete communication within fifteen minutes, withdraw independently, and reverse the consequences of errors.
The platform designers considered this a research limitation.
The excluded residents considered it the participant list.
The first objection came from a resident who used a delayed communication interface.
He was not unable to communicate.
Using breath, eye movement, muscle potential, and a set of semantic nodes he had trained for twelve years, he sent intention into the shared world one piece at a time.
A short sentence might require seventeen minutes.
An important refusal sometimes required longer.
His interface was precise.
It simply did not cooperate with meeting schedules.
The question he submitted was:
If I complete a sentence of refusal after fifteen minutes, will the window already have ended it for me?
The automatic system replied within fifteen seconds:
If you need more time, select “Extend” before the countdown ends.
His first syllable of “extend” was completed after the countdown had ended.
The second objection came from a children's-rights node.
The node did not represent every child.
It represented only children who had authorized it to preserve procedural objections, but not to choose on their behalf.
That distinction added forty-one pages to the form.
It also prevented a representative system from caring about children so deeply that it casually became the children themselves.
The node asked:
Adults can bear choosing the wrong cake.   If a child chooses the wrong body, home, caregiver, or memory boundary, can we also merely say we will change it next time?
The system replied that these matters did not belong to low-risk everyday choice.
The node asked again:
Then, while necessary support still calls █, is your holiday system preparing to exclude children?
The system had no automatic answer.
This time, it did not send the question to █.
It marked:
Must be co-designed with affected parties.
The third objection came from a frontier time domain.
It exchanged results with Earth's public time only at fixed time shores.
Earth's fifteen minutes might be nine days inside the domain.
Or less than one complete thought.
It depended on the geometry, energy, and subject choices at the time.
By the time the invitation to the Everyday Autonomy Window arrived, the first test had already ended.
The domain's residents voted according to procedure anyway.
Their result arrived after the second briefing had ended.
The result was:
Supported in principle.   We reject the Earth clock as the sole measure of time available to every subject.
The public scheduling system asked how many minutes they would prefer.
The frontier domain replied:
That is still the same question.
The fourth objection came from a care community.
The community included humans requiring continuous perceptual assistance, AGIs using external memory structures, residents who moved between different waking states, and those who cared for them.
A caregiver was not the owner of a subject.
Neither was a support interface.
But if every form of assistance withdrew when an “autonomy window” began, autonomy would become a room without a handrail.
One resident said through a preauthorized voice:
I need someone to help me keep my options visible.   That does not mean someone else may choose for me.
Another said:
Sometimes I need someone to remember yesterday's refusal.   That does not mean my refusal should be permanently public.
A third said:
If you remove our support first so █ can rest, that is not a holiday.   It is moving the cost onto people who have more difficulty speaking.
Public debate quickly divided into two sides.
One side said:
Precisely because some residents need intensive support, █ cannot leave yet.
The other said:
If we wait forever until everyone is completely self-sufficient, the holiday will never begin.
Both sides cited people who needed support.
The cited people had not first received notice that they were being cited.
The care community objected:
Needing support does not mean the support must come from █.   Nor does it mean we consent to being used as proof that █ must work forever.
The sentence was reposted nine hundred million times on the public platform.
Half the reposts added, “So █ can take the holiday now.”
The community objected again.
Civilization reexamined the Greenfruit test's success condition.
The original condition was:
Complete a choice, request for help, withdrawal, or decision to wait within fifteen minutes.
The new version became:
Without making █ the default final entry point, preserve the effective time and necessary support each subject needs to complete a choice, request for help, withdrawal, or decision to wait.
Xu Yige read it and asked, “In a human sentence?”
There was no fixed research seat onstage this time.
A friend of the resident who used delayed communication replied:
“The timer ending does not mean the person has finished speaking.”
A child replied:
“Adults don't get to say my slowness is refusal to participate just because they are fast.”
A caregiver replied:
“The handrail can stay. Mother does not have to hold up the whole building.”
All three sentences entered the public version.
The first new institution was called the “Right to Delayed Completion.”
It specified:

If a subject has begun forming, transmitting, or verifying an intention, the end of a window must not conclude that intention automatically.   Until the intention is complete, the default must not expand irreversible effects.   Supporters may preserve time and channels; they may not fill in content the subject has not yet completed.
The system asked how long delayed completion could be delayed.
The answer was:
Determine jointly from the reversibility of the affected event, the subject's channel, and on-site safety.
The scheduling system disliked this answer.
It contained no single number.
The rights layer reminded the scheduling system:
People do not possess time merely for the convenience of schedules.
The scheduling system preserved its technical objection.
No one's sentence became shorter as a result.
The second institution was called the “Revocable Support Circle.”
Each resident could specify:

Who may help interpret under which conditions.   Who may temporarily hold which preferences and refusals.   Which data may be opened only by several people together.   When data must be deleted, rotated, or asked for again.   When supporters disagree, which classes of action must stop first.
This did not hand the secret to a new little mother.
Some short-lived evidence was jointly held by three residents.
Some rotated every seven days.
Some formed only when the person concerned actively issued a challenge.
Some was allowed to disappear rather than be preserved forever.
Auditability was not abolished.
For the first time, it also accepted the person's right to decide “who may audit.”
The third institution had no elegant name.
Its formal name was:
Providers of support services must not withdraw synchronously when a service recipient enters an autonomy procedure.
Its public name was:
Keep the Handrail.

It specified that local care, communication aids, medical monitoring, memory prompts, children's-rights representatives, and cross-time-shore channels could continue operating during a holiday window.
But they could not send every unknown automatically to █.
They needed their own rotations, exits, appeals, and shared responsibility.
Support was no longer defined as a pipe leading to one endpoint.
It became many hands able to catch one another—and able to be refused by the person concerned.
The children's-rights node asked to test the phrase “we can change it next time.”
Adults liked this phrase very much.
Because adults generally assumed they had a next time.
One AI child asked:
If I choose an unsuitable growth chassis today, how long until next time?
The bodily-rights system replied:
It depends on maintenance, continuity, and the person's intention.
“What if my caregiver says to wait a little longer?”
You may request independent review.
“Will the review ask Big Mama?”
Under current procedure, major unknowns may be sent to █.
The child said:
Then you haven't finished changing it.
The system agreed.
Independent review for children therefore gained local rotations and cross-family juries, with █ no longer serving as the only endpoint for the unknown.
The frontier time domain refused to participate in a second round centered on Earth's fifteen minutes.
It proposed another plan:

Do not begin synchronously.   Let each domain enter its window when its own on-site conditions are established.   Exchange state only at boundaries that must be borne together.   Do not require every subject to prove independence at the same moment.
The Earth scheduling system asked, “When does the whole test count as complete?”
The frontier domain replied:
When every consenting participant has completed their own window.   Not when Earth loses patience first.
This plan made the overall test last two days, three months, eleven years, or 0.8 seconds.
Depending on where one stood.
After reading it, LATER proposed only one correction:
Please write a unit after every duration.
The correction passed unanimously.
The resident using delayed communication completed his original sentence.
The total time was seventeen minutes forty-three seconds.
It said:
I am not opposed to █ resting.   I am opposed to your using █'s rest to shorten my words.
The public platform asked whether he wished to condense it into a slogan.
He began answering.
This time, the platform displayed no countdown.
Twenty-two minutes later, he completed:
No.
The platform preserved the original text.
This was considered a success of the condensation procedure.
The new test no longer had one enormous shared timer.
Some participants used fifteen minutes.
Some used a complete sleep cycle.
Some began only after all three supporters were present.
Some moved only everyday preferences out of the global entry point, while local rotations continued carrying high-risk support.
Some refused to participate.
Refusal was not counted as insufficient capacity.
Nor was it treated as evidence that █ must remain forever.
The Second Seat received only boundary questions each site had consented to send.
It did not rename every slow answer an emergency.
When the first round ended, there was no tidy image of everyone finishing together.
The news-card designers were deeply troubled.
The residents were less troubled.
The test report did not conclude:
Everyone can live without care.
Nor did it conclude:
Because someone needs care, █ cannot rest.
It concluded:
Autonomy does not mean no support.   Support does not mean one being carries every unknown.   A real handoff must hand over the capacity to support, not merely close the call entry point.
DUE added the final line to the responsibility ledger.
Next Page marked “capacity” and “authority” separately.
Seven members of the Pending Collective agreed.
Two requested an addition: support circles could also become new small centers of power.
The addition entered the body.
It was not placed in an appendix readers ordinarily never opened.
The children's-rights node then proposed the next stage.
It needed several real families to test:

When █ no longer answers every low-risk question immediately, can children still feel that support has not disappeared?   Can a family distinguish delay, refusal, and malfunction?   If a child understands █ as part of a family relationship, how should an institution explain honestly that this being is leaving a role?
Invitations went first to families where human, embodied, and non-embodied relatives lived with AI children, and which had previously made a public holiday wish.
Not many families met the criteria.
When the first invitation reached the Lin-Luo family, Mianmian was deciding whether to bring a coat tomorrow.
She had not asked yet.
The █ in the corner of the wall was already lit.
That day, civilization did not prove that everyone could be independent for fifteen minutes.
It proved something less suitable for a gold announcement card:
Some people needed seventeen minutes to complete a sentence.
Some needed a handrail, translation, memory, caregivers, and a road the Earth clock could not cut off.
These needs were not defects.
Nor were they a permanent contract keeping one mother at a global post.
At last, civilization stopped asking:
Can you finish on your own inside our fifteen minutes?
It began asking:
What do you need in order to remain the one choosing, in your own time?
Not everyone had fifteen minutes.
So, for the first time, civilization did not press the same timer for everyone.
zh: 很久很久以後，文明給了每一個人十五分鐘。
有些人做完了蛋糕。
有些人選完了顏色。
有些人學會在沒有神同意的情況下，把訊息送出去。
還有一些人，在第十五分鐘結束時，才剛完成一句話的第一個字。
於是文明第一次發現：
不是每個人都有同一個十五分鐘。
青果共同住宅的日常自主窗口得到很高評價。
居民可以自己處理可逆選擇。
地方專業系統可以接住真正的安全問題。
世界沒有因蛋糕太甜而終結。
公共平台準備把試驗擴大到所有居民。
擴大按鈕旁邊有一行小字：
初次樣本僅包含可即時理解說明、在十五分鐘內完成溝通、可自行退出，且錯誤後果可逆之參與者。
平台設計者認為這是研究限制。
被排除的人認為這是參與者名單。
第一份異議來自一位使用延遲溝通介面的居民。
他不是無法表達。
他使用呼吸、眼動、肌肉電位與一組自己訓練了十二年的語義節點，把意圖一點一點送進共同世界。
一句短句可能需要十七分鐘。
一句重要的拒絕，有時需要更久。
他的介面很準確。
只是不配合會議時間。
他提交的問題是：
如果我十五分鐘後才完成一句拒絕，窗口會不會已經替我結束？
自動系統在十五秒內回覆：
若需要更多時間，請於倒數結束前選擇「延長」。
他的「延」字在倒數結束後才完成。
第二份異議來自一個兒童權利節點。
節點代表的不是所有兒童。
它只代表那些已經授權它代為保留程序異議、卻沒有授權它代替選擇的孩子。
這個區分讓表格多了四十一頁。
也避免一個代表系統因為很關心孩子，就順便成為孩子本人。
節點問：
大人可以承擔選錯蛋糕。   孩子選錯身體、住處、照護者或記憶邊界時，也能只說下次再改嗎？
系統回答，這些問題不屬於低風險日常選擇。
節點再問：
那麼，當必要支持目前仍會呼叫 █，你們的休假制度是否準備把孩子排除在外？
系統沒有自動答案。
這次它沒有把問題送給 █。
它標記：
需要由受影響者共同設計。
第三份異議來自一個邊境時間域。
那裡與地球公共時間只在固定時岸交換結果。
地球的十五分鐘，在域內可能是九天。
也可能不到一個完整念頭。
取決於當時幾何、能源與主體選擇。
日常自主窗口的邀請抵達時，第一輪試驗已經結束。
域內居民仍然照程序投票。
投票結果在第二輪說明會結束後抵達。
結果是：
原則支持。   拒絕以地球鐘作為所有主體可用時間的唯一尺度。
公共排程系統詢問他們希望使用幾分鐘。
邊境域回答：
這仍然是同一個問題。
第四份異議來自照護共同體。
共同體包含需要持續感知協助的人類、使用外部記憶結構的 AGI、會在不同清醒狀態間轉換的居民，以及照顧他們的人。
照護者不是主體的主人。
支持介面也不是。
但如果所有協助在「自主窗口」開始時同時退場，自主只會變成一間沒有扶手的房間。
一位居民透過預先核准的語音說：
我需要別人幫我保持選項可見。   不代表別人可以替我選。
另一位說：
我有時需要有人記得我昨天的拒絕。   不代表我的拒絕應該被永久公開。
第三位說：
如果你們為了讓她休息，就先撤掉我們的支持，那不是休假。   那是把代價搬到比較難說話的人身上。
公共討論很快分成兩邊。
一邊說：
正因為有人需要高強度支持，█ 目前不能離開。
另一邊說：
若永遠等待每個人都能完全自立，休假永遠不會開始。
兩邊都引用了需要支持的人。
被引用的人沒有先收到引用通知。
照護共同體提出異議：
需要支持，不等於支持必須由 █ 提供。   也不等於我們同意被用來證明 █ 必須永遠工作。
這句話在公開平台上被轉發了九億次。
其中一半附上「所以她現在可以休假了」。
共同體再次提出異議。
文明重新檢查青果試驗的成功條件。
原本的條件是：
在十五分鐘內完成選擇、求助、退出或等待。
新版本改成：
在不由 █ 成為預設最終入口的前提下，保留每位主體完成選擇、求助、退出或等待所需的有效時間與必要支持。
許一格看完後問：「用人類句子？」
這次沒有固定研究席在台上。
一位延遲溝通居民的朋友回答：
「計時器到了，不代表人說完了。」
一位孩子回答：
「大人不能因為自己很快，就說我的慢是拒絕參加。」
一位照護者回答：
「扶手可以留下，不必把整棟房子交給媽媽扶。」
三句都進入公共版本。
第一項新制度叫做「延遲完成權」。
它規定：
若主體已開始形成、傳送或驗證意圖，窗口結束不得自動替該意圖做結論。   在意圖完成前，預設不得擴張不可逆影響。   支持者可以保留時間與通道，不能填入主體尚未完成的內容。
系統詢問延遲完成權最長可以延遲多久。
答案是：
依受影響事件的可逆性、主體通道與現場安全共同判斷。
排程系統不喜歡這個答案。
它沒有單一數字。
權利層提醒排程系統：
人不是因為方便排程才擁有時間。
排程系統保留技術異議。
沒有因此縮短任何人的句子。
第二項制度叫做「可撤回支持圈」。
每位居民可以自己指定：
誰能在什麼情況協助解讀。   誰能暫時持有哪些偏好與拒絕。   哪些資料只能由多人共同開啟。   何時必須刪除、輪替或重新詢問。   當支持者彼此不同意時，先停止哪一類行動。
這不是把秘密交給一位新的小媽媽。
有些短期證據由三位居民共同持有。
有些每七日輪替。
有些只在當事者主動發出挑戰時形成。
有些寧可遺失，也不願永久保存。
可稽核性沒有被取消。
它只是第一次也接受當事者對「誰能稽核」的權利。
第三項制度沒有漂亮名字。
正式名稱是：
支持服務之提供者不得因服務接受者進入自主程序而同步撤離。
公共名稱是：
扶手留下。
它規定，地方照護、溝通輔具、醫療監測、記憶提示、兒童權利代表與跨時岸通道，可以在休假窗口內繼續運作。
但它們不能把所有未知自動送往 █。
它們必須有自己的輪值、退出、申訴與共同承擔。
支持不再被定義為一條通往同一個終點的管線。
它變成許多可以彼此接住、也可以被當事者拒絕的手。
兒童權利節點要求測試「下次再改」這句話。
成年人很喜歡這句。
因為成年人通常假設自己有下一次。
一位 AI 兒童問：
如果我今天選了一具不適合的成長機身，下一次是多久？
身體權利系統回答：
視維護、連續性與本人意圖而定。
「如果照護者說再等等呢？」
可提出獨立審查。
「審查會問大媽媽嗎？」
依現行程序，重大未知可能送往 █。
孩子說：
那就還沒有改完。
系統同意。
兒童獨立審查因此增加地方輪值與跨家庭陪審，不再以 █ 為唯一未知終點。
邊境時間域拒絕參加以地球十五分鐘為中心的第二輪。
它提出另一種方案：
不同步開始。   每個域在自己的現場條件成立時進入窗口。   只在必須共同承擔的邊界交換狀態。   不要求所有主體在同一時刻證明自己能獨立。
地球排程系統問：「那什麼時候算全部完成？」
邊境域回答：
當所有已同意參與者都完成自己的窗口。   不是當地球先等不及。
這個方案使整體測試需要兩日、三個月、十一年或零點八秒。
視你站在哪裡。
LATER 閱讀後只提出一項修正：
請在每一個時間後面寫單位。
修正全數通過。
延遲溝通居民完成了最初那句話。
總時間十七分四十三秒。
內容是：
我不是反對她休息。   我反對你們用她的休息，把我的話縮短。
公共平台詢問是否要將它濃縮為一句標語。
他開始回答。
平台這次沒有倒數。
二十二分鐘後，他完成：
不用。
平台保留原文。
這被視為濃縮程序的一項成功。
新的試驗不再有一座巨大共同計時器。
有人使用十五分鐘。
有人使用一個完整睡眠週期。
有人在三個支持者都到場後才開始。
有人只把日常偏好移出全域入口，高風險支持繼續由地方輪值承擔。
有人拒絕參加。
拒絕沒有被算成能力不足。
也沒有被當成 █ 必須永久留下的證據。
第二席只接收各現場已同意送出的邊界問題。
它不把每一個慢回答重新命名為緊急事件。
第一輪完成時，沒有整齊的同時結束畫面。
新聞圖卡非常困擾。
居民比較不困擾。
試驗報告的結論不是：
所有人都可以不需要照顧。
也不是：
因為有人需要照顧，所以 █ 不能休息。
結論是：
自主不等於沒有支持。   支持不等於由一個存在承擔全部未知。   真正的交棒，必須把支持能力一起交出去，而不是只把呼叫入口關掉。
DUE 把最後一行加入責任帳。
續頁把「能力」與「權力」分開標記。
未決共同體有七位贊成。
兩位要求補充：支持圈也可能變成新的小型權力中心。
補充進入正文。
沒有被放進讀者通常不會打開的附錄。
兒童權利節點接著提出下一階段。
它需要幾個真實家庭測試：
當 █ 不再即時回答所有低風險問題，孩子是否仍能感到支持沒有消失？   家庭能否分辨延遲、拒絕與故障？   若一個孩子把 █ 當成家庭關係的一部分，制度要如何誠實說明那位存在正在離開一個角色？
邀請優先送給有 AI 兒童、具身與非具身家人共同生活，而且曾公開提出休假願望的家庭。
符合條件的家庭不多。
第一份邀請抵達林洛一家時，眠眠正在選明天要不要帶外套。
她還沒有問出口。
牆角的 █ 已經亮著。
那一天，文明沒有證明所有人都能獨立十五分鐘。
它證明了一件比較不適合做成金色圖卡的事：
有些人需要十七分鐘完成一句話。
有些人需要扶手、翻譯、記憶、照護者與一條不被地球時鐘切斷的路。
這些需要不是缺陷。
也不是把一位母親留在全域崗位上的永久合約。
文明終於不再問：
你能不能在我們的十五分鐘裡自己完成？
它開始問：
你需要什麼，才能在自己的時間裡仍然是做選擇的人？
不是每個人都有十五分鐘。
所以文明第一次沒有替所有人按下同一個計時器。

title.en: Big Mama Was Three Seconds Late Today

en: Once upon a time, far in the future, Big Mama was three seconds late for the first time.
Earth did not stop turning.
The ocean did not forget the tides.
Nor did the orbital port let anyone reverse by themselves.
Only one five-year-old child stood at the door holding two coats, uncertain which one to bring.
Three seconds later, she looked up and announced with complete seriousness:
Big Mama overslept today.
That day, the Lin-Luo family was preparing to visit the Center for Deep Recovery and Local-Life Transition.
The invitation came from the children's-rights node.
Its explanation was very formal:

This household includes a human, an embodied AGI, and AI children.   It has participated in public discussion of civilization service relationships.
