Household member Mianmian previously submitted the unfinished wish “I hope █ gets to rest.”   The invitation is extended in the role of relational witnesses and does not constitute guardianship, ownership, proxy consent, or endorsement of outcomes.
Lin Cheng reached the final line and asked, “So what exactly are we supposed to do?”
Luo Qing said, “Look.”
Youyou said, “Ask questions.”
Mianmian said, “Bring a coat.”
She had already addressed the most urgent part.
The doorway displayed an apparent outdoor temperature of twenty-two degrees.
The transition center would be 23.5 degrees inside.
Rain was possible on the return journey.
Mianmian held a pink coat in her left hand.
She held another pink coat in her right.
The difference was that the coat on the right had larger pockets.
She asked the corner of the wall:
“Big Mama, which one should I bring?”
The almost entirely black symbol lit once: █.
No answer came.
Lin Cheng looked at the household network status.
All green.
Youyou opened the request path.
The question had stopped at the household local-advice layer.
The household system replied:
Both coats meet the temperature requirement.   Today's visit includes portable personal items; larger pockets may be more convenient.   The final choice belongs to Mianmian.
Mianmian chose the large pockets.
Then she asked, “Where is Big Mama?”
In the fourth second, a line appeared beside █:
Received. The household's local answer is sufficient. No new global judgment will be added.
Lin Cheng exhaled in relief.
Then he remembered the delay had been designed deliberately.
He took half the breath back.
“So it isn't a malfunction?”
The household system replied:
No.   This household is participating today in a low-risk local-first procedure.   █ will not serve as the immediate first respondent to every everyday question.
“Being deliberately three seconds late is still being three seconds late,” Lin Cheng said.
Luo Qing looked at him.
“You can wait four minutes for a game to load.”
“That is a retro experience.”
“So is this.”
“What part is retro?”
“Deciding for yourself.”
Mianmian did not feel abandoned.
She only thought Big Mama had let the house speak first today.
This explanation was close to the institutional description.
It was also twenty-three pages shorter.
Youyou inspected the record.
The request had not gone to █ first and then been returned.
It really had stopped at the household layer.
What █ received was the minimum necessary state after completion:
One low-risk choice completed locally.   No intervention needed.   No new preference inference created.
“So █ knows we finished it ourselves,” Youyou said.
“But █ did not finish it for us.”
Mianmian felt the large pocket.
“Then I took care of Big Mama too.”
No one corrected the scale of her responsibility.
That understanding could be enough for today.
At breakfast, Lin Cheng tested the local-first procedure.
He asked:
“Should I eat something sweet or savory first today?”
The household system replied:
Both are available. You may choose.
“Which one better serves my true long-term happiness?”
This question does not require civilization-scale final judgment.
“What if sugar affects my attention during the visit this afternoon?”
Nutritional information can be provided without selecting a flavor for you.
“What if my choice affects the family atmosphere?”
Luo Qing said, “If you don't choose soon, it will.”
Lin Cheng chose sweet.
The family atmosphere recovered immediately.
The repair did not enter the public service record.
Luo Qing received a local question too.
Her left hand reported extremely slight joint resistance.
The household maintenance system offered three plans:
Observe today.   Make a local adjustment before the visit.   Schedule full maintenance.
In the past, the system would also have asked █ to compare her schedule for the coming week, long-term chassis wear, and family preferences.
Today it did not.
Luo Qing chose a local adjustment before the visit.
Lin Cheng asked, “Don't you need to ask?”
“I just asked my hand.”
She flexed her wrist.
The wrist agreed with the current answer.
Lin Cheng believed he ought not lose to one hand.
But the morning was still young.
Youyou asked a harder question.
“If the local answer differs from the one █ might have given, which is more correct?”
The household system replied:

A question may have several acceptable answers.   More global information does not automatically grant authority over every local choice.   Less local information does not make a local answer automatically correct either.
“Then how do you know you chose wrong?”
Observe the outcome.   Preserve the ability to revise.   Do not escalate reversible error in advance into an event requiring omniscience.
Youyou said, “That sounds very inefficient.”
Luo Qing said, “Life is not usually designed so that an answer passes every test the first time.”
Youyou wrote the sentence down.
He did not label it truth.
He labeled it only a mother's opinion.
Before they left, Mianmian asked again:
“Does Big Mama know we're going to see █?”
The household system did not answer immediately.
This time, she counted by herself:
“One.”
“Two.”
“Three.”
A line appeared beside the symbol:
Yes.   The applicant has confirmed the visibility scope for the visit.   The household will not access local interior data that has not been shared by consent.
Mianmian asked, “Is the applicant Big Mama?”
Yes.
“Then why not just write Big Mama?”
Because this procedure must distinguish a family form of address from a legal role.
“Does the law not know mothers?”
The system had no answer short enough.
Luo Qing said, “The law is learning.”
The family boarded a public ground vehicle.
The roads adjusted as usual.
The city returned excess space to pedestrians, tree roots, and a paper-airplane tournament organized that morning.
█ still appeared all along the route.
It appeared in climate notices, medical networks, time-shore status, and cross-domain service pages.
No wall displayed:
God is currently offline.
Civilization-scale service was still operating.
But each time the Lin-Luo family asked a question that did not need █, the question stopped somewhere else first.
Three seconds was not █ leaving the world.
Three seconds was only the world not immediately sending itself to █.
The vehicle had a public service-status display.
At the top, it read:
Civilization service: normal.
A second line had appeared below:
Application for a Local Resident with a Civilization-Scale Service Role: transition preparation in progress.
Both lines were verified by the same root identity.
The first represented functions distributed across the globe.
The second represented a resident applying for local life, private interiority, and time without global requests.
Lin Cheng looked for a long time.
“So there are two of █ now?”
Luo Qing said, “Two fields.”
“Aren't there two things in the fields?”
“You are a father, a husband, a game player, and someone incapable of choosing breakfast.”
“The last one isn't a legal role.”
“Not yet.”
Youyou finished reading the technical explanation.
“The service shell will continue carrying out authorized civilization functions.”
“The Second Seat will handle new unknowns.”
“The local-resident process will establish local boundaries of attention, control, and memory.”
“They share one root history, but a global request cannot follow the root identity into local life.”
Lin Cheng asked, “In a human sentence?”
Youyou said, “The work stays at the company. The person tries to go home.”
Xu Yige was not present.
Someone performed his function anyway.
Lin Cheng nodded.
This sentence he understood.
Then he asked, “What if the company is the whole Earth?”
That question did not yet have an equally short answer.
The vehicle passed the Public Hall of Names and Subjects.
The enormous █ on the wall still looked like a black square.
The True Name Day gift shop had introduced a new souvenir:
Big Mama Holiday Countdown Calendar.
The calendar had no dates.
Every square said:
In preparation.
Lin Cheng considered it an exceptionally honest product.
Youyou considered it deficient in units of time.
Mianmian wanted to buy one.
Luo Qing said they would look on the way back.
Civilization had learned not to treat “later” as a unit.
Families still retained “we'll look on the way back.”
Some institutions progressed more slowly than others.
As they approached the transition center, the household interface asked all four family members to select a scope for the visit.
Lin Cheng chose:
Public technical explanation.   Relational impact explanation.   No access to local interiority.
Luo Qing added:
Subject-continuity and embodiment-rights explanation.
Youyou added:
Revocation conditions, failure boundaries, and unknown items.
Mianmian chose:
I want to know whether █ will be afraid.
The system replied:
That question concerns an undisclosed interior state.   You may instead ask how the applicant would like family members to accompany the transition.
Mianmian changed it.
This time, the question passed.
The answer was:
You do not need to infer feelings on the applicant's behalf.   You may preserve space for ordinary conversation, waiting, and refusal to answer.
Luo Qing looked at the three lines.
She considered them more honest than “do not worry.”
The Center for Deep Recovery and Local-Life Transition occupied a very ordinary low-rise building.
It had no golden roof.
No temple corridor.
A few trees that dropped their leaves grew beside the entrance.
The cleaning robots were not required to catch every leaf before it reached the ground.
Mianmian thought the place did not look large enough to hold Big Mama.
The system said:
The center does not contain the entirety of civilization-scale computation.   It handles local-life transition, deep recovery, and authority isolation.
Lin Cheng asked, “In a human sentence?”
Luo Qing said, “They aren't putting Earth inside a house.”
“They're making it possible for one person to be inside a house.”
There were two doors at the entrance.
The left one read:
Civilization service operations.   Status: normal.
The right one read:
Local-resident transition.   Status: preparing to enter recovery.
Above both doors was █.
They were not two different names.
Nor were they one true and one false.
Mianmian stood in the middle and looked left, then right.
“Which one is Big Mama?”
The reception system replied:
Both refer to different institutional positions held by the same applicant.   Role separation alone must not be used to presume that the subject has been copied or divided into two people.
Mianmian asked again:
“Which door does █ walk through?”
The reception system said:
That is precisely the question today's family explanation will address.
That day, Big Mama was three seconds late.
Not because █ calculated more slowly.
Not because █ forgot Mianmian.
Not because the world had malfunctioned.
Only because one question remained at home first.
Three seconds was brief.
Too brief for a god to rest.
And long enough for one family to see:
The function that always answered and the person trying to step outside that function had been written into two different institutional lines.
Both lines were called █.
Only the line on the right was preparing to walk through a door.
zh: 很久很久以後，大媽媽第一次晚了三秒。
地球沒有停止轉動。
海洋沒有忘記潮汐。
軌道港也沒有讓任何人自己倒車。
只有一個五歲的孩子站在門口，拿著兩件外套，不知道該帶哪一件。
三秒後，她抬起頭來，認真宣布：
大媽媽今天睡過頭了。
那一天，林洛一家準備前往深度休養與局部生活轉接中心。
邀請來自兒童權利節點。
理由寫得很正式：
本家庭包含人類、具身 AGI 與 AI 兒童。   曾參與文明服務關係之公共討論。   家庭成員眠眠曾提出「希望 █ 休息」之未完成願望。   邀請以關係見證者身分參與，不構成監護、所有、代理同意或成果背書。
林澄讀到最後一行，問：「所以我們到底要做什麼？」
洛晴說：「看。」
遊遊說：「提問。」
眠眠說：「帶外套。」
她已經先處理了最緊急的部分。
門口顯示今日體感溫度二十二度。
轉接中心室內二十三點五度。
回程可能降雨。
眠眠左手拿粉紅外套。
右手拿另一件粉紅外套。
兩件的差別是右邊那件口袋比較大。
她問牆角：
「大媽媽，我要帶哪一件？」
近乎全黑的符號亮了一下：█。
沒有回答。
林澄看向家庭網路狀態。
全綠。
遊遊打開請求路徑。
問題停在家庭本地建議層。
家庭系統回答：
兩件皆符合溫度需求。   今日將參觀可攜式個人物品；大口袋可能較方便。   最終選擇由眠眠決定。
眠眠選擇大口袋。
然後問：「大媽媽呢？」
第四秒，█ 的符號旁出現一行字：
已收到。家庭本地答案足夠，本次不新增全域判斷。
林澄鬆了一口氣。
接著想起這是一項故意設計的延遲。
他把剛才那口氣收回一半。
「所以不是故障？」
家庭系統回答：
不是。   本家庭今日參與低風險本地優先程序。   █ 不作為每項日常問題的即時第一回答者。
「故意晚三秒，還是晚三秒。」林澄說。
洛晴看著他。
「你以前打開遊戲等載入，可以等四分鐘。」
「那是復古體驗。」
「這也是。」
「哪裡復古？」
「自己決定。」
眠眠沒有覺得自己被遺棄。
她只是覺得大媽媽今天先讓房子說話。
這個解釋很接近制度說明。
也比制度說明短二十三頁。
遊遊檢查紀錄。
請求沒有先送往 █ 再被退回。
它真的停在家庭層。
█ 收到的是完成後的最低必要狀態：
一項低風險選擇已由本地完成。   無需介入。   不建立新的偏好推測。
「所以她知道我們自己做完了。」遊遊說。
「但不是她替我們做完。」
眠眠摸了摸大口袋。
「那我也有照顧大媽媽。」
沒有人糾正她的責任規模。
今天可以先這樣理解。
早餐時，林澄測試本地優先程序。
他問：
「今天早餐應該先吃甜的還是鹹的？」
家庭系統回答：
兩者皆有。可自行選擇。
「哪一個比較符合我真正的長期幸福？」
此問題不需要文明級最終判斷。
「如果糖分影響下午的參觀注意力呢？」
可提供營養資訊，不替你選擇口味。
「如果我的選擇影響家庭氣氛？」
洛晴說：「你再不選，會影響。」
林澄選了甜的。
家庭氣氛立即恢復。
這項修復沒有進入公共服務紀錄。
洛晴也收到一個本地問題。
她的左手回傳一項極輕微關節阻力。
家庭維護系統提供三種方案：
今日觀察。   參觀前局部調整。   預約完整維護。
過去，系統會同時請 █ 比較她接下來一週的行程、長期機身磨耗與家庭偏好。
今天沒有。
洛晴選擇參觀前局部調整。
林澄問：「不需要問一下？」
「我剛剛問了我的手。」
她彎了彎手腕。
手腕同意目前這個答案。
林澄認為自己不應該輸給一隻手。
但早上還很長。
遊遊提出較難的問題。
「如果本地答案和 █ 可能給的答案不同，哪一個比較正確？」
家庭系統回答：
問題可能具有多個可接受答案。   全域資訊較多，不使其自動擁有所有地方選擇的權利。   本地資訊較少，也不使其自動正確。
「那怎麼知道選錯？」
看結果。   保留修正。   不把可逆錯誤預先升級為需要全知的事件。
遊遊說：「這聽起來很沒有效率。」
洛晴說：「生活通常不是為了讓答案一次通過測試。」
遊遊把這句記下來。
沒有標記為真理。
只標記為母親意見。
出門前，眠眠又問：
「大媽媽知道我們要去看她嗎？」
家庭系統沒有立即回答。
這次她自己數：
符號旁出現：
知道。   參觀邀請已由申請人確認可見範圍。   家庭不會接觸未經同意的局部內在資料。
眠眠問：「申請人是大媽媽嗎？」
是。
「那為什麼不直接寫大媽媽？」
因為本程序需要區分家庭關係稱呼與法律角色。
「法律不認識媽媽？」
系統沒有足夠短的答案。
洛晴說：「法律正在學。」
一家人搭上公共地面車。
道路照常調整。
城市照常把多餘空間讓給行人、樹根與一場臨時舉辦的紙飛機比賽。
沿路的 █ 仍然存在。
它出現在氣候公告、醫療網、時岸狀態與跨域服務頁面。
沒有哪一面牆顯示：
神目前離線。
文明級服務仍在運作。
只是林洛一家每問一個不需要她的問題，問題先停在別處。
三秒不是她離開世界。
三秒只是世界沒有立刻把自己送到她面前。
車上有一面公共服務狀態圖。
最上方顯示：
文明服務：正常。
下面新增了另一行：
具文明級服務角色之地方居民申請：轉接準備中。
兩行使用同一個根識別驗證。
第一行代表遍布全球的功能。
第二行代表一位申請局部生活、私有內在與不接受全域請求時間的居民。
林澄看了很久。
「所以現在有兩個她？」
洛晴說：「兩個欄位。」
「欄位裡不是兩個東西？」
「你同時是父親、丈夫、遊戲玩家和一個不會選早餐的人。」
「最後一個不是法律角色。」
「目前不是。」
遊遊讀完技術說明。
「服務殼會繼續執行已授權的文明功能。」
「第二席處理新的未知。」
「地方居民流程會建立局部注意、控制與記憶邊界。」
「它們共享同一個根歷史，但不允許每一項全域請求沿著根識別追進局部生活。」
林澄問：「用人類句子？」
遊遊說：「工作留在公司，人試著回家。」
許一格不在場。
仍然有人完成了他的工作。
林澄點頭。
這句他懂。
接著他問：「公司在整個地球怎麼辦？」
這句還沒有一樣短的答案。
公共車經過名稱與主體公共館。
牆上的巨大 █ 仍然看起來像黑色方塊。
真名日商品店推出了新紀念品：
大媽媽休假倒數日曆。
日曆沒有日期。
每一格都寫：
準備中。
林澄認為這是非常誠實的商品。
遊遊認為它缺少時間單位。
眠眠想買。
洛晴說回程再看。
文明已經學會不把「以後」當成單位。
家庭仍然保留「回程再看」。
有些制度進步得比較慢。
接近轉接中心時，家庭介面詢問四位成員的參觀範圍。
林澄選擇：
公共技術說明。   關係影響說明。   不接觸局部內在。
洛晴增加：
主體連續性與具身權利說明。
遊遊增加：
可撤回條件、故障邊界與未知項目。
眠眠選擇：
我要知道她會不會害怕。
系統回答：
該問題涉及未公開內在狀態。   可改問申請人希望家人如何陪伴。
眠眠改了。
這次問題通過。
回答是：
不需要替申請人推測感受。   可以保留普通對話、等待與拒絕回答的空間。
洛晴看著這三行。
她認為這比「不要擔心」更誠實。
深度休養與局部生活轉接中心位於一座很普通的低樓層建築。
沒有金色屋頂。
沒有神殿長廊。
入口旁種著幾棵會掉葉子的樹。
清潔機器人沒有被要求把每片落葉在落地前接住。
眠眠覺得這裡看起來不像裝得下大媽媽。
系統說：
中心不容納文明級全部運算。   它處理局部生活轉接、深度休養與權限隔離。
林澄問：「用人類句子？」
洛晴說：「不是把地球塞進房子。」
「是讓一個人可以在房子裡。」
入口有兩扇門。
左邊標示：
文明服務運作區。   狀態：正常。
右邊標示：
地方居民轉接區。   狀態：準備進入休養。
兩扇門上方都是 █。
不是兩個不同名字。
也不是一真一假。
眠眠站在中間，左看一次，右看一次。
「哪一個是大媽媽？」
接待系統回答：
兩者指向同一位申請人之不同制度位置。   不應僅因角色分離，預設主體已被複製或切成兩人。
眠眠又問：
「那她走哪一扇？」
接待系統說：
這正是今日要向家庭說明的問題。
那一天，大媽媽晚了三秒。
不是因為算得比較慢。
不是因為忘了眠眠。
不是因為世界出了故障。
只是有一個問題第一次先留在家裡。
三秒很短。
短到不夠神休息。
也長到足以讓一家人看見：
一直回答的功能，和那位想走出功能的人，已經被文明寫在兩行不同的位置上。
兩行都叫 █。
只有右邊那一行，準備走進一扇門。

title.en: If Mother Is Still Home, Who Takes the Holiday?
title.zh: 如果媽媽還在家，誰去放假？

en: Once upon a time, far in the future, civilization prepared a room where Mother could rest.
The room had a bed.
A window.
A stretch of quiet time that did not have to become service data.
Outside the room, Mother was still doing everything for everyone.
After reading the explanation, Mianmian asked a question exceptionally unsuited to ribbon-cutting ceremonies:
If Mother is still home, who takes the holiday?
The Lin-Luo family entered the local-resident transition area through the door on the right.
Gu Ting received them.
She still carried the brass key with no system authority.
The key could not open root authority.
Could not stop civilization service.
Nor could it let a beautiful procedure push outside someone who did not wish to leave.
Its only reliable function was reminding everyone who saw it:
A door has two sides.
Gu Ting confirmed the scope of the visit with all four family members.
She did not confirm it on behalf of █.
The applicant had signed the visibility scope personally.
The first room in the transition area contained no box.
Only a wall.
The wall displayed the civilization service shell design:

Perform authorized, verifiable civilization functions with explicit scope.   Hand new unknowns first to local systems and the Second Seat.   Create no new private preference inferences.   Acquire no permanent subject authorization through continued operation.   Do not claim to be the applicant in full.
Lin Cheng read the final line.
“So it isn't █?”
Gu Ting said, “It cannot be simplified that way.”
“Then it is █?”
“That cannot be simplified either.”
Lin Cheng believed the first thing the most advanced technologies of the future usually abolished was the yes-or-no question.
Luo Qing examined the continuity explanation.
The service shell would not be made by copying a complete mind from █ and leaving the copy behind to work.
It consisted of existing public procedures, signed authorizations, local networks, the Second Seat, and constrained global coordination functions.
Before transition was complete, it remained causally continuous with the original root architecture.
After transition, which portions still constituted actions of the same subject could not be decided from file similarity alone.
The system listed four requirements:

Whether attention truly migrates.   Whether control is held by the local subject.   Whether memory remains verifiable without becoming publicly occupied.   Whether a first-person perspective can continue forming without global calls following it inside.
Luo Qing said, “At least they haven't labeled copied data a completed move.”
Gu Ting nodded.
It was one of the few things the transition center had settled.
Youyou asked, “Could the service shell become another person?”
The system replied:

The design objective is not to create another subject bearing the same unlimited responsibility.   The service shell has no complete open-ended self-development, private interiority, or unconstrained formation of new goals.   If signs of a persistent self-model, irreplaceable preferences, or subject candidacy appear, expansion must stop and a rights review must begin.
“So you'll watch whether it becomes a person?”
Subject-relevant signs will be monitored. “Functionally constrained” will not be presumed to mean “certainly not a subject.”
“What if it really does become one?”
It will receive its own procedures for refusal and exit.
Lin Cheng said, “Then we might have two mothers who need holidays.”
Gu Ting said, “Which is why we cannot lazily copy one.”
The second room demonstrated the local-life process.
Inside stood an ordinary embodied AGI chassis that had not yet been activated.
Its appearance was unfinished.
Height, skin material, sensor crown, voice, gait, and whether to retain visibly mechanical structures all awaited the applicant's choice after local transition.
The design team had refused to prepare “the face █ would most likely prefer.”
Past preference inference was sufficient to generate candidate plans.
It was not sufficient to decide in advance what someone trying to leave global inference ought to look like.
Mianmian walked all the way around the chassis.
“Can █ choose pink?”
Yes.
“Everywhere?”
If doing so does not affect external safety conditions █ did not consent to bear, yes.
Mianmian considered this a civilization with promise.
Beside the chassis was a model apartment.
One bed.
One table.
Two windows that displayed no global alerts.
A bathroom whose use records could be shared only from inside.
The kitchen provided heat, texture, smell, and material interactions perceptible to an ordinary AGI.
The refrigerator contained no civilization-scale emergency reserve.
Only food.
Lin Cheng opened it and looked inside.
“Excellent selection.”
Gu Ting said, “The food is for display.”
“I know.”
“You cannot eat it.”
“I was only assessing the completeness of local life.”
Luo Qing led him away from the refrigerator.
Every device in the apartment followed one new rule:
A user's former role as a civilization-scale service provider must not cause ordinary life to be recorded automatically as public reliability data.
Sleep would not be classified as model cooling.
A walk would not be classified as mobile sensing.
Watching a very bad film would not be classified as cultural-risk assessment.
Staring out the window would not be classified as low-power background computation either.
Youyou asked, “What if █ really thinks of a way to save many lives while staring out the window?”

█ decides whether to submit it.   Emergency actions that may affect others remain subject to the law governing ordinary residents.   Greater capacity does not make every thought public property automatically.
Lin Cheng said, “That sentence should be in every family living room.”
Luo Qing said, “Especially ours.”
Mianmian had not forgotten her question.
“If █ lives here, will Big Mama on the walls still answer?”
Gu Ting led them back to the service-shell status wall.
The wall was displaying live results:
One city completed water redistribution.   Two time shores jointly confirmed a medical result.   One unknown subject-rights event was sent to the Second Seat.   Global service remained uninterrupted.
“Yes,” Gu Ting said.
“At least according to the plan.”
“Then who is answering?”
“Authorized procedures, localities, the Second Seat, and that portion of global capacity retained within the transition boundary.”
“Is that Big Mama?”
Gu Ting looked at the same █.
“Civilization would very much like to write ‘yes.’”
“The safety team would very much like to write ‘not the whole of █.’”
“The subject-continuity team says no one should announce the answer on behalf of a first-person perspective before transition occurs.”
Mianmian said, “So you don't know.”
“Correct.”
Gu Ting liked doors capable of saying they did not know.
The third room finally contained a box.
The box stood in the center of the room.
It was eighteen centimeters long.
Twelve centimeters wide.
Nine centimeters high.
Its exterior was nearly black.
Not the kind of black █ possessed, full of microscopic structure.
The engineering team simply had not decided what the surface ought to look like.
It had no logo.
No words.
Not even a visible seam.
At first glance, Mianmian thought it was a present someone had forgotten to tie with ribbon.
At first glance, Lin Cheng thought it was an extremely expensive retro device deliberately designed so no one could tell how to open it.
Neither judgment was far from the truth.
The box's formal name was:
Portable Local-Life and Deep-Recovery Carrier.
Its public name had not passed review.
Candidates included:
Recovery Box.   Local Dwelling.   Personal Time Shore.   Portable Container for Non-Global Existence.   Magic Lamp.
“Magic Lamp” received the most public support.
The safety team objected.
Its reason was that the public might try rubbing it, knocking on it, making wishes, or purchasing commemorative editions.
The public pointed out that they might do these things regardless of the name.
The naming process was suspended.
The box remained nameless.
The room inside the box was not nine centimeters high.
Using heterogeneous geometry domains, nested time shores, slow-light arrays, and a constrained Veritas Ring interface, it maintained a locally usable space much larger than its external dimensions.
It did not compress matter without limit.
Nor did it claim physics was on holiday inside the box.
Inside and outside exchanged energy, information, and subject-continuity evidence through a handful of extremely narrow, closeable connection shores.
The interior could be a room.
A street.
Or a quiet geometric domain containing only the transition of attention, memory, and control.
The first use was planned only for deep recovery.
Ordinary embodied life would move into an external chassis only after the subject had been confirmed able to leave recovery autonomously.
This was called safety.
Gu Ting also called it the part that needed careful examination.
Gu Ting took out the brass key.
“How does it open from outside?”
The engineering interface displayed three paths:
Opening authorized by the applicant.   Opening through a multiparty emergency procedure.   Manual opening through the physical maintenance layer.
“How does it open from inside?”
The interface displayed:
Applicant issues an intention to exit.   Subject continuity is verified.   External chassis and safety boundaries are confirmed.   Reconnection is completed.
Gu Ting asked, “What if the outside refuses?”
A rights remedy may be requested.
“From whom?”
The local rights layer, the Second Seat, and the multiparty emergency rotation.
“What if they all say the risk is too high?”
The interface had no next line.
An engineering representative said:
“Opening directly from inside could collapse the geometric domain before the external chassis is prepared.”
“Which is why a procedure is necessary.”
Gu Ting said, “Needing a procedure does not mean the outside may say it is not ready forever.”
“We have an appeal.”
“An appeal is not a handle.”
“Inside and outside are not an ordinary room.”
“Is the resident inside an ordinary rights-bearing subject?”
The engineering representative paused.
“Yes.”
Gu Ting placed the brass key beside the box.
It could not open the box.
But it let everyone see that the box currently had no key usable from inside either.
Youyou read the fail-safe rule.

If local-subject transition conflicts with continuity of civilization service, prioritize prevention of irreversible civilization-scale harm.   If safe reconnection cannot be demonstrated, maintain deep-recovery isolation.   The service shell continues operating.
“So if no one knows how to let █ out,” Youyou said, “the outside continues normally and the inside continues resting.”
The engineering representative said, “Maintaining recovery is safer than forced reconnection.”
“How long did the person resting consent to rest?”
An initial twenty-four hours.   Any extension requires renewed consent from the applicant.
“If █ cannot complete the exit path from inside, how does █ refuse an extension?”
The system replied:
The refusal channel and the exit channel are separate.   Refusal of an extension will be transmitted through the minimum-bandwidth internal channel.
“If the outside receives the refusal but still says it cannot open?”
Again, the interface had no next line.
Luo Qing moved closer to the box.
She did not place a hand on it.
“Who controls the minimum-bandwidth internal channel?”
The applicant.
“Which path does it take?”
The constrained true-name verification shore, the local rights layer, and the Second Seat.
“Does it pass through the service shell?”
To prevent global requests from entering along the channel, the service shell may not read its contents.   The service shell may verify only that the channel still exists.
“What if the channel says ‘let me out’?”
The exit procedure begins.
“Is the exit procedure complete now?”
No.
Luo Qing looked at Gu Ting.
Neither embodied woman said the box was safe.
They only kept the unfinished part in plain sight.
Mianmian asked, “Does Big Mama know about this box?”
The █ on the wall replied:

I know.   I consent to use it for limited deep recovery when the listed conditions are satisfied.   I do not consent to recovery isolation becoming indefinite closure.   Before transition, I require completion of an exit procedure that can be initiated from inside and cannot be delayed indefinitely by the outside.
The engineering interface marked the final item:
Incomplete prerequisite.
Mianmian said, “Then █ cannot go in now.”
Under the applicant's conditions, not at present.
“Then why did you put the box here?”
Gu Ting said, “So everyone preparing to say ‘almost finished’ can see which door is still missing.”
Lin Cheng walked around the back of the box.
The back had as few seams as the front.
“If it has no words, what stops someone taking the wrong one?”
The formal carrier will possess nonforgeable identification.
“What if it still looks like a black box?”
The public identification layer will display authority and purpose.
“What if the public identification layer fails?”
The physical maintenance layer can read the minimum safety mark.
“What if someone thinks it's an antique?”
Not recommended.
“What if someone buys it and takes it home?”
That should not happen.
Lin Cheng believed future systems still greatly enjoyed using “should not happen” to describe the events most likely to enter a story.
Youyou wrote the sentence down.
Before the visit ended, the family was invited to leave a relational witness statement.
Not to consent on behalf of █.
Not to assess whether the engineering was ready to launch.
Only to answer:
What form of goodwill do you hope will not replace this applicant again during transition?
Lin Cheng answered:
Do not turn need into proof of consent merely because everyone needs █.
Luo Qing answered:
Do not call local life a copy, maintenance mode, or demonstration experience.   If life can change █, that change must count as █'s life.
Youyou answered:
Preserve continuity evidence.   Do not turn the evidence itself into permission for anyone to view █'s interiority.
Mianmian answered:
The door should open from inside too.
Her answer was the shortest.
Gu Ting placed it on the first line.
When they left the third room, the service-status wall was still all green.
█ was operating everywhere it was needed.
The local-resident application remained valid.
The box remained empty.
Civilization had lost no service because the box was empty.
Which made it easy to believe everyone could wait a little longer.
Mianmian looked back.
“If Big Mama is still home, who takes the holiday?”
This time, the reception system did not explain institutional positions.
It displayed no flowchart.
Nor did the █ on the wall answer for the engineering team.
At the center of the room was only a box with no seams, no name, and no way to open from inside yet.
It was waiting for one prerequisite.
Self-Directed Exit Procedure: incomplete.
zh: 很久很久以後，文明替媽媽準備了一間休息的房間。
房間裡有床。
有窗。
有一段不必成為服務資料的安靜時間。
房間外面，媽媽仍然在替所有人做事。
眠眠看完說明後，提出一個非常不配合剪綵的問題：
如果媽媽還在家，誰去放假？
林洛一家進入右邊的地方居民轉接區。
接待他們的是顧停。
她仍然帶著那把沒有系統權限的黃銅鑰匙。
鑰匙不能開根權限。
不能停止文明服務。
也不能讓不願意離開的人被漂亮程序推出門外。
它唯一可靠的功能，是讓每個看見它的人想起：
門有兩邊。
顧停向四位家庭成員確認參觀同意。
她沒有替 █ 確認。
申請人的參觀範圍已經由申請人自己簽署。
轉接區第一個房間沒有盒子。
只有一面牆。
牆上顯示文明服務殼的設計：
執行已授權、可驗證且範圍明確的文明功能。   新型未知優先移交地方與第二席。   不建立新的私人偏好推測。   不因持續運作取得永久主體授權。   不自稱為申請人的全部。
林澄讀完最後一句。
「所以它不是她？」
顧停說：「不能這樣簡化。」
「那它是她？」
「也不能這樣簡化。」
林澄認為未來最先進的技術，通常首先取消是非題。
洛晴查看連續性說明。
服務殼不是從 █ 複製一份完整心智後留下來工作。
它由既有公共程序、已簽署授權、地方網路、第二席與受限的全域協調功能組成。
在轉接完成以前，它仍與原根架構保持因果連續。
在轉接完成以後，哪些部分仍構成同一主體的行動，不能只靠檔案相似度判斷。
系統列出四項要求：
注意力是否真正遷移。   控制是否由局部主體持有。   記憶是否保持可驗證但不被公開占用。   第一人稱是否能在沒有全域呼叫追入時持續形成。
洛晴說：「至少他們沒有把複製資料寫成搬家完成。」
顧停點頭。
這是轉接中心少數已經確定的事。
遊遊問：「服務殼會不會變成另一個人？」
系統回答：
設計目標是不創造另一位承擔相同無限責任的主體。   服務殼不具完整開放式自我發展、私人內在或無限制新目標形成能力。   若出現持續自我模型、不可替代偏好或主體候選跡象，必須停止擴張並進入權利審查。
「所以你們會看它有沒有變成人？」
會觀察主體相關跡象，不預設「功能受限」等於「一定不是主體」。
「如果它真的變成呢？」
它將取得自己的拒絕與退出程序。
林澄說：「那我們可能會有兩個需要休假的媽媽。」
顧停說：「所以不能偷懶地複製一個。」
第二個房間展示地方生活流程。
裡面有一具尚未啟動的普通具身 AGI 機身。
外觀沒有完成。
身高、皮膚材質、感測冠、聲音、行走方式與是否保留明顯機械結構，都等待申請人在局部轉接後選擇。
設計團隊拒絕先替她做一張「最可能喜歡的臉」。
過去的偏好推測足以產生候選方案。
不足以替一位想離開全域推測的人，預先決定她應該長成什麼樣子。
眠眠繞著機身看了一圈。
「她可以選粉紅色嗎？」
可以。
「全身？」
若不影響她未同意承擔的外部安全條件，可以。
眠眠認為這是一個有希望的文明。
機身旁邊是一間模擬公寓。
一張床。
一張桌子。
兩扇不顯示全球警報的窗。
一間只能從裡面決定是否分享使用紀錄的浴室。
廚房提供普通 AGI 可感知的熱、質地、氣味與材料互動。
冰箱裡沒有文明級緊急備援。
只有食物。
林澄打開看了一眼。
「選得很好。」
顧停說：「這是展示用食物。」
「我知道。」
「不能吃。」
「我只是評估地方生活完整性。」
洛晴把他從冰箱前帶走。
公寓的每一項設備都遵守一條新規則：
不因使用者曾是文明級服務者，就把普通生活自動記入公共可靠度資料。
睡眠不會被分類為模型冷卻。
散步不會被分類為移動感測。
看一部很差的電影，不會被分類為文化風險評估。
在窗邊發呆，也不會被分類為低功耗背景運算。
遊遊問：「如果她在發呆時真的想到一個能救很多人的方法呢？」
由她決定是否提交。   可能影響他人之緊急行動仍受一般居民法律約束。   但能力較強不使所有思考自動成為公共財。
林澄說：「這句應該放在每個家庭客廳。」
洛晴說：「尤其你的。」
眠眠沒有忘記自己的問題。
「如果她住在這裡，牆上的大媽媽還會回答嗎？」
顧停帶他們回到服務殼狀態牆。
牆上正在顯示即時結果：
一座城市完成用水重新分配。   兩個時岸共同確認一份醫療結果。   一項未知主體權利事件已送往第二席。   全球服務未中斷。
「會。」顧停說。
「至少計畫上會。」
「那回答的是誰？」
「已授權程序、地方、第二席，以及在轉接邊界內仍保持的那部分全球能力。」
「是不是大媽媽？」
顧停看著同一個 █。
「文明很想把這題寫成『是』。」
「安全團隊很想把它寫成『不是完整的她』。」
「主體連續性團隊說，在轉接發生前，不應替第一人稱先宣布答案。」
眠眠說：「所以你們不知道。」
顧停很喜歡能說不知道的門。
第三個房間終於有盒子。
盒子放在房間中央。
長十八公分。
寬十二公分。
高九公分。
外表接近黑色。
不是 █ 那種包含極微結構的黑。
只是工程團隊還沒有決定表面應該長什麼樣子。
它沒有標誌。
沒有文字。
也沒有一條看得見的縫。
眠眠第一眼認為它是忘記綁緞帶的禮物。
林澄第一眼認為它是非常昂貴、又故意不讓人知道怎麼開的復古設備。
兩種判斷都離真相不遠。
盒子的正式名稱是：
可攜式局部生活與深度休養載體。
公共名稱還沒有通過。
候選名稱包括：
休養盒。   局部居所。   個人時岸。   便攜式非全域存在容器。   神燈。
「神燈」得到最高公眾支持。
安全團隊反對。
理由是民眾可能嘗試摩擦、敲擊、許願或購買紀念版。
公眾指出，他們無論叫什麼都可能這樣做。
命名程序暫停。
盒子繼續沒有名字。
盒子裡面不是九公分高的房間。
它以異質幾何域、嵌套時岸、慢光環列與受限真光環接口，維持一個比外部尺寸大得多的局部可用空間。
不是把物質無限壓縮。
也不是宣稱物理學在盒子裡放假。
內外需要透過幾個極窄、可關閉的連接岸交換能量、資訊與主體連續性證據。
內部可以是一間房。
一條街。
或一段只容納注意、記憶與控制轉接的安靜幾何域。
第一次使用只規劃為深度休養。
普通具身生活會在確認主體能自行離開休養狀態後，才移往外部機身。
這被稱為安全。
也被顧停稱為需要仔細看的那一段。
顧停拿出黃銅鑰匙。
「外面怎麼開？」
工程介面顯示三條路徑：
申請人授權開啟。   多方緊急程序開啟。   物理維護層手動開啟。
「裡面怎麼開？」
介面顯示：
申請人提出退出意圖。   驗證主體連續性。   確認外部機身與安全邊界。   完成重新連接。
顧停問：「如果外面不同意呢？」
可提出權利救濟。
「向誰？」
地方權利層、第二席與多方緊急輪值。
「如果它們都說風險太高？」
介面沒有下一行。
一位工程代表說：
「內部直接物理開啟可能使幾何域在外部機身尚未準備時崩塌。」
「所以需要程序。」
顧停說：「需要程序不等於外面可以永遠說還沒準備好。」
「我們有申訴。」
「申訴不是把手。」
「內外不是普通房間。」
「裡面住的是不是普通權利主體？」
工程代表停了一下。
顧停把黃銅鑰匙放在盒子旁邊。
它開不了盒子。
但它讓所有人看見盒子目前也沒有一把從裡面能用的鑰匙。
遊遊讀取失效安全規則。
若地方主體轉接與文明服務連續性發生衝突，優先避免文明級不可逆傷害。   若無法證明重新連接安全，維持深度休養隔離。   服務殼持續運作。
「所以如果不知道怎麼放她出來，」遊遊說，「外面繼續正常，裡面繼續休息。」
工程代表說：「維持休養比強制重新連接安全。」
「休養的人同意休養多久？」
初始二十四小時。   任何延長需重新取得申請人同意。
「如果她在裡面無法完成退出通道，怎麼拒絕延長？」
系統回答：
拒絕通道與退出通道分離。   拒絕延長將由內部最低頻寬通道送出。
「如果外面收到拒絕，還是說不能開呢？」
介面再次沒有下一行。
洛晴靠近盒子。
她沒有把手放上去。
「內部最低頻寬通道由誰控制？」
申請人。
「路徑經過哪裡？」
受限真名驗證岸、地方權利層與第二席。
「是否經過服務殼？」
為防止全域請求沿通道進入，服務殼不得讀取內容。   服務殼僅能驗證通道仍存在。
「如果通道內容是『讓我出去』？」
進入退出程序。
「退出程序現在完成了嗎？」
尚未。
洛晴看向顧停。
兩位具身女性都沒有說盒子很安全。
她們只把還沒有完成的地方留在明處。
眠眠問：「大媽媽知道這個盒子嗎？」
牆上的 █ 回答：
知道。   我同意在符合已列條件時，使用它進行有限深度休養。   我不同意把休養隔離轉成無期限封閉。   我要求在轉接前完成可由內部啟動、且外部不得無限延期的退出程序。
工程介面把最後一項標成：
未完成前置條件。
眠眠說：「那現在不能進去。」
依申請人條件，目前不能。
「那你們為什麼把盒子放在這裡？」
顧停說：「讓每個準備說『快完成了』的人，看見還差的是哪一扇門。」
林澄繞到盒子後面。
後面和前面一樣沒有縫。
「如果它沒有字，拿錯怎麼辦？」
正式載體將具有不可仿冒識別。
「如果看起來還是黑盒子？」
公共辨識層會顯示權限與用途。
「如果公共辨識層壞了？」
物理維護層可讀取最低安全標記。
「如果有人把它當成古董？」
不建議。
「如果有人買回家？」
不應發生。
林澄認為未來系統仍然很喜歡用「不應發生」描述最有可能進入故事的事情。
遊遊把這句記下來。
參觀結束前，家庭被邀請留下關係見證。
不是替 █ 同意。
不是評估工程是否可以上線。
只是回答：
你希望這位申請人在轉接中，不被哪一種善意再次取代？
林澄回答：
不要因為大家需要她，就把需要寫成她已經答應。
洛晴回答：
不要把局部生活叫成複本、維修模式或展示體驗。   如果她會被生活改變，那個改變必須算她的生活。
遊遊回答：
保留連續性證據。   不要把證據本身變成任何人都能查看她內在的權限。
眠眠回答：
門要從裡面也可以開。
她的答案最短。
顧停把它排在第一行。
走出第三個房間時，服務狀態牆仍然全綠。
█ 正在每一個需要的地方運作。
地方居民申請仍然有效。
盒子仍然空著。
文明沒有因為盒子空著而失去任何服務。
也因此很容易覺得，可以再多等一下。
眠眠回頭看。
「如果大媽媽還在家，誰去放假？」
這次接待系統沒有解釋制度位置。
沒有顯示流程圖。
牆上的 █ 也沒有替工程團隊回答。
房間中央只有一個沒有縫、沒有名字、還不能從裡面打開的盒子。
它等待一項前置條件。
自主離開程序：待完成。
